CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ops.read_pdf_published_revision(p_task bigint, p_key text, p_digest text)
 RETURNS SETOF ops.pdf_published_revision
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
BEGIN ATOMIC
 SELECT pdf_published_revision.build_id,
     pdf_published_revision.task_id,
     pdf_published_revision.product_key,
     pdf_published_revision.logical_digest,
     pdf_published_revision.release_id,
     pdf_published_revision.source_digest,
     pdf_published_revision.schema_digest,
     pdf_published_revision.recipe_digest,
     pdf_published_revision.frozen_digest,
     pdf_published_revision.kind
    FROM (ops.pdf_published_revision
      JOIN ops.pdf_stage_build ON ((pdf_published_revision.build_id = pdf_stage_build.build_id)))
   WHERE ((pdf_published_revision.task_id = read_pdf_published_revision.p_task) AND (pdf_published_revision.product_key = read_pdf_published_revision.p_key) AND (pdf_published_revision.logical_digest = read_pdf_published_revision.p_digest) AND (pdf_stage_build.state = 'published'::text));
END

SELECT p.task_id,
    p.product_key,
    p.logical_digest AS content_digest,
    p.release_id,
    contract_input.content_digest AS contract_digest,
    p.schema_digest,
    p.recipe_digest,
    NULL::bigint AS parent_task_id,
    NULL::text AS parent_product_key,
    NULL::text AS parent_digest,
    NULL::jsonb AS native_json,
    ( SELECT c.body - ARRAY['source_scope'::text, 'page_start'::text, 'page_end'::text]
           FROM kb.pdf_record_companion c
          WHERE c.product_id = p.build_id AND c.revision_id = p.build_id AND c.family = 'health'::text AND c.body ? 'source_scope'::text
          ORDER BY c.ordinal, c.local_id
         LIMIT 1) AS health,
    NULL::bytea AS payload
   FROM ops.pdf_published_revision p
     JOIN ops.pdf_build_validation v ON v.build_id = p.build_id
     JOIN sem.input contract_input ON contract_input.release_id = p.release_id AND contract_input.input_kind = 'dependency'::text AND (contract_input.input_name = ANY (ARRAY['execution/schema/pdf_products'::text, 'pdf-domain/schema/pdf_products'::text]));

DECLARE principal name:=session_user; owner_oid oid;
BEGIN
 SELECT nspowner INTO owner_oid FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname='sem';
 IF pg_has_role(principal,owner_oid,'MEMBER') THEN RETURN; END IF;
 IF NOT pg_has_role(principal,'corpus_sem_admitter','USAGE')
 OR pg_has_role(principal,'corpus_sem_publisher','MEMBER')
 OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_roles WHERE oid=principal::regrole AND (rolsuper OR rolcreaterole OR rolcreatedb OR rolbypassrls OR rolreplication))
 OR has_database_privilege(principal,current_database(),'TEMP')
 OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname IN ('sem','data','ops','kb','eval') AND has_schema_privilege(principal,oid,'CREATE'))
 OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('sem','data') AND c.relkind IN ('r','p') AND (has_table_privilege(principal,c.oid,'INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE,TRUNCATE,TRIGGER') OR has_any_column_privilege(principal,c.oid,'INSERT,UPDATE')))
 OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='eval' AND c.relkind IN ('r','p') AND has_table_privilege(principal,c.oid,'SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE,TRUNCATE')) OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(data.execution_contract_descriptor()->'functions') contract
 JOIN pg_proc p ON p.oid=to_regprocedure(contract->>'signature')
 WHERE has_function_privilege(principal,p.oid,'EXECUTE') IS DISTINCT FROM ((contract->'execute_roles') ? 'corpus_sem_admitter')) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'unrestricted admission caller' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
END

DECLARE principal name:=session_user; required_role text; owner_oid oid;
BEGIN
 required_role:=CASE purpose WHEN 'read' THEN 'corpus_sem_reader' WHEN 'write' THEN 'corpus_sem_writer' WHEN 'evaluate' THEN 'corpus_sem_evaluator' WHEN 'admit' THEN 'corpus_sem_admitter' END;
 IF required_role IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unknown runtime purpose'; END IF;
 SELECT nspowner INTO owner_oid FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname='sem';
 IF NOT pg_has_role(principal,required_role,'USAGE') OR current_setting('role') NOT IN ('none',principal::text)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_roles WHERE oid=principal::regrole AND (rolsuper OR rolcreaterole OR rolcreatedb OR rolbypassrls OR rolreplication))
 OR pg_has_role(principal,'corpus_sem_publisher','MEMBER') OR pg_has_role(principal,owner_oid,'MEMBER')
 OR has_database_privilege(principal,current_database(),'TEMP')
 OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname IN ('sem','data','ops','kb','eval') AND has_schema_privilege(principal,oid,'CREATE'))
 OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('sem','data') AND c.relkind IN ('r','p') AND (has_table_privilege(principal,c.oid,'INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE,TRUNCATE,TRIGGER') OR has_any_column_privilege(principal,c.oid,'INSERT,UPDATE'))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'unrestricted or mismatched runtime principal for %',purpose USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF NOT has_table_privilege(principal,'sem.release','SELECT')
 OR NOT has_schema_privilege(principal,'ops','USAGE')
 OR (purpose IN ('read','write','evaluate') AND NOT coalesce(has_function_privilege(principal,to_regprocedure('ops.read_demand_result(jsonb)'),'EXECUTE'),false))
 OR (purpose='write' AND NOT coalesce(has_function_privilege(principal,to_regprocedure('ops.initialize_source_project(jsonb)'),'EXECUTE'),false))
 OR (purpose IN ('write','evaluate') AND NOT coalesce(has_function_privilege(principal,to_regprocedure('ops.register_data_demand(jsonb)'),'EXECUTE'),false))
 OR (purpose='evaluate' AND NOT coalesce(has_function_privilege(principal,to_regprocedure('ops.admit_authored_data(jsonb)'),'EXECUTE'),false))
 OR (purpose='admit' AND (NOT coalesce(has_function_privilege(principal,to_regprocedure('sem.publish_release_archive(text)'),'EXECUTE'),false)
 OR NOT coalesce(has_function_privilege(principal,to_regprocedure('ops.inspect_data_execution(jsonb)'),'EXECUTE'),false))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'required runtime capability unavailable' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(data.execution_contract_descriptor()->'functions') contract
  LEFT JOIN pg_proc p ON p.oid=to_regprocedure(contract->>'signature')
  WHERE p.oid IS NULL OR has_function_privilege(principal,p.oid,'EXECUTE') IS DISTINCT FROM ((contract->'execute_roles') ? required_role)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'runtime operation privileges differ from purpose contract' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF purpose<>'evaluate'  AND EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='eval' AND c.relkind IN ('r','p') AND has_table_privilege(principal,c.oid,'SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE,TRUNCATE')) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'runtime principal has independent reference access' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
END

DECLARE selected jsonb; product kb.data_product; member kb.data_product_member;
 roles jsonb:='[]'; support_refs jsonb; meaning jsonb; context_meaning jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF data.ddo_field(r.binding->'parameters','replicate') IS DISTINCT FROM
 data.ddo_json_meaning(jsonb_build_object('replicate',r.replicate)->'replicate') THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'CPU input basis requires the actual exact request replicate wrapper' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 FOR selected IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(r.binding->'inputs')
 ORDER BY value->>'role' COLLATE "C",(value->>'position')::integer NULLS FIRST,
 value->>'product_id' COLLATE "C",value->>'member_id' COLLATE "C" NULLS FIRST LOOP
 SELECT * INTO STRICT product FROM kb.data_product
 WHERE id=selected->>'product_id' AND project_id=r.project_id;
 member:=NULL;
 IF selected->>'member_id' IS NOT NULL THEN
 SELECT * INTO STRICT member FROM kb.data_product_member
 WHERE product_id=product.id AND member_id=selected->>'member_id'; END IF;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(reference ORDER BY convert_to(data.canonical_json(data.ddo_json_meaning(reference)),'UTF8')),'[]') INTO support_refs FROM (
 SELECT DISTINCT jsonb_strip_nulls(
 CASE WHEN coalesce(item->>'kind','computation')='computation' THEN
 jsonb_build_object('kind','computation','derivation_id',item->>'derivation_id','admission_use_id',item->>'admission_use_id')
 ELSE jsonb_build_object('kind',item->>'kind','admission_id',item->>'admission_id','source_reference',item->>'source_reference') END
 ) AS reference
 FROM jsonb_array_elements(r.binding->'support') entry(item)
 WHERE item->>'role'=selected->>'role' AND item->>'position' IS NOT DISTINCT FROM selected->>'position'
 AND (EXISTS(SELECT FROM ops.data_derivation_output output
 WHERE coalesce(item->>'kind','computation')='computation' AND output.derivation_id=item->>'derivation_id'
 AND output.product_id=product.id AND (output.member_id IS NULL OR output.member_id=member.member_id))
 OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM ops.original_source_admission admission
 WHERE item->>'kind' IN ('original-source','authored') AND admission.id=item->>'admission_id'
 AND admission.product_id=product.id AND member.member_id IS NULL))
 ) admitted;
 context_meaning:=data.ddo_json_meaning(jsonb_build_object(
 'project_id',r.project_id,'subject',coalesce(member.subject,product.subject),
 'subject_definition',coalesce(member.subject_definition,product.subject_definition),
 'original_source',CASE WHEN member.member_id IS NULL THEN product.original_source ELSE member.original_source END,
 'analyzed_scope',coalesce(member.analyzed_scope,product.analyzed_scope)));
 meaning:=jsonb_build_array('mapping',jsonb_build_array(
 jsonb_build_array('role',jsonb_build_array('string',selected->>'role')),
 jsonb_build_array('position',CASE WHEN selected->>'position' IS NULL THEN '["null"]'::jsonb ELSE jsonb_build_array('integer',selected->>'position') END),
 jsonb_build_array('multiplicity',jsonb_build_array('integer',selected->>'multiplicity')),
 jsonb_build_array('product_id',jsonb_build_array('string',product.id)),
 jsonb_build_array('member_id',CASE WHEN member.member_id IS NULL THEN '["null"]'::jsonb ELSE jsonb_build_array('string',member.member_id) END),
 jsonb_build_array('kind_contract',jsonb_build_array('string',coalesce(member.kind_contract,product.kind_contract))),
 jsonb_build_array('context',context_meaning),
 jsonb_build_array('body',coalesce(member.body,product.canonical_body)),
 jsonb_build_array('support',data.ddo_json_meaning(support_refs))));
 roles:=roles||jsonb_build_array(meaning);
 END LOOP;
 RETURN data.ddo_normalize(jsonb_build_array('mapping',jsonb_build_array(
 jsonb_build_array('version',jsonb_build_array('string','cpu-input-basis-2')),
 jsonb_build_array('recipe',jsonb_build_array('string',r.recipe)),
 jsonb_build_array('context',data.ddo_json_meaning(jsonb_build_object(
 'project_id',r.project_id,'subject',r.subject,'subject_definition',ops.ddo_operation_subject(r.release_id,r.operation_id),
 'original_source',r.original_source,'analyzed_scope',r.analyzed_scope))),
 jsonb_build_array('roles',jsonb_build_array('sequence',roles)),
 jsonb_build_array('parameters',data.ddo_normalize(data.ddo_field(r.binding->'parameters','parameters'))),
 jsonb_build_array('replicate',data.ddo_normalize(data.ddo_field(r.binding->'parameters','replicate'))))));
END

DECLARE p jsonb:=jsonb_build_object('scope',boundary.scope); node record;
BEGIN
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(d.selection->'operations') selected
 JOIN sem.data_operation_definition definition ON definition.release_id=d.release_id AND definition.operation_id=selected->>'operation'
 WHERE definition.operation_id IN ('record_policy.grade','record_policy.fit','record_policy.authorize')
 OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(definition.input_roles||definition.output_roles) role
 JOIN sem.data_kind_contract kind ON kind.kind_contract=role->>'kind_contract'
 WHERE kind.universe='evaluator')) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'record census cannot consume a protected judgment demand' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 FOR node IN WITH RECURSIVE selected_use_seeds AS 
(SELECT DISTINCT ON (ops.demand_use.obligation_id) ops.demand_use.obligation_id AS obligation_id, ops.demand_use.id AS id, ops.demand_use.fate AS fate 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE ops.demand_use.demand_id = d.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.demand_use.created_at, ops.demand_use.created_xid, boundary) ORDER BY ops.demand_use.obligation_id, ops.demand_use.created_at DESC, ops.demand_use.id DESC), 
source_entries AS 
(SELECT source_entry.value AS entry 
FROM jsonb_each(coalesce(d.selection['source_sets'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB))) AS source_set(key, value) JOIN jsonb_array_elements(source_set.value) AS source_entry(value) ON true), 
support_seed AS 
(SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(selected_use_seeds.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM selected_use_seeds 
WHERE true UNION SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_population.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population 
WHERE ops.data_population.demand_id = d.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.data_population.created_at, ops.data_population.created_xid, boundary) UNION SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation JOIN ops.data_derivation_output ON ops.data_derivation_output.derivation_id = ops.data_derivation.id JOIN ops.demand_use ON ops.demand_use.derivation_id = ops.data_derivation.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = d.project_id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM source_entries 
WHERE (source_entries.entry ->> 'product') = ops.data_derivation_output.product_id)) AND ops.demand_use.fate = 'fulfilled' AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.demand_use.created_at, ops.demand_use.created_xid, boundary) UNION SELECT CAST('original' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.original_source_admission.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.original_source_admission 
WHERE ops.original_source_admission.demand_id = d.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.original_source_admission.created_at, ops.original_source_admission.created_xid, boundary)), 
support_closure(kind, id) AS 
(SELECT support_seed.kind AS kind, support_seed.id AS id 
FROM support_seed 
WHERE support_seed.id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT support_edge.kind AS kind, support_edge.id AS id 
FROM support_closure JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN (ops.data_derivation_support.admission_use_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(coalesce(ops.data_derivation_support.admission_use_id, ops.data_derivation_support.support_derivation_id) AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation_support 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation_support.derivation_id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('original' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_derivation_original_support.admission_id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation_original_support 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation_original_support.derivation_id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('episode' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.derivation_id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN 'original' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_id' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id' ELSE selected_support_reference.value ->> 'derivation_id' END AS TEXT) AS id

 WITH RECURSIVE bounded AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT ops.data_obligation.id AS id, ops.data_obligation.demand_id AS demand_id, ops.data_obligation.operation_id AS operation_id, ops.data_obligation.subject AS subject, ops.data_obligation.original_source AS original_source, ops.data_obligation.analyzed_scope AS analyzed_scope, ops.data_obligation.parameters AS parameters, ops.data_obligation.created_at AS created_at, ops.data_obligation.created_xid AS created_xid

FROM ops.data_derivation_support

WHERE ops.data_derivation_output.derivation_id = selected_uses.derivation_id AND CASE WHEN (selected_view = 'products') THEN CASE WHEN (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'product_ids') OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM jsonb_array_elements_text((coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)))['product_ids']) AS selected_body_product(value)

FROM selected_uses), 'obligations', (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(((to_jsonb(bounded) - 'created_at') - 'created_xid') || jsonb_build_object('obligation_id', bounded.id, 'subject_definition', (SELECT sem.data_operation_definition.subject_definition 
FROM sem.data_operation_definition 
WHERE sem.data_operation_definition.release_id = d.release_id AND sem.data_operation_definition.operation_id = bounded.operation_id), 'historical_fate', latest.fate, 'fate', CASE WHEN (latest.fate = 'fulfilled' AND ops.ddo_use_valid(latest, boundary) = false) THEN 'unavailable' WHEN (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.data_external_packet JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_external_packet.request_id AND ops.data_request.generation = ops.data_external_packet.generation AND ops.data_request.live_task_id = ops.data_external_packet.task_id

WHERE ops.data_completion_intent.request_id = latest.request_id AND ops.data_completion_intent.generation = latest.generation ORDER BY ops.data_completion_intent.created_at DESC, ops.data_completion_intent.id DESC 
 LIMIT 1)) ORDER BY bounded.id), CAST('[]' AS JSONB)) AS coalesce_4

 LIMIT 1) AS latest ON true), 'original_source_admissions', (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('admission_id', ops.original_source_admission.id, 'selection_name', ops.original_source_admission.selection_name, 'product_id', ops.original_source_admission.product_id, 'kind_contract', kb.data_product.kind_contract, 'subject', ops.original_source_admission.subject, 'subject_definition', kb.data_product.subject_definition, 'original_source', ops.original_source_admission.original_source, 'analyzed_scope', ops.original_source_admission.analyzed_scope, 'source_reference', ops.original_source_admission.source_reference, 'trust_snapshot', ops.original_source_admission.trust_snapshot, 'evidence', ops.original_source_admission.evidence) ORDER BY ops.original_source_admission.id), CAST('[]' AS JSONB)) AS coalesce_5 
FROM ops.original_source_admission JOIN kb.data_product ON kb.data_product.id = ops.original_source_admission.product_id 
WHERE ops.original_source_admission.demand_id = d.id AND ops.ddo_original_admission_valid(original_source_admission, boundary) AND ops.ddo_kind_access(kb.data_product.kind_contract) AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM bounded 
WHERE bounded.subject = ops.original_source_admission.subject AND bounded.original_source IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ops.original_source_admission.original_source AND bounded.analyzed_scope = ops.original_source_admission.analyzed_scope))), 'support_page', CASE WHEN (selected_view = 'support') THEN CASE WHEN (SELECT coalesce(bool_and(ops.ddo_body_access(kb.data_product.kind_contract, kb.data_product.canonical_body)), true) AS coalesce_6

FROM support_export_page) ELSE NULL END, 'complete', (SELECT count(*) AS count_1 
FROM support_export_bounded) <= lim) ELSE ops.ddo_result_bytes_refusal() END ELSE ops.ddo_result_bytes_refusal() END ELSE NULL END, 'attempt_failures', (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('failure_id', ops.data_attempt_failure.id, 'request_id', ops.data_attempt_failure.request_id, 'generation', ops.data_attempt_failure.generation, 'task_id', ops.data_attempt_failure.task_id, 'attempt', ops.data_attempt_failure.attempt, 'holder', ops.data_attempt_failure.holder, 'failure', CASE WHEN ((ops.data_attempt_failure.failure ? 'd1_limitation') AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.data_request JOIN jsonb_array_elements(ops.data_request.binding['inputs']) AS failure_input(value) ON true JOIN kb.data_product ON kb.data_product.id = (failure_input.value ->> 'product_id') LEFT OUTER JOIN kb.data_product_member AS failure_member ON failure_member.product_id = kb.data_product.id AND failure_member.member_id = (failure_input.value ->> 'member_id') 
WHERE ops.data_request.id = ops.data_attempt_failure.request_id AND NOT ops.ddo_kind_access(coalesce(failure_member.kind_contract, kb.data_product.kind_contract))))) THEN (ops.data_attempt_failure.failure - 'd1_limitation') || jsonb_build_object('d1_limitation_disclosure', 'undisclosed') ELSE ops.data_attempt_failure.failure END) ORDER BY ops.data_attempt_failure.request_id, ops.data_attempt_failure.generation, ops.data_attempt_failure.attempt), CAST('[]' AS JSONB)) AS coalesce_9 
FROM ops.data_attempt_failure 
WHERE (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM selected_uses

FROM ops.data_population 
WHERE ops.data_population.demand_id = d.id AND (ops.data_population.selected_obligation_id IS NULL OR ops.data_population.selected_obligation_id IN (SELECT bounded.id 
FROM bounded)) AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.data_population.created_at, ops.data_population.created_xid, boundary) AND ops.ddo_population_valid(data_population, boundary)), 'continuation', CASE WHEN ((SELECT max(bounded.id) AS max_2 
FROM bounded) IS NOT NULL AND (EXISTS (SELECT ops.data_obligation.id, ops.data_obligation.demand_id, ops.data_obligation.operation_id, ops.data_obligation.subject, ops.data_obligation.original_source, ops.data_obligation.analyzed_scope, ops.data_obligation.parameters, ops.data_obligation.created_at, ops.data_obligation.created_xid 
FROM ops.data_obligation 
WHERE ops.data_obligation.demand_id = d.id AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'operation_id') OR ops.data_obligation.operation_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'operation_id')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'subject') OR ops.data_obligation.subject IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'subject')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'original_source') OR ops.data_obligation.original_source IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'original_source')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'product_ids') OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.demand_use AS scope_use JOIN ops.data_derivation_output ON ops.data_derivation_output.derivation_id = scope_use.derivation_id JOIN jsonb_array_elements_text((coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)))['product_ids']) AS scope_product(value) ON ops.data_derivation_output.product_id = scope_product.value 
WHERE scope_use.obligation_id = ops.data_obligation.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_use.created_at, scope_use.created_xid, boundary) AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.demand_use AS scope_later_use 
WHERE scope_later_use.obligation_id = scope_use.obligation_id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_later_use.created_at, scope_later_use.created_xid, boundary) AND (scope_later_use.created_at > scope_use.created_at OR scope_later_use.created_at = scope_use.created_at AND scope_later_use.id > scope_use.id))))) OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.original_source_admission AS scope_original JOIN jsonb_array_elements_text((coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)))['product_ids']) AS scope_product(value) ON scope_original.product_id = scope_product.value 
WHERE scope_original.demand_id = d.id AND scope_original.project_id = d.project_id AND scope_original.subject = ops.data_obligation.subject AND scope_original.original_source IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ops.data_obligation.original_source AND scope_original.analyzed_scope = ops.data_obligation.analyzed_scope AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_original.created_at, scope_original.created_xid, boundary)))) AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.data_obligation.created_at, ops.data_obligation.created_xid, boundary) AND ops.data_obligation.id > (SELECT max(bounded.id) AS max_2

 SELECT obligations||coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(value->>'obligation_id',value),'{}') INTO obligations
 FROM jsonb_array_elements(results->'payload'->'obligations') item(value);
 SELECT uses_||coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(value->>'use_id',value),'{}') INTO uses_
 FROM jsonb_array_elements(results->'payload'->'uses') item(value);
 EXIT WHEN results->'payload'->'continuation' IS NULL OR results->'payload'->'continuation'='null'::jsonb;
 after_key:=results->'payload'->'continuation'->>'after';
 END LOOP;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(selected_output)),'[]') INTO outputs
 FROM (WITH RECURSIVE scoped_obligations AS 
(SELECT ops.data_obligation.id AS id, ops.data_obligation.demand_id AS demand_id, ops.data_obligation.operation_id AS operation_id, ops.data_obligation.subject AS subject, ops.data_obligation.original_source AS original_source, ops.data_obligation.analyzed_scope AS analyzed_scope, ops.data_obligation.parameters AS parameters, ops.data_obligation.created_at AS created_at, ops.data_obligation.created_xid AS created_xid 
FROM ops.data_obligation 
WHERE ops.data_obligation.demand_id = d.id AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'operation_id') OR ops.data_obligation.operation_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'operation_id')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'subject') OR ops.data_obligation.subject IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'subject')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'original_source') OR ops.data_obligation.original_source IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'original_source')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'product_ids') OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.demand_use AS scope_use JOIN ops.data_derivation_output ON ops.data_derivation_output.derivation_id = scope_use.derivation_id JOIN jsonb_array_elements_text((coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)))['product_ids']) AS scope_product(value) ON ops.data_derivation_output.product_id = scope_product.value 
WHERE scope_use.obligation_id = ops.data_obligation.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_use.created_at, scope_use.created_xid, boundary) AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.demand_use AS scope_later_use 
WHERE scope_later_use.obligation_id = scope_use.obligation_id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_later_use.created_at, scope_later_use.created_xid, boundary) AND (scope_later_use.created_at > scope_use.created_at OR scope_later_use.created_at = scope_use.created_at AND scope_later_use.id > scope_use.id))))) OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.original_source_admission AS scope_original JOIN jsonb_array_elements_text((coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)))['product_ids']) AS scope_product(value) ON scope_original.product_id = scope_product.value 
WHERE scope_original.demand_id = d.id AND scope_original.project_id = d.project_id AND scope_original.subject = ops.data_obligation.subject AND scope_original.original_source IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ops.data_obligation.original_source AND scope_original.analyzed_scope = ops.data_obligation.analyzed_scope AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_original.created_at, scope_original.created_xid, boundary)))) AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.data_obligation.created_at, ops.data_obligation.created_xid, boundary)), 
selected_uses AS 
(SELECT latest.id AS id, latest.demand_id AS demand_id, latest.obligation_id AS obligation_id, latest.fate AS fate, latest.request_id AS request_id, latest.generation AS generation, latest.derivation_id AS derivation_id, latest.selection AS selection, latest.trust_snapshot AS trust_snapshot, latest.created_at AS created_at, latest.created_xid AS created_xid

 LIMIT 1) AS latest ON true), 
selected_output_seed AS 
(SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(selected_uses.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM selected_uses 
WHERE selected_uses.fate = 'fulfilled' AND ops.ddo_use_valid(selected_uses, boundary)), 
support_closure(kind, id) AS 
(SELECT selected_output_seed.kind AS kind, selected_output_seed.id AS id

FROM ops.data_derivation_support 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation_support.derivation_id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('original' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_derivation_original_support.admission_id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation_original_support 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation_original_support.derivation_id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('episode' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.derivation_id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN 'original' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_id' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id' ELSE selected_support_reference.value ->> 'derivation_id' END AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ops.demand_use.selection['support'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS selected_support_reference(value) ON true 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND true UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_population.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ops.demand_use.selection['populations'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS selected_population_reference(value) ON true JOIN ops.data_population ON ops.data_population.id = (selected_population_reference.value ->> 'population_id') AND ops.data_population.demand_id = ops.demand_use.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND true UNION ALL SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population JOIN ops.demand_use ON ops.demand_use.id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'admission_use_id') AND ops.demand_use.derivation_id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'derivation_id') AND ops.demand_use.demand_id = ops.data_population.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST((ops.data_population.evidence['selection']) ->> 'parent_population_id' AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id) AS support_edge ON true 
WHERE support_edge.id IS NOT NULL)
 SELECT DISTINCT ops.data_derivation.id AS derivation_id, ops.data_derivation_output.product_id 
FROM ops.data_derivation JOIN ops.data_derivation_output ON ops.data_derivation_output.derivation_id = ops.data_derivation.id JOIN kb.data_product ON kb.data_product.id = ops.data_derivation_output.product_id 
WHERE (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM support_closure 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id)) AND ops.data_derivation_output.member_id IS NULL AND kb.data_product.project_id = d.project_id AND ops.ddo_support_valid(ops.data_derivation.id, boundary) AND ops.ddo_kind_access(kb.data_product.kind_contract) AND ops.ddo_body_access(kb.data_product.kind_contract, kb.data_product.canonical_body)) selected_output;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('obligations',obligations,'uses',uses_,'outputs',outputs);
END

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ops.ddo_record_grade_acquire_census(project text,cut_text text,cut_id text)
RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=pg_catalog,pg_temp AS $grade$
DECLARE d ops.data_demand; boundary ops.data_demand_read; p jsonb; captured jsonb:=cut_text::jsonb; results jsonb;
 obligations jsonb:='{}'; uses_ jsonb:='{}'; outputs jsonb;
 lim bigint:=1000; after_key text:=''; selected_view text:='frontier'; selected_max_bytes bigint:=67108864;
BEGIN
 PERFORM ops.ddo_record_grade_require_cut(project,cut_text,cut_id);
 SELECT * INTO STRICT d FROM ops.data_demand WHERE id=captured->>'demand_id' AND project_id=project;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT boundary FROM ops.data_demand_read WHERE id=captured->>'read_id' AND demand_id=d.id;
 p:=jsonb_build_object('scope',boundary.scope);
 -- One prepared, bounded frontier per distinct actual cut. Numerical/event
 -- comparisons below use these indexes rather than restarting the frontier.
 LOOP
 WITH RECURSIVE bounded AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT ops.data_obligation.id AS id, ops.data_obligation.demand_id AS demand_id, ops.data_obligation.operation_id AS operation_id, ops.data_obligation.subject AS subject, ops.data_obligation.original_source AS original_source, ops.data_obligation.analyzed_scope AS analyzed_scope, ops.data_obligation.parameters AS parameters, ops.data_obligation.created_at AS created_at, ops.data_obligation.created_xid AS created_xid 
FROM ops.data_obligation 
WHERE ops.data_obligation.demand_id = d.id AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'operation_id') OR ops.data_obligation.operation_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'operation_id')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'subject') OR ops.data_obligation.subject IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'subject')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'original_source') OR ops.data_obligation.original_source IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'original_source')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'product_ids') OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.demand_use AS scope_use JOIN ops.data_derivation_output ON ops.data_derivation_output.derivation_id = scope_use.derivation_id JOIN jsonb_array_elements_text((coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)))['product_ids']) AS scope_product(value) ON ops.data_derivation_output.product_id = scope_product.value 
WHERE scope_use.obligation_id = ops.data_obligation.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_use.created_at, scope_use.created_xid, boundary) AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.demand_use AS scope_later_use

DECLARE definition sem.data_operation_definition; output jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF r.operation_id IS DISTINCT FROM 'record_policy.grade' THEN RETURN; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT definition FROM sem.data_operation_definition WHERE release_id=r.release_id AND operation_id=r.operation_id;
 IF definition.profile IS DISTINCT FROM 'derivation' OR definition.support_contract->'effects' IS DISTINCT FROM '[]'::jsonb
 OR definition.support_contract->'capabilities'->'prepared_factory'->>'entrypoint' IS DISTINCT FROM 'corpus_structure.methods.declared_record_policy.RecordPolicyGrade.acquire_port'
 OR (definition.support_contract->'capabilities'->'prepared_factory'->>'source_digest' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') IS NOT TRUE
 OR (definition.implementation_revision LIKE 'implementation-slice:%') IS NOT TRUE
 OR completion->>'implementation_revision' IS DISTINCT FROM definition.implementation_revision
 OR jsonb_array_length(coalesce(completion->'execution_evidence'->'cpu_receipts','[]'))<>1
 OR completion->>'outcome' IS DISTINCT FROM 'success' OR completion->'inputs' IS DISTINCT FROM r.binding->'inputs'
 OR jsonb_array_length(completion->'outputs')<>1 THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'record grade requires its actual admitted pure CPU implementation and complete inputs' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 output:=completion->'outputs'->0;
 IF output->>'role' IS DISTINCT FROM 'grade' OR output->>'member_id' IS NOT NULL
 OR (output->>'position')::integer IS DISTINCT FROM 0 OR (output->>'multiplicity')::integer IS DISTINCT FROM 1
 OR output->'product'->'members' IS DISTINCT FROM '[]'::jsonb
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM sem.data_kind_contract kind WHERE kind.kind_contract=output->'product'->>'kind_contract'
 AND kind.kind='https://corpus-structure.dev/semantic/data-operation-record-policy/protected/DdoRecordGrade' AND kind.universe='evaluator') THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'record grade output differs from protected whole scalar contract' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
END

DECLARE scope_key text; snapshot jsonb:='{}'; e bigint;
BEGIN
 -- A recursive closure includes every producing scope, not merely caller named epochs.
 FOR scope_key IN WITH RECURSIVE support_seed AS 
(SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN ((root_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN 'original' WHEN ((root_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(CASE WHEN ((root_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN root_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_id' WHEN ((root_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN root_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id' ELSE root_support_reference.value ->> 'derivation_id' END AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(support) AS root_support_reference(value)), 
support_closure(kind, id) AS 
(SELECT support_seed.kind AS kind, support_seed.id AS id 
FROM support_seed 
WHERE support_seed.id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT support_edge.kind AS kind, support_edge.id AS id 
FROM support_closure JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN (ops.data_derivation_support.admission_use_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(coalesce(ops.data_derivation_support.admission_use_id, ops.data_derivation_support.support_derivation_id) AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation_support 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation_support.derivation_id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('original' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_derivation_original_support.admission_id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation_original_support 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation_original_support.derivation_id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('episode' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.derivation_id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN 'original' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_id' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id' ELSE selected_support_reference.value ->> 'derivation_id' END AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ops.demand_use.selection['support'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS selected_support_reference(value) ON true 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND true UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_population.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ops.demand_use.selection['populations'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS selected_population_reference(value) ON true JOIN ops.data_population ON ops.data_population.id = (selected_population_reference.value ->> 'population_id') AND ops.data_population.demand_id = ops.demand_use.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND true UNION ALL SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population JOIN ops.demand_use ON ops.demand_use.id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'admission_use_id') AND ops.demand_use.derivation_id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'derivation_id') AND ops.demand_use.demand_id = ops.data_population.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST((ops.data_population.evidence['selection']) ->> 'parent_population_id' AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id) AS support_edge ON true 
WHERE support_edge.id IS NOT NULL), 
support_sources AS 
(SELECT source AS source UNION SELECT ops.data_request.original_source AS source 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.data_derivation ON support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = project UNION SELECT ops.original_source_admission.original_source AS source 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.original_source_admission ON support_closure.kind = 'original' AND ops.original_source_admission.id = support_closure.id 
WHERE ops.original_source_admission.project_id = project)
 SELECT ops.ddo_scope(project, support_sources.source) AS scope 
FROM support_sources UNION SELECT record_grade_scope.scope 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.data_derivation ON support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id JOIN ops.ddo_record_grade_dependency_scopes(ops.data_derivation.id) AS record_grade_scope(scope) ON true 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = project UNION SELECT record_fit_scope.scope 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.data_derivation ON support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id JOIN ops.ddo_record_fit_dependency_scopes(ops.data_derivation.id) AS record_fit_scope(scope) ON true 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = project UNION SELECT operation_event_scope.scope 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.data_derivation ON support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id JOIN ops.ddo_operation_event_dependency_scopes(ops.data_derivation.id) AS operation_event_scope(scope) ON true 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = project ORDER BY scope LOOP
 INSERT INTO ops.data_trust_scope(scope,project_id,epoch) VALUES(scope_key,project,0) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
 SELECT epoch INTO e FROM ops.data_trust_scope WHERE scope=scope_key FOR UPDATE;
 snapshot:=snapshot||jsonb_build_object(scope_key,e);
 END LOOP;
 RETURN snapshot;
END

FROM ops.demand_use JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ops.demand_use.selection['support'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS selected_support_reference(value) ON true 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND true UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_population.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ops.demand_use.selection['populations'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS selected_population_reference(value) ON true JOIN ops.data_population ON ops.data_population.id = (selected_population_reference.value ->> 'population_id') AND ops.data_population.demand_id = ops.demand_use.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND true UNION ALL SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population JOIN ops.demand_use ON ops.demand_use.id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'admission_use_id') AND ops.demand_use.derivation_id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'derivation_id') AND ops.demand_use.demand_id = ops.data_population.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST((ops.data_population.evidence['selection']) ->> 'parent_population_id' AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id) AS support_edge ON true 
WHERE support_edge.id IS NOT NULL), 
support_sources AS 
(SELECT source AS source UNION SELECT ops.data_request.original_source AS source 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.data_derivation ON support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = project UNION SELECT ops.original_source_admission.original_source AS source 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.original_source_admission ON support_closure.kind = 'original' AND ops.original_source_admission.id = support_closure.id 
WHERE ops.original_source_admission.project_id = project)
 SELECT ops.ddo_scope(project, support_sources.source) AS scope 
FROM support_sources UNION SELECT record_grade_scope.scope 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.data_derivation ON support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id JOIN ops.ddo_record_grade_dependency_scopes(ops.data_derivation.id) AS record_grade_scope(scope) ON true 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = project UNION SELECT record_fit_scope.scope 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.data_derivation ON support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id JOIN ops.ddo_record_fit_dependency_scopes(ops.data_derivation.id) AS record_fit_scope(scope) ON true 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = project UNION SELECT operation_event_scope.scope 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.data_derivation ON support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id JOIN ops.ddo_operation_event_dependency_scopes(ops.data_derivation.id) AS operation_event_scope(scope) ON true 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = project ORDER BY scope) ordinary_scopes
 UNION SELECT scope FROM ops.ddo_record_grade_completion_scopes(r) extra(scope)
 UNION SELECT scope FROM ops.ddo_record_fit_completion_scopes(r) fit_extra(scope)
 UNION SELECT scope FROM ops.ddo_operation_event_completion_scopes(r) event_extra(scope)
 ORDER BY scope
 LOOP
 INSERT INTO ops.data_trust_scope(scope,project_id,epoch) VALUES(scope_key,project,0) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
 SELECT epoch INTO e FROM ops.data_trust_scope WHERE scope=scope_key FOR UPDATE;
 snapshot:=snapshot||jsonb_build_object(scope_key,e);
 END LOOP;
 RETURN snapshot;
END

-- Completion must lock the union once in canonical order. A grade's retained
-- census includes failed and zero-output producers beyond bound product support.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ops.ddo_lock_completion_support(r ops.data_request,completion jsonb) RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=pg_catalog,pg_temp AS $$
DECLARE project text:=r.project_id; source text:=r.original_source; support jsonb:=completion->'support';
 scope_key text; snapshot jsonb:='{}'; e bigint;
BEGIN
 FOR scope_key IN
 SELECT scope FROM (WITH RECURSIVE support_seed AS 
(SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN ((root_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN 'original' WHEN ((root_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(CASE WHEN ((root_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN root_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_id' WHEN ((root_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN root_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id' ELSE root_support_reference.value ->> 'derivation_id' END AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(support) AS root_support_reference(value)), 
support_closure(kind, id) AS 
(SELECT support_seed.kind AS kind, support_seed.id AS id 
FROM support_seed 
WHERE support_seed.id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT support_edge.kind AS kind, support_edge.id AS id 
FROM support_closure JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN (ops.data_derivation_support.admission_use_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(coalesce(ops.data_derivation_support.admission_use_id, ops.data_derivation_support.support_derivation_id) AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation_support 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation_support.derivation_id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('original' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_derivation_original_support.admission_id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation_original_support 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation_original_support.derivation_id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('episode' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.derivation_id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN 'original' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_id' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id' ELSE selected_support_reference.value ->> 'derivation_id' END AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ops.demand_use.selection['support'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS selected_support_reference(value) ON true 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND true UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_population.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ops.demand_use.selection['populations'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS selected_population_reference(value) ON true JOIN ops.data_population ON ops.data_population.id = (selected_population_reference.value ->> 'population_id') AND ops.data_population.demand_id = ops.demand_use.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND true UNION ALL SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population JOIN ops.demand_use ON ops.demand_use.id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'admission_use_id') AND ops.demand_use.derivation_id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'derivation_id') AND ops.demand_use.demand_id = ops.data_population.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST((ops.data_population.evidence['selection']) ->> 'parent_population_id' AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id) AS support_edge ON true 
WHERE support_edge.id IS NOT NULL), 
support_sources AS 
(SELECT source AS source UNION SELECT ops.data_request.original_source AS source 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.data_derivation ON support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = project UNION SELECT ops.original_source_admission.original_source AS source 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.original_source_admission ON support_closure.kind = 'original' AND ops.original_source_admission.id = support_closure.id 
WHERE ops.original_source_admission.project_id = project)
 SELECT ops.ddo_scope(project, support_sources.source) AS scope 
FROM support_sources UNION SELECT record_grade_scope.scope 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.data_derivation ON support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id JOIN ops.ddo_record_grade_dependency_scopes(ops.data_derivation.id) AS record_grade_scope(scope) ON true 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = project UNION SELECT record_fit_scope.scope 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.data_derivation ON support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id JOIN ops.ddo_record_fit_dependency_scopes(ops.data_derivation.id) AS record_fit_scope(scope) ON true 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = project UNION SELECT operation_event_scope.scope 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.data_derivation ON support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id JOIN ops.ddo_operation_event_dependency_scopes(ops.data_derivation.id) AS operation_event_scope(scope) ON true 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = project ORDER BY scope) ordinary_scopes
 UNION SELECT scope FROM ops.ddo_record_grade_completion_scopes(r) extra(scope)
 UNION SELECT scope FROM ops.ddo_record_fit_completion_scopes(r) fit_extra(scope)
 UNION SELECT scope FROM ops.ddo_operation_event_completion_scopes(r) event_extra(scope)
 ORDER BY scope
 LOOP
 INSERT INTO ops.data_trust_scope(scope,project_id,epoch) VALUES(scope_key,project,0) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
 SELECT epoch INTO e FROM ops.data_trust_scope WHERE scope=scope_key FOR UPDATE;
 snapshot:=snapshot||jsonb_build_object(scope_key,e);
 END LOOP;
 RETURN snapshot;
END $$
ALTER FUNCTION ops.ddo_lock_completion_support(ops.data_request,jsonb) OWNER TO corpus_sem_publisher

DECLARE p jsonb:=p_payload; key text; d ops.data_demand; subject_scopes jsonb; root_context jsonb; selected_definition sem.data_operation_definition;
BEGIN
 PERFORM ops.ddo_fields(p,ARRAY['project_id','release_id','runtime_id','root','selection','strength']);
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.project WHERE project_id=p->>'project_id') OR
 NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM sem.data_operation_definition WHERE release_id=p->>'release_id') OR
 p->>'strength' NOT IN ('value','episode','independent') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unadmitted demand/project/strength'; END IF;
 IF p->'root' IS DISTINCT FROM p->'selection'->'roots'
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM sem.artifact a WHERE a.release_id=p->>'release_id' AND a.artifact_name='data_operations.json' AND a.content_digest=p->'selection'->>'model')
 OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(p->'selection'->'operations') selected WHERE NOT EXISTS(
 SELECT FROM sem.artifact a CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(convert_from(a.content,'UTF8')::jsonb->'operations') op
 WHERE a.release_id=p->>'release_id' AND a.artifact_name='data_operation_native_definitions.json'
 AND op->>'operation_id'=selected->>'operation' AND op->>'recipe'=selected->>'recipe'
 AND op->>'definition'=selected->>'definition' AND op->>'eligibility'=selected->>'eligibility')) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'demand differs from authenticated effective model/selection'; END IF;
 -- Authenticate the selected graph, not merely each node's recipe identity.
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(p->'selection'->'operations') selected GROUP BY selected->>'operation' HAVING count(*)<>1)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM sem.artifact a
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(convert_from(a.content,'UTF8')::jsonb->'operations') operation
 JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(p->'selection'->'operations') selected ON selected->>'operation'=operation->>'semantic_id'
 WHERE a.release_id=p->>'release_id' AND a.artifact_name='data_operations.json'
 AND (NOT (coalesce(operation->'dependencies','[]') <@ (selected->'dependencies'))
 OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(selected->'dependencies') dependency
 WHERE NOT ((coalesce(operation->'dependencies','[]')||coalesce(operation->'potential_dependencies','[]')) ? dependency))
 OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(selected->'dependencies') dependency GROUP BY dependency HAVING count(*)<>1)))
 OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(p->'selection'->'operations') selected
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(selected->'dependencies') dependency
 WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(p->'selection'->'operations') target WHERE target->>'operation'=dependency))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'selected dependencies differ from the authenticated declared graph'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(p->'selection'->'discovery') relation GROUP BY relation->>'population' HAVING count(DISTINCT jsonb_build_array(relation->>'producer',relation->>'output_role'))<>1)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(p->'selection'->'discovery') relation GROUP BY relation HAVING count(*)<>1) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'discovery population requires one source projection and distinct targets'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(p->'selection'->'discovery') relation
 WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM sem.artifact a
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(convert_from(a.content,'UTF8')::jsonb->'operations') operation
 WHERE a.release_id=p->>'release_id' AND a.artifact_name='data_operations.json'
 AND operation->>'semantic_id'=relation->>'producer' AND operation->>'profile'='discovery'
 AND EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(operation->'roles') role WHERE role->>'direction'='output' AND role->>'name'=relation->>'output_role')))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'discovery relation differs from declared producer output'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(p->'selection'->'discovery') relation
 WHERE relation ? 'target_role' AND (jsonb_typeof(relation->'target_role') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR NOT EXISTS(
 SELECT FROM sem.data_operation_definition target
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(target.input_roles) input
 JOIN sem.data_operation_definition producer ON producer.release_id=target.release_id AND producer.operation_id=relation->>'producer'
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(producer.output_roles) output
 JOIN sem.data_kind_contract kind ON kind.kind_contract=output->>'kind_contract'
 WHERE target.release_id=p->>'release_id' AND target.operation_id=relation->>'target'
 AND input->>'name'=relation->>'target_role' AND output->>'name'=relation->>'output_role'
 AND coalesce(input->'support'->'origins','["computation"]'::jsonb) ? 'computation'
 AND EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(input->'accepted_kind_contracts') accepted WHERE kind.member_contracts ? accepted))))
 OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(p->'selection'->'discovery') relation WHERE relation ? 'target_role' GROUP BY relation->>'target',relation->>'target_role' HAVING count(*)<>1)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'discovery target role differs from declared member/input contracts'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(WITH RECURSIVE edges(source,target) AS (
 SELECT selected->>'operation',dependency FROM jsonb_array_elements(p->'selection'->'operations') selected
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(selected->'dependencies') dependency),
 reach(source,target) AS (SELECT * FROM edges UNION SELECT reach.source,edges.target FROM reach JOIN edges ON edges.source=reach.target)
 SELECT FROM reach WHERE source=target) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'selected demand dependency cycle'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(WITH RECURSIVE roots(id) AS (
 SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(p->'selection'->'targets')
 UNION SELECT relation->>'producer' FROM jsonb_array_elements(p->'selection'->'discovery') relation),
 closure(id) AS (SELECT id FROM roots UNION SELECT dependency FROM closure
 JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(p->'selection'->'operations') selected ON selected->>'operation'=closure.id
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(selected->'dependencies') dependency),
 member_roots(id) AS (SELECT relation->>'target' FROM jsonb_array_elements(p->'selection'->'discovery') relation),
 member_closure(id) AS (SELECT id FROM member_roots UNION SELECT dependency FROM member_closure
 JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(p->'selection'->'operations') selected ON selected->>'operation'=member_closure.id
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(selected->'dependencies') dependency),
 root_expected(id) AS (SELECT id FROM closure WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM roots) OR id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM member_closure))
 SELECT id FROM root_expected FULL JOIN jsonb_array_elements_text(p->'selection'->'root_operations') declared(id) USING(id)
 WHERE root_expected.id IS NULL OR declared.id IS NULL)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'root operations differ from selected dependency closure'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(WITH RECURSIVE roots(id) AS (
 SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(p->'selection'->'targets')
 UNION SELECT relation->>'producer' FROM jsonb_array_elements(p->'selection'->'discovery') relation
 UNION SELECT relation->>'target' FROM jsonb_array_elements(p->'selection'->'discovery') relation),
 closure(id) AS (SELECT id FROM roots UNION SELECT dependency FROM closure
 JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(p->'selection'->'operations') selected ON selected->>'operation'=closure.id
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(selected->'dependencies') dependency)
 SELECT closure.id FROM closure FULL JOIN (SELECT selected->>'operation' id FROM jsonb_array_elements(p->'selection'->'operations') selected) declared USING(id)
 WHERE closure.id IS NULL OR declared.id IS NULL)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'selected operations differ from requested target/discovery closure'; END IF;
 PERFORM ops.ddo_validate_parameters(op,selected,convert_from(a.content,'UTF8')::jsonb)
 FROM sem.artifact a CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(convert_from(a.content,'UTF8')::jsonb->'operations') op
 JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(p->'selection'->'operations') selected ON selected->>'operation'=op->>'semantic_id'
 WHERE a.release_id=p->>'release_id' AND a.artifact_name='data_operations.json';
 PERFORM ops.ddo_authorize(kind.universe) FROM jsonb_array_elements(p->'selection'->'operations') selected JOIN sem.data_operation_definition operation ON operation.release_id=p->>'release_id' AND operation.operation_id=selected->>'operation' CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(operation.input_roles||operation.output_roles) role JOIN sem.data_kind_contract kind ON kind.kind_contract=role->>'kind_contract';
 IF p->>'strength'='independent' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'independent strength requires declared distinct-episode replicate obligations' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(p->'selection'->'operations') selected
 JOIN sem.data_operation_definition definition ON definition.release_id=p->>'release_id' AND definition.operation_id=selected->>'operation'
 WHERE selected->>'replicate'='' OR ops.ddo_replicate_required(definition.support_contract->>'replicate_policy')
 IS DISTINCT FROM (selected->>'replicate' IS NOT NULL)) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'replicate selection differs from declared operation policy' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF p->>'strength'='episode' AND EXISTS(SELECT FROM sem.data_operation_definition op
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(op.input_roles) role
 WHERE op.release_id=p->>'release_id' AND EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(p->'selection'->'operations') sel WHERE sel->>'operation'=op.operation_id)
 AND NOT (role->'identity_requirements' ? 'episode')) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'episode strength requires episode-qualified input contracts'; END IF;
 subject_scopes:=ops.ddo_release_subject_scopes(p->>'release_id');
 FOR root_context IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(p->'root') LOOP
 FOR selected_definition IN SELECT operation.* FROM sem.data_operation_definition operation
 WHERE operation.release_id=p->>'release_id' AND p->'selection'->'root_operations' ? operation.operation_id LOOP
 PERFORM ops.ddo_require_subject_source(subject_scopes,selected_definition.subject_definition,root_context->>'original_source');
 END LOOP; END LOOP;
 PERFORM ops.ddo_validate_source_sets(coalesce(p->'selection'->'source_sets','{}'),p->>'project_id',subject_scopes);
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_each(coalesce(p->'selection'->'source_sets','{}')) named WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(p->'selection'->'operations') selected JOIN sem.data_operation_definition def ON def.release_id=p->>'release_id' AND def.operation_id=selected->>'operation' CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(def.input_roles) roledef WHERE roledef->'support'->>'source_set'=named.key))
 OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(p->'selection'->'operations') selected JOIN sem.data_operation_definition def ON def.release_id=p->>'release_id' AND def.operation_id=selected->>'operation' CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(def.input_roles) roledef WHERE roledef->'support'->>'source_set' IS NOT NULL AND NOT coalesce(p->'selection'->'source_sets','{}') ? (roledef->'support'->>'source_set')) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'frozen source sets differ from admitted selected role policies'; END IF;
 PERFORM sem.require_runtime_binding(p->>'release_id',p->>'runtime_id');
 key:='demand:'||ops.ddo_digest(p);
 INSERT INTO ops.data_trust_scope(scope,project_id,epoch) SELECT DISTINCT ops.ddo_scope(p->>'project_id',root->>'original_source'),p->>'project_id',0 FROM (SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(p->'root') UNION ALL SELECT source_entry.value FROM jsonb_each(coalesce(p->'selection'->'source_sets','{}')) named CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(named.value) source_entry(value)) roots(root) ORDER BY 1 ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
 INSERT INTO ops.data_demand VALUES(key,p->>'project_id',p->>'release_id',p->>'runtime_id',p->'root',p->'selection',p->>'strength',clock_timestamp()) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT d FROM ops.data_demand WHERE id=key;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('payload',jsonb_build_object('demand_id',d.id,'selection',d.selection)||CASE WHEN ops.ddo_demand_active(d.id) THEN '{}'::jsonb ELSE jsonb_build_object('state','cancelled') END);
END

 FOR root_context IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(p->'root') LOOP
 FOR selected_definition IN SELECT operation.* FROM sem.data_operation_definition operation
 WHERE operation.release_id=p->>'release_id' AND p->'selection'->'root_operations' ? operation.operation_id LOOP
 PERFORM ops.ddo_require_subject_source(subject_scopes,selected_definition.subject_definition,root_context->>'original_source');
 END LOOP; END LOOP;
 PERFORM ops.ddo_validate_source_sets(coalesce(p->'selection'->'source_sets','{}'),p->>'project_id',subject_scopes);
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_each(coalesce(p->'selection'->'source_sets','{}')) named WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(p->'selection'->'operations') selected JOIN sem.data_operation_definition def ON def.release_id=p->>'release_id' AND def.operation_id=selected->>'operation' CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(def.input_roles) roledef WHERE roledef->'support'->>'source_set'=named.key))
 OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(p->'selection'->'operations') selected JOIN sem.data_operation_definition def ON def.release_id=p->>'release_id' AND def.operation_id=selected->>'operation' CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(def.input_roles) roledef WHERE roledef->'support'->>'source_set' IS NOT NULL AND NOT coalesce(p->'selection'->'source_sets','{}') ? (roledef->'support'->>'source_set')) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'frozen source sets differ from admitted selected role policies'; END IF;
 PERFORM sem.require_runtime_binding(p->>'release_id',p->>'runtime_id');
 key:='demand:'||ops.ddo_digest(p);
 INSERT INTO ops.data_trust_scope(scope,project_id,epoch) SELECT DISTINCT ops.ddo_scope(p->>'project_id',root->>'original_source'),p->>'project_id',0 FROM (SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(p->'root') UNION ALL SELECT source_entry.value FROM jsonb_each(coalesce(p->'selection'->'source_sets','{}')) named CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(named.value) source_entry(value)) roots(root) ORDER BY 1 ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
 INSERT INTO ops.data_demand VALUES(key,p->>'project_id',p->>'release_id',p->>'runtime_id',p->'root',p->'selection',p->>'strength',clock_timestamp()) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT d FROM ops.data_demand WHERE id=key;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('payload',jsonb_build_object('demand_id',d.id,'selection',d.selection)||CASE WHEN ops.ddo_demand_active(d.id) THEN '{}'::jsonb ELSE jsonb_build_object('state','cancelled') END);
END $$
