DECLARE p jsonb:=p_payload; d ops.data_demand; snapshot jsonb:='{}'; results jsonb; obligations jsonb; lim integer; after_key text; next_key text; more boolean; selected_view text; selected_max_bytes bigint; boundary ops.data_demand_read; scope_key text; epoch bigint;
BEGIN
 PERFORM ops.ddo_fields(p,ARRAY['demand_id'],ARRAY['selection','after','limit','trust_snapshot','read_id','read_snapshot','frontier_at','view','max_bytes','scope','support_after']);
 SELECT * INTO STRICT d FROM ops.data_demand WHERE id=p->>'demand_id';
 PERFORM ops.ddo_authorize(kind.universe) FROM jsonb_array_elements(d.selection->'operations') selected
 JOIN sem.data_operation_definition operation ON operation.release_id=d.release_id AND operation.operation_id=selected->>'operation'
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(operation.input_roles||operation.output_roles) role
 JOIN sem.data_kind_contract kind ON kind.kind_contract=role->>'kind_contract';
 IF (p ? 'selection' AND p->'selection' IS DISTINCT FROM d.selection) OR (p ? 'after' AND NOT (p ? 'read_id'))
 OR ((p ? 'read_snapshot' OR p ? 'frontier_at') AND NOT p ? 'read_id') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'demand read selection/snapshot pins are incomplete or differ'; END IF;
 selected_view:=coalesce(p->>'view','frontier');
 IF selected_view NOT IN ('frontier','products','support') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unknown demand read view'; END IF;
 selected_max_bytes:=coalesce((p->>'max_bytes')::bigint,8388608);
 IF selected_max_bytes NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 67108864 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid product page byte bound'; END IF;
 lim:=coalesce((p->>'limit')::integer,100); after_key:=coalesce(p->>'after','');
 IF lim NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1000 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid demand read bound'; END IF;
 -- Establish visibility before selecting structurally relevant support. A revoked
 -- support must still contribute its authority scope to the read's pinned closure.
 IF p ? 'read_id' THEN
 SELECT * INTO STRICT boundary FROM ops.data_demand_read WHERE id=p->>'read_id' AND demand_id=d.id;
 IF boundary.scope IS DISTINCT FROM coalesce(p->'scope','{}') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'read scope differs from its pinned acquisition'; END IF;
 ELSE
 boundary.id:='read:'||gen_random_uuid()::text; boundary.demand_id:=d.id;
 boundary.read_snapshot:=pg_current_snapshot()::text; boundary.frontier_at:=clock_timestamp();
 boundary.owner_xid:=pg_current_xact_id()::text;
 END IF;
 FOR scope_key IN WITH RECURSIVE source_entries AS 
(SELECT source_entry.value AS entry 
FROM jsonb_each(coalesce(d.selection['source_sets'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB))) AS source_set(key, value) JOIN jsonb_array_elements(source_set.value) AS source_entry(value) ON true), 
direct_sources AS 
(SELECT root.value ->> 'original_source' AS source 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(d.root) AS root(value) UNION SELECT source_entries.entry ->> 'original_source' AS anon_1 
FROM source_entries), 
selected_use_seeds AS 
(SELECT DISTINCT ON (ops.demand_use.obligation_id) ops.demand_use.obligation_id AS obligation_id, ops.demand_use.id AS id, ops.demand_use.fate AS fate 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE ops.demand_use.demand_id = d.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.demand_use.created_at, ops.demand_use.created_xid, boundary) ORDER BY ops.demand_use.obligation_id, ops.demand_use.created_at DESC, ops.demand_use.id DESC), 
support_seed AS 
(SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(selected_use_seeds.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM selected_use_seeds 
WHERE true UNION SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_population.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population 
WHERE ops.data_population.demand_id = d.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.data_population.created_at, ops.data_population.created_xid, boundary) UNION SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation JOIN ops.data_derivation_output ON ops.data_derivation_output.derivation_id = ops.data_derivation.id JOIN ops.demand_use ON ops.demand_use.derivation_id = ops.data_derivation.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = d.project_id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM source_entries 
WHERE (source_entries.entry ->> 'product') = ops.data_derivation_output.product_id)) AND ops.demand_use.fate = 'fulfilled' AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.demand_use.created_at, ops.demand_use.created_xid, boundary) UNION SELECT CAST('original' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.original_source_admission.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.original_source_admission 
WHERE ops.original_source_admission.demand_id = d.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.original_source_admission.created_at, ops.original_source_admission.created_xid, boundary)), 
support_closure(kind, id) AS 
(SELECT support_seed.kind AS kind, support_seed.id AS id 
FROM support_seed 
WHERE support_seed.id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT support_edge.kind AS kind, support_edge.id AS id 
FROM support_closure JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN (ops.data_derivation_support.admission_use_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(coalesce(ops.data_derivation_support.admission_use_id, ops.data_derivation_support.support_derivation_id) AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation_support 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation_support.derivation_id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('original' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_derivation_original_support.admission_id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation_original_support 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation_original_support.derivation_id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('episode' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.derivation_id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN 'original' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_id' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id' ELSE selected_support_reference.value ->> 'derivation_id' END AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ops.demand_use.selection['support'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS selected_support_reference(value) ON true 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND true UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_population.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ops.demand_use.selection['populations'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS selected_population_reference(value) ON true JOIN ops.data_population ON ops.data_population.id = (selected_population_reference.value ->> 'population_id') AND ops.data_population.demand_id = ops.demand_use.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND true UNION ALL SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population JOIN ops.demand_use ON ops.demand_use.id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'admission_use_id') AND ops.demand_use.derivation_id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'derivation_id') AND ops.demand_use.demand_id = ops.data_population.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST((ops.data_population.evidence['selection']) ->> 'parent_population_id' AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id) AS support_edge ON true 
WHERE support_edge.id IS NOT NULL), 
support_sources AS 
(SELECT direct_sources.source AS source 
FROM direct_sources UNION SELECT ops.data_request.original_source AS source 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.data_derivation ON support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = d.project_id UNION SELECT ops.original_source_admission.original_source AS source 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.original_source_admission ON support_closure.kind = 'original' AND ops.original_source_admission.id = support_closure.id 
WHERE ops.original_source_admission.project_id = d.project_id)
 SELECT ops.ddo_scope(d.project_id, support_sources.source) AS scope 
FROM support_sources UNION SELECT record_grade_scope.scope 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.data_derivation ON support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id JOIN ops.ddo_record_grade_dependency_scopes(ops.data_derivation.id) AS record_grade_scope(scope) ON true 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = d.project_id UNION SELECT record_fit_scope.scope 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.data_derivation ON support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id JOIN ops.ddo_record_fit_dependency_scopes(ops.data_derivation.id) AS record_fit_scope(scope) ON true 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = d.project_id UNION SELECT operation_event_scope.scope 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.data_derivation ON support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id JOIN ops.ddo_operation_event_dependency_scopes(ops.data_derivation.id) AS operation_event_scope(scope) ON true 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = d.project_id ORDER BY scope LOOP
 INSERT INTO ops.data_trust_scope(scope,project_id,epoch) VALUES(scope_key,d.project_id,0) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
 SELECT s.epoch INTO epoch FROM ops.data_trust_scope s WHERE s.scope=scope_key FOR SHARE;
 snapshot:=snapshot||jsonb_build_object(scope_key,epoch);
 END LOOP;
 snapshot:=ops.ddo_trust_snapshot_meaning(snapshot);
 IF p ? 'read_id' THEN
 IF ops.ddo_trust_snapshot_meaning(boundary.trust_snapshot) IS DISTINCT FROM snapshot
 OR (p ? 'read_snapshot' AND p->>'read_snapshot' IS DISTINCT FROM boundary.read_snapshot)
 OR (p ? 'frontier_at' AND (p->>'frontier_at')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM boundary.frontier_at) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'read acquisition pins or current trust differ'; END IF;
 ELSE
 INSERT INTO ops.data_demand_read(id,demand_id,read_snapshot,frontier_at,owner_xid,trust_snapshot,scope)
 VALUES(boundary.id,d.id,boundary.read_snapshot,boundary.frontier_at,boundary.owner_xid,snapshot,coalesce(p->'scope','{}')) RETURNING * INTO boundary;
 END IF;
 IF p ? 'trust_snapshot' AND ops.ddo_trust_snapshot_meaning(p->'trust_snapshot') IS DISTINCT FROM snapshot THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'trust snapshot changed; reacquire demand read'; END IF;
 PERFORM ops.ddo_authorize(k.universe) FROM ops.demand_use u JOIN ops.data_derivation_output outp ON outp.derivation_id=u.derivation_id JOIN kb.data_product x ON x.id=outp.product_id JOIN sem.data_kind_contract k ON k.kind_contract=x.kind_contract WHERE u.demand_id=d.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(u.created_at,u.created_xid,boundary);
 WITH RECURSIVE bounded AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT ops.data_obligation.id AS id, ops.data_obligation.demand_id AS demand_id, ops.data_obligation.operation_id AS operation_id, ops.data_obligation.subject AS subject, ops.data_obligation.original_source AS original_source, ops.data_obligation.analyzed_scope AS analyzed_scope, ops.data_obligation.parameters AS parameters, ops.data_obligation.created_at AS created_at, ops.data_obligation.created_xid AS created_xid 
FROM ops.data_obligation 
WHERE ops.data_obligation.demand_id = d.id AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'operation_id') OR ops.data_obligation.operation_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'operation_id')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'subject') OR ops.data_obligation.subject IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'subject')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'original_source') OR ops.data_obligation.original_source IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'original_source')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'product_ids') OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.demand_use AS scope_use JOIN ops.data_derivation_output ON ops.data_derivation_output.derivation_id = scope_use.derivation_id JOIN jsonb_array_elements_text((coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)))['product_ids']) AS scope_product(value) ON ops.data_derivation_output.product_id = scope_product.value 
WHERE scope_use.obligation_id = ops.data_obligation.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_use.created_at, scope_use.created_xid, boundary) AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.demand_use AS scope_later_use 
WHERE scope_later_use.obligation_id = scope_use.obligation_id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_later_use.created_at, scope_later_use.created_xid, boundary) AND (scope_later_use.created_at > scope_use.created_at OR scope_later_use.created_at = scope_use.created_at AND scope_later_use.id > scope_use.id))))) OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.original_source_admission AS scope_original JOIN jsonb_array_elements_text((coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)))['product_ids']) AS scope_product(value) ON scope_original.product_id = scope_product.value 
WHERE scope_original.demand_id = d.id AND scope_original.project_id = d.project_id AND scope_original.subject = ops.data_obligation.subject AND scope_original.original_source IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ops.data_obligation.original_source AND scope_original.analyzed_scope = ops.data_obligation.analyzed_scope AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_original.created_at, scope_original.created_xid, boundary)))) AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.data_obligation.created_at, ops.data_obligation.created_xid, boundary) AND ops.data_obligation.id > after_key ORDER BY ops.data_obligation.id 
 LIMIT lim),

WHERE kb.data_product.id = selected_body_product.value))) <= selected_max_bytes ELSE true END THEN jsonb_build_object('payload', jsonb_build_object('demand_id', d.id, 'project_id', d.project_id, 'release_id', d.release_id, 'runtime_id', d.runtime_id, 'selection', d.selection, 'trust_snapshot', boundary.trust_snapshot, 'read_id', boundary.id, 'read_snapshot', boundary.read_snapshot, 'frontier_at', boundary.frontier_at, 'scope', boundary.scope, 'view', selected_view, 'intent', d.selection, 'root', d.root, 'state', CASE WHEN (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.data_demand_cancellation 
WHERE ops.data_demand_cancellation.demand_id = d.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.data_demand_cancellation.created_at, ops.data_demand_cancellation.created_xid, boundary))) THEN 'cancelled' ELSE 'active' END, 'uses', (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('use_id', selected_uses.id, 'obligation_id', selected_uses.obligation_id, 'fate', CASE WHEN (selected_uses.fate = 'fulfilled' AND ops.ddo_use_valid(selected_uses, boundary) = false) THEN 'unavailable' WHEN (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.data_external_packet JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_external_packet.request_id AND ops.data_request.generation = ops.data_external_packet.generation AND ops.data_request.live_task_id = ops.data_external_packet.task_id 
WHERE selected_uses.fate = 'attached' AND ops.data_external_packet.request_id = selected_uses.request_id AND ops.data_external_packet.generation = selected_uses.generation AND ops.ddo_request_useful(data_request) AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.data_external_receipt 
WHERE ops.data_external_receipt.packet_id = ops.data_external_packet.id)))) THEN 'awaiting-external' ELSE selected_uses.fate END, 'historical_fate', selected_uses.fate, 'semantic_outcome', (SELECT ops.data_completion_intent.payload['outcome'] AS anon_1 
FROM ops.data_derivation JOIN ops.data_completion_intent ON ops.data_completion_intent.id = ops.data_derivation.intent_id 
WHERE ops.data_derivation.id = selected_uses.derivation_id), 'completion_state', (SELECT ops.data_derivation.outcome 
FROM ops.data_derivation 
WHERE ops.data_derivation.id = selected_uses.derivation_id), 'request_id', selected_uses.request_id, 'generation', selected_uses.generation, 'derivation_id', selected_uses.derivation_id, 'rebind_derivation', CASE WHEN (selected_uses.fate = 'fulfilled' AND ops.ddo_use_valid(selected_uses, boundary) = false AND ops.ddo_direct_support_valid(selected_uses.derivation_id) AND d.strength = 'value' AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.data_request JOIN sem.data_operation_definition ON sem.data_operation_definition.release_id = d.release_id AND sem.data_operation_definition.operation_id = ops.data_request.operation_id 
WHERE ops.data_request.id = selected_uses.request_id AND (sem.data_operation_definition.support_contract ->> 'provenance') = 'value_substitution' AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(sem.data_operation_definition.input_roles) AS required_identity_role(value) 
WHERE coalesce(required_identity_role.value['identity_requirements'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB)) != CAST('[]' AS JSONB)))))) THEN selected_uses.derivation_id ELSE NULL END, 'selection', selected_uses.selection, 'trust_snapshot', selected_uses.trust_snapshot, 'products', (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('role', ops.data_derivation_output.role, 'position', ops.data_derivation_output.position, 'multiplicity', ops.data_derivation_output.multiplicity, 'product_id', ops.data_derivation_output.product_id, 'member_id', ops.data_derivation_output.member_id, 'kind_contract', kb.data_product.kind_contract, 'subject', kb.data_product.subject, 'subject_definition', kb.data_product.subject_definition, 'original_source', kb.data_product.original_source, 'analyzed_scope', kb.data_product.analyzed_scope, 'body_state', CASE WHEN (selected_view = 'products') THEN 'present' ELSE 'not_requested' END) || CASE WHEN (selected_view = 'products') THEN jsonb_build_object('body', kb.data_product.canonical_body) ELSE CAST('{}' AS JSONB) END ORDER BY ops.data_derivation_output.role, ops.data_derivation_output.position), CAST('[]' AS JSONB)) AS coalesce_3 
FROM ops.data_derivation_output JOIN kb.data_product ON kb.data_product.id = ops.data_derivation_output.product_id 
WHERE ops.data_derivation_output.derivation_id = selected_uses.derivation_id AND CASE WHEN (selected_view = 'products') THEN CASE WHEN (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'product_ids') OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM jsonb_array_elements_text((coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)))['product_ids']) AS selected_body_product(value) 
WHERE kb.data_product.id = selected_body_product.value))) THEN ops.ddo_body_access(kb.data_product.kind_contract, kb.data_product.canonical_body) ELSE false END ELSE true END)) ORDER BY selected_uses.obligation_id), CAST('[]' AS JSONB)) AS coalesce_2 
FROM selected_uses), 'obligations', (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(((to_jsonb(bounded) - 'created_at') - 'created_xid') || jsonb_build_object('obligation_id', bounded.id, 'subject_definition', (SELECT sem.data_operation_definition.subject_definition 
FROM sem.data_operation_definition 
WHERE sem.data_operation_definition.release_id = d.release_id AND sem.data_operation_definition.operation_id = bounded.operation_id), 'historical_fate', latest.fate, 'fate', CASE WHEN (latest.fate = 'fulfilled' AND ops.ddo_use_valid(latest, boundary) = false) THEN 'unavailable' WHEN (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.data_external_packet JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_external_packet.request_id AND ops.data_request.generation = ops.data_external_packet.generation AND ops.data_request.live_task_id = ops.data_external_packet.task_id 
WHERE latest.fate = 'attached' AND ops.data_external_packet.request_id = latest.request_id AND ops.data_external_packet.generation = latest.generation AND ops.ddo_request_useful(data_request) AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.data_external_receipt 
WHERE ops.data_external_receipt.packet_id = ops.data_external_packet.id)))) THEN 'awaiting-external' ELSE coalesce(latest.fate, 'waiting') END, 'request_id', latest.request_id, 'generation', latest.generation, 'intent_id', (SELECT ops.data_completion_intent.id 
FROM ops.data_completion_intent 
WHERE ops.data_completion_intent.request_id = latest.request_id AND ops.data_completion_intent.generation = latest.generation ORDER BY ops.data_completion_intent.created_at DESC, ops.data_completion_intent.id DESC 
 LIMIT 1)) ORDER BY bounded.id), CAST('[]' AS JSONB)) AS coalesce_4 
FROM bounded LEFT OUTER JOIN LATERAL (SELECT ops.demand_use.id AS id, ops.demand_use.demand_id AS demand_id, ops.demand_use.obligation_id AS obligation_id, ops.demand_use.fate AS fate, ops.demand_use.request_id AS request_id, ops.demand_use.generation AS generation, ops.demand_use.derivation_id AS derivation_id, ops.demand_use.selection AS selection, ops.demand_use.trust_snapshot AS trust_snapshot, ops.demand_use.created_at AS created_at, ops.demand_use.created_xid AS created_xid 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE ops.demand_use.obligation_id = bounded.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.demand_use.created_at, ops.demand_use.created_xid, boundary) ORDER BY ops.demand_use.created_at DESC, ops.demand_use.id DESC 
 LIMIT 1) AS latest ON true), 'original_source_admissions', (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('admission_id', ops.original_source_admission.id, 'selection_name', ops.original_source_admission.selection_name, 'product_id', ops.original_source_admission.product_id, 'kind_contract', kb.data_product.kind_contract, 'subject', ops.original_source_admission.subject, 'subject_definition', kb.data_product.subject_definition, 'original_source', ops.original_source_admission.original_source, 'analyzed_scope', ops.original_source_admission.analyzed_scope, 'source_reference', ops.original_source_admission.source_reference, 'trust_snapshot', ops.original_source_admission.trust_snapshot, 'evidence', ops.original_source_admission.evidence) ORDER BY ops.original_source_admission.id), CAST('[]' AS JSONB)) AS coalesce_5 
FROM ops.original_source_admission JOIN kb.data_product ON kb.data_product.id = ops.original_source_admission.product_id 
WHERE ops.original_source_admission.demand_id = d.id AND ops.ddo_original_admission_valid(original_source_admission, boundary) AND ops.ddo_kind_access(kb.data_product.kind_contract) AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM bounded 
WHERE bounded.subject = ops.original_source_admission.subject AND bounded.original_source IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ops.original_source_admission.original_source AND bounded.analyzed_scope = ops.original_source_admission.analyzed_scope))), 'support_page', CASE WHEN (selected_view = 'support') THEN CASE WHEN (SELECT coalesce(bool_and(ops.ddo_body_access(kb.data_product.kind_contract, kb.data_product.canonical_body)), true) AS coalesce_6 
FROM kb.data_product 
WHERE kb.data_product.id IN (SELECT export_products.product_id 
FROM export_products)) THEN CASE WHEN ((SELECT coalesce(sum(octet_length(CAST(support_export_page.record AS TEXT))), 0) AS coalesce_7 
FROM support_export_page) <= selected_max_bytes) THEN jsonb_build_object('records', (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('key', support_export_page.key, 'relation', support_export_page.relation, 'record', support_export_page.record) ORDER BY support_export_page.key), CAST('[]' AS JSONB)) AS coalesce_8 
FROM support_export_page), 'after', CASE WHEN ((SELECT count(*) AS count_1 
FROM support_export_bounded) > lim) THEN (SELECT max(support_export_page.key) AS max_1 
FROM support_export_page) ELSE NULL END, 'complete', (SELECT count(*) AS count_1 
FROM support_export_bounded) <= lim) ELSE ops.ddo_result_bytes_refusal() END ELSE ops.ddo_result_bytes_refusal() END ELSE NULL END, 'attempt_failures', (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('failure_id', ops.data_attempt_failure.id, 'request_id', ops.data_attempt_failure.request_id, 'generation', ops.data_attempt_failure.generation, 'task_id', ops.data_attempt_failure.task_id, 'attempt', ops.data_attempt_failure.attempt, 'holder', ops.data_attempt_failure.holder, 'failure', CASE WHEN ((ops.data_attempt_failure.failure ? 'd1_limitation') AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.data_request JOIN jsonb_array_elements(ops.data_request.binding['inputs']) AS failure_input(value) ON true JOIN kb.data_product ON kb.data_product.id = (failure_input.value ->> 'product_id') LEFT OUTER JOIN kb.data_product_member AS failure_member ON failure_member.product_id = kb.data_product.id AND failure_member.member_id = (failure_input.value ->> 'member_id') 
WHERE ops.data_request.id = ops.data_attempt_failure.request_id AND NOT ops.ddo_kind_access(coalesce(failure_member.kind_contract, kb.data_product.kind_contract))))) THEN (ops.data_attempt_failure.failure - 'd1_limitation') || jsonb_build_object('d1_limitation_disclosure', 'undisclosed') ELSE ops.data_attempt_failure.failure END) ORDER BY ops.data_attempt_failure.request_id, ops.data_attempt_failure.generation, ops.data_attempt_failure.attempt), CAST('[]' AS JSONB)) AS coalesce_9 
FROM ops.data_attempt_failure 
WHERE (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM selected_uses 
WHERE selected_uses.request_id = ops.data_attempt_failure.request_id AND selected_uses.generation = ops.data_attempt_failure.generation)) AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.data_attempt_failure.created_at, ops.data_attempt_failure.created_xid, boundary)), 'populations', (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg((((to_jsonb(data_population) - 'created_at') - 'created_xid') - 'selected_obligation_id') || jsonb_build_object('population_id', ops.data_population.id, 'evidence', ops.data_population.evidence || jsonb_build_object('producer_context', ops.ddo_population_producer_context(data_population))) ORDER BY ops.data_population.name), CAST('[]' AS JSONB)) AS coalesce_10 
FROM ops.data_population 
WHERE ops.data_population.demand_id = d.id AND (ops.data_population.selected_obligation_id IS NULL OR ops.data_population.selected_obligation_id IN (SELECT bounded.id 
FROM bounded)) AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.data_population.created_at, ops.data_population.created_xid, boundary) AND ops.ddo_population_valid(data_population, boundary)), 'continuation', CASE WHEN ((SELECT max(bounded.id) AS max_2 
FROM bounded) IS NOT NULL AND (EXISTS (SELECT ops.data_obligation.id, ops.data_obligation.demand_id, ops.data_obligation.operation_id, ops.data_obligation.subject, ops.data_obligation.original_source, ops.data_obligation.analyzed_scope, ops.data_obligation.parameters, ops.data_obligation.created_at, ops.data_obligation.created_xid 
FROM ops.data_obligation 
WHERE ops.data_obligation.demand_id = d.id AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'operation_id') OR ops.data_obligation.operation_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'operation_id')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'subject') OR ops.data_obligation.subject IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'subject')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'original_source') OR ops.data_obligation.original_source IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'original_source')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'product_ids') OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.demand_use AS scope_use JOIN ops.data_derivation_output ON ops.data_derivation_output.derivation_id = scope_use.derivation_id JOIN jsonb_array_elements_text((coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)))['product_ids']) AS scope_product(value) ON ops.data_derivation_output.product_id = scope_product.value 
WHERE scope_use.obligation_id = ops.data_obligation.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_use.created_at, scope_use.created_xid, boundary) AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.demand_use AS scope_later_use 
WHERE scope_later_use.obligation_id = scope_use.obligation_id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_later_use.created_at, scope_later_use.created_xid, boundary) AND (scope_later_use.created_at > scope_use.created_at OR scope_later_use.created_at = scope_use.created_at AND scope_later_use.id > scope_use.id))))) OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.original_source_admission AS scope_original JOIN jsonb_array_elements_text((coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)))['product_ids']) AS scope_product(value) ON scope_original.product_id = scope_product.value 
WHERE scope_original.demand_id = d.id AND scope_original.project_id = d.project_id AND scope_original.subject = ops.data_obligation.subject AND scope_original.original_source IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ops.data_obligation.original_source AND scope_original.analyzed_scope = ops.data_obligation.analyzed_scope AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_original.created_at, scope_original.created_xid, boundary)))) AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.data_obligation.created_at, ops.data_obligation.created_xid, boundary) AND ops.data_obligation.id > (SELECT max(bounded.id) AS max_2 
FROM bounded)))) THEN jsonb_build_object('demand_id', d.id, 'scope', boundary.scope, 'selection', d.selection, 'trust_snapshot', boundary.trust_snapshot, 'read_id', boundary.id, 'read_snapshot', boundary.read_snapshot, 'frontier_at', boundary.frontier_at, 'view', selected_view, 'after', (SELECT max(bounded.id) AS max_2 
FROM bounded), 'limit', lim, 'max_bytes', selected_max_bytes) ELSE NULL END)) ELSE ops.ddo_result_bytes_refusal() END AS result INTO results;
 IF selected_view IN ('products','support') AND octet_length(data.canonical_json(results))>selected_max_bytes THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete native product page envelope exceeds max_bytes; reduce the page limit'; END IF;
 RETURN results;
END

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ops.ddo_impl_read_demand_result(p_payload jsonb) RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp' AS $$
DECLARE p jsonb:=p_payload; d ops.data_demand; snapshot jsonb:='{}'; results jsonb; obligations jsonb; lim integer; after_key text; next_key text; more boolean; selected_view text; selected_max_bytes bigint; boundary ops.data_demand_read; scope_key text; epoch bigint;
BEGIN
 PERFORM ops.ddo_fields(p,ARRAY['demand_id'],ARRAY['selection','after','limit','trust_snapshot','read_id','read_snapshot','frontier_at','view','max_bytes','scope','support_after']);
 SELECT * INTO STRICT d FROM ops.data_demand WHERE id=p->>'demand_id';
 PERFORM ops.ddo_authorize(kind.universe) FROM jsonb_array_elements(d.selection->'operations') selected
 JOIN sem.data_operation_definition operation ON operation.release_id=d.release_id AND operation.operation_id=selected->>'operation'
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(operation.input_roles||operation.output_roles) role
 JOIN sem.data_kind_contract kind ON kind.kind_contract=role->>'kind_contract';
 IF (p ? 'selection' AND p->'selection' IS DISTINCT FROM d.selection) OR (p ? 'after' AND NOT (p ? 'read_id'))
 OR ((p ? 'read_snapshot' OR p ? 'frontier_at') AND NOT p ? 'read_id') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'demand read selection/snapshot pins are incomplete or differ'; END IF;
 selected_view:=coalesce(p->>'view','frontier');
 IF selected_view NOT IN ('frontier','products','support') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unknown demand read view'; END IF;
 selected_max_bytes:=coalesce((p->>'max_bytes')::bigint,8388608);
 IF selected_max_bytes NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 67108864 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid product page byte bound'; END IF;
 lim:=coalesce((p->>'limit')::integer,100); after_key:=coalesce(p->>'after','');
 IF lim NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1000 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid demand read bound'; END IF;
 -- Establish visibility before selecting structurally relevant support. A revoked
 -- support must still contribute its authority scope to the read's pinned closure.
 IF p ? 'read_id' THEN
 SELECT * INTO STRICT boundary FROM ops.data_demand_read WHERE id=p->>'read_id' AND demand_id=d.id;
 IF boundary.scope IS DISTINCT FROM coalesce(p->'scope','{}') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'read scope differs from its pinned acquisition'; END IF;
 ELSE
 boundary.id:='read:'||gen_random_uuid()::text; boundary.demand_id:=d.id;
 boundary.read_snapshot:=pg_current_snapshot()::text; boundary.frontier_at:=clock_timestamp();
 boundary.owner_xid:=pg_current_xact_id()::text;
 END IF;
 FOR scope_key IN WITH RECURSIVE source_entries AS 
(SELECT source_entry.value AS entry 
FROM jsonb_each(coalesce(d.selection['source_sets'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB))) AS source_set(key, value) JOIN jsonb_array_elements(source_set.value) AS source_entry(value) ON true), 
direct_sources AS 
(SELECT root.value ->> 'original_source' AS source 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(d.root) AS root(value) UNION SELECT source_entries.entry ->> 'original_source' AS anon_1 
FROM source_entries), 
selected_use_seeds AS 
(SELECT DISTINCT ON (ops.demand_use.obligation_id) ops.demand_use.obligation_id AS obligation_id, ops.demand_use.id AS id, ops.demand_use.fate AS fate 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE ops.demand_use.demand_id = d.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.demand_use.created_at, ops.demand_use.created_xid, boundary) ORDER BY ops.demand_use.obligation_id, ops.demand_use.created_at DESC, ops.demand_use.id DESC), 
support_seed AS 
(SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(selected_use_seeds.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM selected_use_seeds 
WHERE true UNION SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_population.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population 
WHERE ops.data_population.demand_id = d.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.data_population.created_at, ops.data_population.created_xid, boundary) UNION SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation JOIN ops.data_derivation_output ON ops.data_derivation_output.derivation_id = ops.data_derivation.id JOIN ops.demand_use ON ops.demand_use.derivation_id = ops.data_derivation.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = d.project_id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM source_entries 
WHERE (source_entries.entry ->> 'product') = ops.data_derivation_output.product_id)) AND ops.demand_use.fate = 'fulfilled' AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.demand_use.created_at, ops.demand_use.created_xid, boundary) UNION SELECT CAST('original' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.original_source_admission.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.original_source_admission 
WHERE ops.original_source_admission.demand_id = d.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.original_source_admission.created_at, ops.original_source_admission.created_xid, boundary)), 
support_closure(kind, id) AS 
(SELECT support_seed.kind AS kind, support_seed.id AS id 
FROM support_seed 
WHERE support_seed.id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT support_edge.kind AS kind, support_edge.id AS id 
FROM support_closure JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN (ops.data_derivation_support.admission_use_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(coalesce(ops.data_derivation_support.admission_use_id, ops.data_derivation_support.support_derivation_id) AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation_support 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation_support.derivation_id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('original' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_derivation_original_support.admission_id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation_original_support 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation_original_support.derivation_id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('episode' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.derivation_id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN 'original' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_id' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id' ELSE selected_support_reference.value ->> 'derivation_id' END AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ops.demand_use.selection['support'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS selected_support_reference(value) ON true 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND true UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_population.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ops.demand_use.selection['populations'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS selected_population_reference(value) ON true JOIN ops.data_population ON ops.data_population.id = (selected_population_reference.value ->> 'population_id') AND ops.data_population.demand_id = ops.demand_use.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND true UNION ALL SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population JOIN ops.demand_use ON ops.demand_use.id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'admission_use_id') AND ops.demand_use.derivation_id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'derivation_id') AND ops.demand_use.demand_id = ops.data_population.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST((ops.data_population.evidence['selection']) ->> 'parent_population_id' AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id) AS support_edge ON true 
WHERE support_edge.id IS NOT NULL), 
support_sources AS 
(SELECT direct_sources.source AS source 
FROM direct_sources UNION SELECT ops.data_request.original_source AS source 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.data_derivation ON support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = d.project_id UNION SELECT ops.original_source_admission.original_source AS source 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.original_source_admission ON support_closure.kind = 'original' AND ops.original_source_admission.id = support_closure.id 
WHERE ops.original_source_admission.project_id = d.project_id)
 SELECT ops.ddo_scope(d.project_id, support_sources.source) AS scope 
FROM support_sources UNION SELECT record_grade_scope.scope 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.data_derivation ON support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id JOIN ops.ddo_record_grade_dependency_scopes(ops.data_derivation.id) AS record_grade_scope(scope) ON true 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = d.project_id UNION SELECT record_fit_scope.scope

FROM scoped_obligations JOIN LATERAL (SELECT ops.demand_use.id AS id, ops.demand_use.demand_id AS demand_id, ops.demand_use.obligation_id AS obligation_id, ops.demand_use.fate AS fate, ops.demand_use.request_id AS request_id, ops.demand_use.generation AS generation, ops.demand_use.derivation_id AS derivation_id, ops.demand_use.selection AS selection, ops.demand_use.trust_snapshot AS trust_snapshot, ops.demand_use.created_at AS created_at, ops.demand_use.created_xid AS created_xid 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE ops.demand_use.obligation_id = scoped_obligations.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.demand_use.created_at, ops.demand_use.created_xid, boundary) ORDER BY ops.demand_use.created_at DESC, ops.demand_use.id DESC 
 LIMIT 1) AS latest ON true), 
selected_output_seed AS 
(SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(selected_uses.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM selected_uses 
WHERE selected_uses.id = p_use AND selected_uses.fate = 'fulfilled' AND ops.ddo_use_valid(selected_uses, boundary)), 
support_closure(kind, id) AS 
(SELECT selected_output_seed.kind AS kind, selected_output_seed.id AS id 
FROM selected_output_seed 
WHERE selected_output_seed.id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT support_edge.kind AS kind, support_edge.id AS id 
FROM support_closure JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN (ops.data_derivation_support.admission_use_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(coalesce(ops.data_derivation_support.admission_use_id, ops.data_derivation_support.support_derivation_id) AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation_support 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation_support.derivation_id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('original' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_derivation_original_support.admission_id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation_original_support 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation_original_support.derivation_id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('episode' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.derivation_id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN 'original' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_id' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id' ELSE selected_support_reference.value ->> 'derivation_id' END AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ops.demand_use.selection['support'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS selected_support_reference(value) ON true 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND true UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_population.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ops.demand_use.selection['populations'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS selected_population_reference(value) ON true JOIN ops.data_population ON ops.data_population.id = (selected_population_reference.value ->> 'population_id') AND ops.data_population.demand_id = ops.demand_use.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND true UNION ALL SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population JOIN ops.demand_use ON ops.demand_use.id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'admission_use_id') AND ops.demand_use.derivation_id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'derivation_id') AND ops.demand_use.demand_id = ops.data_population.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST((ops.data_population.evidence['selection']) ->> 'parent_population_id' AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id) AS support_edge ON true 
WHERE support_edge.id IS NOT NULL), 
selected_whole_outputs AS 
(SELECT DISTINCT ops.data_derivation.id AS derivation_id, ops.data_derivation_output.product_id AS product_id 
FROM ops.data_derivation JOIN ops.data_derivation_output ON ops.data_derivation_output.derivation_id = ops.data_derivation.id JOIN kb.data_product ON kb.data_product.id = ops.data_derivation_output.product_id 
WHERE (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM support_closure 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id)) AND ops.data_derivation_output.member_id IS NULL AND kb.data_product.project_id = d.project_id AND ops.ddo_support_valid(ops.data_derivation.id, boundary) AND ops.ddo_kind_access(kb.data_product.kind_contract) AND ops.ddo_body_access(kb.data_product.kind_contract, kb.data_product.canonical_body))
 SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM selected_whole_outputs 
WHERE selected_whole_outputs.derivation_id = p_derivation AND selected_whole_outputs.product_id = p_product) AS anon_1 INTO admitted;
 IF NOT coalesce(admitted,false) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'output is outside current pinned selected support' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('demand_id', d.id, 'project_id', d.project_id, 'release_id', d.release_id, 'runtime_id', d.runtime_id, 'selection', d.selection, 'trust_snapshot', boundary.trust_snapshot, 'read_id', boundary.id, 'read_snapshot', boundary.read_snapshot, 'frontier_at', boundary.frontier_at, 'scope', boundary.scope) AS jsonb_build_object_1 INTO cut;
 RETURN cut;
END

-- Protected families can inspect an exact retained effect only through an
-- already pinned current read and the same selected-support closure as serving.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ops.ddo_require_selected_output(
 p_demand text,p_read text,p_use text,p_product text,p_derivation text) RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=pg_catalog,pg_temp AS $$
DECLARE d ops.data_demand; boundary ops.data_demand_read; p jsonb; admitted boolean; cut jsonb;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO STRICT d FROM ops.data_demand WHERE id=p_demand;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT boundary FROM ops.data_demand_read WHERE id=p_read AND demand_id=d.id;
 p:=jsonb_build_object('demand_id',d.id,'read_id',boundary.id,'scope',boundary.scope,
 'view','frontier','limit',1,'trust_snapshot',boundary.trust_snapshot,
 'read_snapshot',boundary.read_snapshot,'frontier_at',boundary.frontier_at);
 -- Reacquire current purpose, visibility and trust locks at the owning boundary.
 PERFORM ops.read_demand_result(p);
 WITH RECURSIVE scoped_obligations AS 
(SELECT ops.data_obligation.id AS id, ops.data_obligation.demand_id AS demand_id, ops.data_obligation.operation_id AS operation_id, ops.data_obligation.subject AS subject, ops.data_obligation.original_source AS original_source, ops.data_obligation.analyzed_scope AS analyzed_scope, ops.data_obligation.parameters AS parameters, ops.data_obligation.created_at AS created_at, ops.data_obligation.created_xid AS created_xid 
FROM ops.data_obligation 
WHERE ops.data_obligation.demand_id = d.id AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'operation_id') OR ops.data_obligation.operation_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'operation_id')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'subject') OR ops.data_obligation.subject IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'subject')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'original_source') OR ops.data_obligation.original_source IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'original_source')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'product_ids') OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.demand_use AS scope_use JOIN ops.data_derivation_output ON ops.data_derivation_output.derivation_id = scope_use.derivation_id JOIN jsonb_array_elements_text((coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)))['product_ids']) AS scope_product(value) ON ops.data_derivation_output.product_id = scope_product.value 
WHERE scope_use.obligation_id = ops.data_obligation.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_use.created_at, scope_use.created_xid, boundary) AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.demand_use AS scope_later_use 
WHERE scope_later_use.obligation_id = scope_use.obligation_id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_later_use.created_at, scope_later_use.created_xid, boundary) AND (scope_later_use.created_at > scope_use.created_at OR scope_later_use.created_at = scope_use.created_at AND scope_later_use.id > scope_use.id))))) OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.original_source_admission AS scope_original JOIN jsonb_array_elements_text((coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)))['product_ids']) AS scope_product(value) ON scope_original.product_id = scope_product.value 
WHERE scope_original.demand_id = d.id AND scope_original.project_id = d.project_id AND scope_original.subject = ops.data_obligation.subject AND scope_original.original_source IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ops.data_obligation.original_source AND scope_original.analyzed_scope = ops.data_obligation.analyzed_scope AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_original.created_at, scope_original.created_xid, boundary)))) AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.data_obligation.created_at, ops.data_obligation.created_xid, boundary)), 
selected_uses AS 
(SELECT latest.id AS id, latest.demand_id AS demand_id, latest.obligation_id AS obligation_id, latest.fate AS fate, latest.request_id AS request_id, latest.generation AS generation, latest.derivation_id AS derivation_id, latest.selection AS selection, latest.trust_snapshot AS trust_snapshot, latest.created_at AS created_at, latest.created_xid AS created_xid 
FROM scoped_obligations JOIN LATERAL (SELECT ops.demand_use.id AS id, ops.demand_use.demand_id AS demand_id, ops.demand_use.obligation_id AS obligation_id, ops.demand_use.fate AS fate, ops.demand_use.request_id AS request_id, ops.demand_use.generation AS generation, ops.demand_use.derivation_id AS derivation_id, ops.demand_use.selection AS selection, ops.demand_use.trust_snapshot AS trust_snapshot, ops.demand_use.created_at AS created_at, ops.demand_use.created_xid AS created_xid 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE ops.demand_use.obligation_id = scoped_obligations.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.demand_use.created_at, ops.demand_use.created_xid, boundary) ORDER BY ops.demand_use.created_at DESC, ops.demand_use.id DESC 
 LIMIT 1) AS latest ON true), 
selected_output_seed AS 
(SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(selected_uses.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM selected_uses 
WHERE selected_uses.id = p_use AND selected_uses.fate = 'fulfilled' AND ops.ddo_use_valid(selected_uses, boundary)), 
support_closure(kind, id) AS 
(SELECT selected_output_seed.kind AS kind, selected_output_seed.id AS id 
FROM selected_output_seed 
WHERE selected_output_seed.id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT support_edge.kind AS kind, support_edge.id AS id 
FROM support_closure JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN (ops.data_derivation_support.admission_use_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(coalesce(ops.data_derivation_support.admission_use_id, ops.data_derivation_support.support_derivation_id) AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation_support 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation_support.derivation_id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('original' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_derivation_original_support.admission_id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation_original_support 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation_original_support.derivation_id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('episode' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.derivation_id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN 'original' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_id' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id' ELSE selected_support_reference.value ->> 'derivation_id' END AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ops.demand_use.selection['support'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS selected_support_reference(value) ON true 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND true UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_population.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ops.demand_use.selection['populations'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS selected_population_reference(value) ON true JOIN ops.data_population ON ops.data_population.id = (selected_population_reference.value ->> 'population_id') AND ops.data_population.demand_id = ops.demand_use.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND true UNION ALL SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population JOIN ops.demand_use ON ops.demand_use.id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'admission_use_id') AND ops.demand_use.derivation_id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'derivation_id') AND ops.demand_use.demand_id = ops.data_population.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST((ops.data_population.evidence['selection']) ->> 'parent_population_id' AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id) AS support_edge ON true 
WHERE support_edge.id IS NOT NULL), 
selected_whole_outputs AS 
(SELECT DISTINCT ops.data_derivation.id AS derivation_id, ops.data_derivation_output.product_id AS product_id 
FROM ops.data_derivation JOIN ops.data_derivation_output ON ops.data_derivation_output.derivation_id = ops.data_derivation.id JOIN kb.data_product ON kb.data_product.id = ops.data_derivation_output.product_id 
WHERE (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM support_closure 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id)) AND ops.data_derivation_output.member_id IS NULL AND kb.data_product.project_id = d.project_id AND ops.ddo_support_valid(ops.data_derivation.id, boundary) AND ops.ddo_kind_access(kb.data_product.kind_contract) AND ops.ddo_body_access(kb.data_product.kind_contract, kb.data_product.canonical_body))
 SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM selected_whole_outputs 
WHERE selected_whole_outputs.derivation_id = p_derivation AND selected_whole_outputs.product_id = p_product) AS anon_1 INTO admitted;
 IF NOT coalesce(admitted,false) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'output is outside current pinned selected support' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('demand_id', d.id, 'project_id', d.project_id, 'release_id', d.release_id, 'runtime_id', d.runtime_id, 'selection', d.selection, 'trust_snapshot', boundary.trust_snapshot, 'read_id', boundary.id, 'read_snapshot', boundary.read_snapshot, 'frontier_at', boundary.frontier_at, 'scope', boundary.scope) AS jsonb_build_object_1 INTO cut;
 RETURN cut;
END $$

DECLARE d ops.data_demand; snapshot jsonb; boundary ops.data_demand_read;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO STRICT d FROM ops.data_demand WHERE id=p_demand;
 IF p_read IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'binding requires exact native read acquisition'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT boundary FROM ops.data_demand_read WHERE id=p_read AND demand_id=d.id;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(d.selection->'operations') selected WHERE selected->>'operation'=p_operation) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'projection operation outside frozen demand'; END IF;
 IF p_source IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF jsonb_typeof(p_source) NOT IN ('string','null') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'source filter requires JSON string or explicit null' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 PERFORM ops.ddo_require_subject_source(ops.ddo_release_subject_scopes(d.release_id),ops.ddo_operation_subject(d.release_id,p_operation),p_source#>>'{}');
 END IF;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(scope.scope,scope.epoch),'{}') INTO snapshot FROM ops.data_trust_scope scope JOIN (WITH RECURSIVE source_entries AS 
(SELECT source_entry.value AS entry 
FROM jsonb_each(coalesce(d.selection['source_sets'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB))) AS source_set(key, value) JOIN jsonb_array_elements(source_set.value) AS source_entry(value) ON true), 
direct_sources AS 
(SELECT root.value ->> 'original_source' AS source 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(d.root) AS root(value) UNION SELECT source_entries.entry ->> 'original_source' AS anon_1 
FROM source_entries), 
selected_use_seeds AS 
(SELECT DISTINCT ON (ops.demand_use.obligation_id) ops.demand_use.obligation_id AS obligation_id, ops.demand_use.id AS id, ops.demand_use.fate AS fate 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE ops.demand_use.demand_id = d.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.demand_use.created_at, ops.demand_use.created_xid, boundary) ORDER BY ops.demand_use.obligation_id, ops.demand_use.created_at DESC, ops.demand_use.id DESC), 
support_seed AS 
(SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(selected_use_seeds.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM selected_use_seeds 
WHERE true UNION SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_population.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population 
WHERE ops.data_population.demand_id = d.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.data_population.created_at, ops.data_population.created_xid, boundary) UNION SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation JOIN ops.data_derivation_output ON ops.data_derivation_output.derivation_id = ops.data_derivation.id JOIN ops.demand_use ON ops.demand_use.derivation_id = ops.data_derivation.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = d.project_id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM source_entries 
WHERE (source_entries.entry ->> 'product') = ops.data_derivation_output.product_id)) AND ops.demand_use.fate = 'fulfilled' AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.demand_use.created_at, ops.demand_use.created_xid, boundary) UNION SELECT CAST('original' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.original_source_admission.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.original_source_admission 
WHERE ops.original_source_admission.demand_id = d.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.original_source_admission.created_at, ops.original_source_admission.created_xid, boundary)), 
support_closure(kind, id) AS 
(SELECT support_seed.kind AS kind, support_seed.id AS id 
FROM support_seed 
WHERE support_seed.id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT support_edge.kind AS kind, support_edge.id AS id 
FROM support_closure JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN (ops.data_derivation_support.admission_use_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(coalesce(ops.data_derivation_support.admission_use_id, ops.data_derivation_support.support_derivation_id) AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation_support 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation_support.derivation_id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('original' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_derivation_original_support.admission_id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation_original_support 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation_original_support.derivation_id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('episode' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.derivation_id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN 'original' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_id' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id' ELSE selected_support_reference.value ->> 'derivation_id' END AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ops.demand_use.selection['support'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS selected_support_reference(value) ON true 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND true UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_population.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ops.demand_use.selection['populations'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS selected_population_reference(value) ON true JOIN ops.data_population ON ops.data_population.id = (selected_population_reference.value ->> 'population_id') AND ops.data_population.demand_id = ops.demand_use.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND true UNION ALL SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population JOIN ops.demand_use ON ops.demand_use.id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'admission_use_id') AND ops.demand_use.derivation_id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'derivation_id') AND ops.demand_use.demand_id = ops.data_population.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST((ops.data_population.evidence['selection']) ->> 'parent_population_id' AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id) AS support_edge ON true 
WHERE support_edge.id IS NOT NULL), 
support_sources AS 
(SELECT direct_sources.source AS source 
FROM direct_sources UNION SELECT ops.data_request.original_source AS source 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.data_derivation ON support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = d.project_id UNION SELECT ops.original_source_admission.original_source AS source 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.original_source_admission ON support_closure.kind = 'original' AND ops.original_source_admission.id = support_closure.id 
WHERE ops.original_source_admission.project_id = d.project_id)
 SELECT ops.ddo_scope(d.project_id, support_sources.source) AS scope 
FROM support_sources UNION SELECT record_grade_scope.scope 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.data_derivation ON support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id JOIN ops.ddo_record_grade_dependency_scopes(ops.data_derivation.id) AS record_grade_scope(scope) ON true 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = d.project_id UNION SELECT record_fit_scope.scope 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.data_derivation ON support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id JOIN ops.ddo_record_fit_dependency_scopes(ops.data_derivation.id) AS record_fit_scope(scope) ON true 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = d.project_id UNION SELECT operation_event_scope.scope 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.data_derivation ON support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id JOIN ops.ddo_operation_event_dependency_scopes(ops.data_derivation.id) AS operation_event_scope(scope) ON true 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = d.project_id ORDER BY scope) required ON required.scope=scope.scope WHERE scope.project_id=d.project_id;
 snapshot:=ops.ddo_trust_snapshot_meaning(snapshot);
 IF snapshot IS DISTINCT FROM ops.ddo_trust_snapshot_meaning(p_trust) OR (boundary.id IS NOT NULL AND ops.ddo_trust_snapshot_meaning(boundary.trust_snapshot) IS DISTINCT FROM snapshot) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'binding trust snapshot changed'; END IF;
 PERFORM ops.ddo_authorize(kind.universe) FROM sem.data_operation_definition operation CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(operation.input_roles) input_role(value) JOIN sem.data_kind_contract kind ON kind.kind_contract=input_role.value->>'kind_contract' WHERE operation.release_id=d.release_id AND operation.operation_id=p_operation;
 RETURN QUERY WITH declared_pins AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT entry.value AS entry 
FROM sem.data_operation_definition JOIN jsonb_array_elements(sem.data_operation_definition.input_roles) AS input_role(value) ON true JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(d.selection['source_sets'][(((input_role.value['support']) ->> 'source_set'))], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS entry(value) ON true 
WHERE sem.data_operation_definition.release_id = d.release_id AND sem.data_operation_definition.operation_id = p_operation), 
admitted AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT DISTINCT ON (episode.id, outp.role, outp.position, x.id, outp.member_id) x.id AS product_id, x.kind_contract AS parent_kind, x.subject AS parent_subject, x.subject_definition AS parent_subject_definition, x.original_source AS parent_source, x.analyzed_scope AS parent_scope, x.canonical_body AS canonical_body, outp.member_id AS output_member, outp.position AS output_position, outp.multiplicity AS output_multiplicity, episode.id AS episode_id, u.id AS use_id, producer.operation_id AS producer_operation 
FROM ops.demand_use AS u JOIN ops.data_derivation AS episode ON episode.id = u.derivation_id JOIN ops.data_request AS producer ON producer.id = episode.request_id JOIN ops.data_derivation_output AS outp ON outp.derivation_id = episode.id JOIN kb.data_product AS x ON x.id = outp.product_id 
WHERE (u.demand_id = d.id OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM declared_pins 
WHERE (declared_pins.entry ->> 'product') = x.id AND ((declared_pins.entry ->> 'member') IS NULL AND outp.member_id IS NULL OR (declared_pins.entry ->> 'member') IS NOT NULL AND (outp.member_id IS NULL OR outp.member_id = (declared_pins.entry ->> 'member')))))) AND u.fate = 'fulfilled' AND x.project_id = d.project_id AND (p_selected IS NULL OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_selected) AS selected_binding_key(value) 
WHERE (selected_binding_key.value ->> 'product_id') = x.id))) AND ops.ddo_read_visible(u.created_at, u.created_xid, boundary) AND ops.ddo_use_valid(u, boundary) AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(d.selection['operations']) AS selected_operation(value) 
WHERE (selected_operation.value ->> 'operation') = p_operation AND (jsonb_array_length(selected_operation.value['dependencies']) = 0 OR producer.operation_id = any(ops.ddo_consumed_producers(d.selection, p_operation))))) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM declared_pins 
WHERE (declared_pins.entry ->> 'product') = x.id AND ((declared_pins.entry ->> 'member') IS NULL AND outp.member_id IS NULL OR (declared_pins.entry ->> 'member') IS NOT NULL AND (outp.member_id IS NULL OR outp.member_id = (declared_pins.entry ->> 'member'))))) OR NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.demand_use AS later 
WHERE later.obligation_id = u.obligation_id AND (later.created_at > u.created_at OR later.created_at = u.created_at AND later.id > u.id) AND ops.ddo_read_visible(later.created_at, later.created_xid, boundary)))) ORDER BY episode.id, outp.role, outp.position, x.id, outp.member_id, u.id), 
candidates AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT admitted.product_id AS product_id, admitted.parent_kind AS parent_kind, admitted.parent_subject AS parent_subject, admitted.parent_subject_definition AS parent_subject_definition, admitted.parent_source AS parent_source, admitted.parent_scope AS parent_scope, admitted.canonical_body AS canonical_body, admitted.output_member AS output_member, admitted.output_position AS output_position, admitted.output_multiplicity AS output_multiplicity, admitted.episode_id AS episode_id, admitted.use_id AS use_id, admitted.producer_operation AS producer_operation, projected.member_id AS member_id, projected.projected_kind AS projected_kind, projected.projected_subject AS projected_subject, projected.projected_subject_definition AS projected_subject_definition, projected.projected_source AS projected_source, projected.projected_scope AS projected_scope, projected.projected_body AS projected_body, CAST(coalesce(member_role.position, admitted.output_position) AS BIGINT) AS occurrence_position, CAST(coalesce(member_role.multiplicity, admitted.output_multiplicity) AS BIGINT) AS occurrence_multiplicity 
FROM admitted JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS member_id, admitted.parent_kind AS projected_kind, admitted.parent_subject AS projected_subject, admitted.parent_subject_definition AS projected_subject_definition, admitted.parent_source AS projected_source, admitted.parent_scope AS projected_scope, admitted.canonical_body AS projected_body 
WHERE admitted.output_member IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT m.member_id AS member_id, m.kind_contract AS kind_contract, m.subject AS subject, m.subject_definition AS subject_definition, m.original_source AS original_source, m.analyzed_scope AS analyzed_scope, m.body AS body 
FROM kb.data_product_member AS m 
WHERE m.product_id = admitted.product_id AND (admitted.output_member IS NULL OR admitted.output_member = m.member_id)) AS projected ON true LEFT OUTER JOIN kb.data_member_role AS member_role ON member_role.product_id = admitted.product_id AND member_role.member_id = projected.member_id 
WHERE (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM sem.data_operation_definition JOIN jsonb_array_elements(sem.data_operation_definition.input_roles) AS input_role(value) ON true 
WHERE sem.data_operation_definition.release_id = d.release_id AND sem.data_operation_definition.operation_id = p_operation AND CASE WHEN ((input_role.value['accepted_kind_contracts'] ? projected.projected_kind) AND (coalesce(input_role.value['support']['origins'], CAST('["computation"]' AS JSONB)) ? 'computation') AND (p_scope IS NULL OR (input_role.value ->> 'subject_field') IS NOT NULL OR (input_role.value ->> 'subject_target') = 'source-set' OR projected.projected_scope IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_scope)) THEN CASE WHEN (ops.ddo_kind_access(admitted.parent_kind) AND ops.ddo_body_access(projected.projected_kind, projected.projected_body)) THEN (p_subject IS NULL OR ops.ddo_binding_subject(input_role.value, jsonb_build_object('subject', projected.projected_subject, 'meaning_body', projected.projected_body), p_subject, CAST(p_source #>> '{}' AS TEXT))) AND (p_source IS NULL AND ((input_role.value['support']) ->> 'source_set') IS NULL OR ops.ddo_binding_source(input_role.value, jsonb_build_object('product', admitted.product_id, 'member', projected.member_id, 'subject', projected.projected_subject, 'subject_definition', projected.projected_subject_definition, 'original_source', projected.projected_source, 'analyzed_scope', projected.projected_scope, 'meaning_body', projected.projected_body), CAST(p_source #>> '{}' AS TEXT), coalesce(d.selection['source_sets'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)))) ELSE false END ELSE false END)) AND (p_selected IS NULL OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_selected) AS selected_binding_key(value) 
WHERE (selected_binding_key.value ->> 'product_id') = admitted.product_id AND (selected_binding_key.value ->> 'member_id') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM projected.member_id))))
 SELECT CAST(candidates.product_id AS TEXT) AS product, CAST(candidates.projected_kind AS TEXT) AS kind_contract, CAST(candidates.projected_subject AS TEXT) AS subject, CAST(candidates.projected_subject_definition AS TEXT) AS subject_definition, CAST(candidates.projected_source AS TEXT) AS original_source, CAST(candidates.projected_scope AS JSONB) AS analyzed_scope, CAST((SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg((to_jsonb(coverage_row) - 'product_id') - 'member_id' ORDER BY coverage_row.ordinal), CAST('[]' AS JSONB)) AS coalesce_1 
FROM kb.data_member_coverage AS coverage_row 
WHERE coverage_row.product_id = candidates.product_id AND coverage_row.member_id = candidates.member_id) AS JSONB) AS coverage, CAST(jsonb_build_array(candidates.episode_id) AS JSONB) AS support_episodes, CAST(jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('kind', 'computation', 'derivation_id', candidates.episode_id, 'admission_use_id', candidates.use_id)) AS JSONB) AS support_references, CAST(jsonb_build_object('demand_id', d.id, 'use_id', candidates.use_id, 'trust_snapshot', snapshot, 'read_id', boundary.id, 'read_snapshot', boundary.read_snapshot, 'frontier_at', boundary.frontier_at) AS JSONB) AS support_evidence, CAST(candidates.occurrence_position AS BIGINT) AS position, CAST(candidates.occurrence_multiplicity AS BIGINT) AS multiplicity, CAST(candidates.member_id AS TEXT) AS member, CAST(ops.ddo_episode_provider_identity(candidates.episode_id) AS TEXT) AS provider_identity, CAST(candidates.producer_operation AS TEXT) AS alternative_identity, CAST(CASE WHEN p_decode_body THEN data.ddo_json(candidates.projected_body) ELSE NULL END AS JSONB) AS body, CAST(candidates.projected_body AS JSONB) AS meaning_body 
FROM candidates 
WHERE ops.ddo_kind_access(candidates.parent_kind) AND ops.ddo_body_access(candidates.projected_kind, candidates.projected_body);
 RETURN QUERY WITH factual AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT admission.id AS id, admission.demand_id AS demand_id, admission.project_id AS project_id, admission.release_id AS release_id, admission.selection_name AS selection_name, admission.source_reference AS source_reference, admission.reference AS reference, admission.selectors AS selectors, admission.product_id AS product_id, admission.subject AS subject, admission.original_source AS original_source, admission.analyzed_scope AS analyzed_scope, admission.trust_snapshot AS trust_snapshot, admission.evidence AS evidence, admission.created_at AS created_at, admission.created_xid AS created_xid, x.kind_contract AS kind_contract, x.subject_definition AS subject_definition, x.canonical_body AS canonical_body 
FROM ops.original_source_admission AS admission JOIN kb.data_product AS x ON x.id = admission.product_id 
WHERE admission.demand_id = d.id AND admission.project_id = d.project_id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(admission.created_at, admission.created_xid, boundary) AND ops.ddo_original_admission_valid(admission, boundary) AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM sem.data_operation_definition JOIN jsonb_array_elements(sem.data_operation_definition.input_roles) AS input_role(value) ON true 
WHERE sem.data_operation_definition.release_id = d.release_id AND sem.data_operation_definition.operation_id = p_operation AND CASE WHEN ((input_role.value['accepted_kind_contracts'] ? x.kind_contract) AND (coalesce(input_role.value['support']['origins'], CAST('["computation"]' AS JSONB)) ? CASE WHEN ((admission.reference ->> 'kind') = 'authored-fact') THEN 'authored' ELSE 'original-source' END) AND (p_scope IS NULL OR (input_role.value ->> 'subject_field') IS NOT NULL OR (input_role.value ->> 'subject_target') = 'source-set' OR admission.analyzed_scope IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_scope) AND (p_source IS NULL AND ((input_role.value['support']) ->> 'source_set') IS NULL OR ops.ddo_binding_source(input_role.value, jsonb_build_object('product', admission.product_id, 'member', CAST(NULL AS TEXT), 'subject', admission.subject, 'subject_definition', x.subject_definition, 'original_source', admission.original_source, 'analyzed_scope', admission.analyzed_scope, 'meaning_body', x.canonical_body), CAST(p_source #>> '{}' AS TEXT), coalesce(d.selection['source_sets'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB))))) THEN CASE WHEN ops.ddo_body_access(x.kind_contract, x.canonical_body) THEN p_subject IS NULL OR ops.ddo_binding_subject(input_role.value, jsonb_build_object('product', admission.product_id, 'member', CAST(NULL AS TEXT), 'subject', admission.subject, 'subject_definition', x.subject_definition, 'original_source', admission.original_source, 'analyzed_scope', admission.analyzed_scope, 'meaning_body', x.canonical_body), p_subject, CAST(p_source #>> '{}' AS TEXT)) ELSE false END ELSE false END)) AND (p_selected IS NULL OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_selected) AS selected_binding_key(value) 
WHERE (selected_binding_key.value ->> 'product_id') = admission.product_id AND (selected_binding_key.value ->> 'member_id') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM CAST(NULL AS TEXT)))))
 SELECT CAST(factual.product_id AS TEXT) AS product, CAST(factual.kind_contract AS TEXT) AS kind_contract, CAST(factual.subject AS TEXT) AS subject, CAST(factual.subject_definition AS TEXT) AS subject_definition, CAST(factual.original_source AS TEXT) AS original_source, CAST(factual.analyzed_scope AS JSONB) AS analyzed_scope, CAST(CAST('[]' AS JSONB) AS JSONB) AS coverage, CAST(CAST('[]' AS JSONB) AS JSONB) AS support_episodes, CAST(coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('kind', CASE WHEN ((factual.reference ->> 'kind') = 'authored-fact') THEN 'authored' ELSE 'original-source' END, 'admission_id', factual.id, 'source_reference', factual.source_reference) ORDER BY factual.id), CAST('[]' AS JSONB)) AS JSONB) AS support_references, CAST(jsonb_build_object('demand_id', d.id, 'original_admissions', coalesce(jsonb_agg(factual.id ORDER BY factual.id), CAST('[]' AS JSONB)), 'trust_snapshot', snapshot, 'read_id', boundary.id, 'read_snapshot', boundary.read_snapshot, 'frontier_at', boundary.frontier_at) AS JSONB) AS support_evidence, CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS position, CAST(1 AS BIGINT) AS multiplicity, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS member, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS provider_identity, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS alternative_identity, CAST(CASE WHEN p_decode_body THEN data.ddo_json(factual.canonical_body) ELSE NULL END AS JSONB) AS body, CAST(factual.canonical_body AS JSONB) AS meaning_body 
FROM factual 
WHERE ops.ddo_body_access(factual.kind_contract, factual.canonical_body) GROUP BY factual.product_id, factual.kind_contract, factual.subject, factual.subject_definition, factual.original_source, factual.analyzed_scope, factual.canonical_body;
END
