CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ops.ddo_binding_rows(p_demand text,p_operation text,p_trust jsonb,p_read text DEFAULT NULL,p_subject text DEFAULT NULL,p_source jsonb DEFAULT NULL,p_scope jsonb DEFAULT NULL,p_decode_body boolean DEFAULT true,p_selected jsonb DEFAULT NULL)
RETURNS TABLE("product" TEXT,"kind_contract" TEXT,"subject" TEXT,"subject_definition" TEXT,"original_source" TEXT,"analyzed_scope" JSONB,"coverage" JSONB,"support_episodes" JSONB,"support_references" JSONB,"support_evidence" JSONB,"position" BIGINT,"multiplicity" BIGINT,"member" TEXT,"provider_identity" TEXT,"alternative_identity" TEXT,"body" JSONB,"meaning_body" JSONB)
LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=pg_catalog,pg_temp AS $$
DECLARE d ops.data_demand; snapshot jsonb; boundary ops.data_demand_read;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO STRICT d FROM ops.data_demand WHERE id=p_demand;
 IF p_read IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'binding requires exact native read acquisition'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT boundary FROM ops.data_demand_read WHERE id=p_read AND demand_id=d.id;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(d.selection->'operations') selected WHERE selected->>'operation'=p_operation) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'projection operation outside frozen demand'; END IF;
 IF p_source IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF jsonb_typeof(p_source) NOT IN ('string','null') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'source filter requires JSON string or explicit null' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 PERFORM ops.ddo_require_subject_source(ops.ddo_release_subject_scopes(d.release_id),ops.ddo_operation_subject(d.release_id,p_operation),p_source#>>'{}');
 END IF;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(scope.scope,scope.epoch),'{}') INTO snapshot FROM ops.data_trust_scope scope JOIN (WITH RECURSIVE source_entries AS 
(SELECT source_entry.value AS entry 
FROM jsonb_each(coalesce(d.selection['source_sets'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB))) AS source_set(key, value) JOIN jsonb_array_elements(source_set.value) AS source_entry(value) ON true), 
direct_sources AS 
(SELECT root.value ->> 'original_source' AS source 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(d.root) AS root(value) UNION SELECT source_entries.entry ->> 'original_source' AS anon_1 
FROM source_entries), 
selected_use_seeds AS 
(SELECT DISTINCT ON (ops.demand_use.obligation_id) ops.demand_use.obligation_id AS obligation_id, ops.demand_use.id AS id, ops.demand_use.fate AS fate 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE ops.demand_use.demand_id = d.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.demand_use.created_at, ops.demand_use.created_xid, boundary) ORDER BY ops.demand_use.obligation_id, ops.demand_use.created_at DESC, ops.demand_use.id DESC), 
support_seed AS 
(SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(selected_use_seeds.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM selected_use_seeds 
WHERE true UNION SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_population.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population 
WHERE ops.data_population.demand_id = d.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.data_population.created_at, ops.data_population.created_xid, boundary) UNION SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation JOIN ops.data_derivation_output ON ops.data_derivation_output.derivation_id = ops.data_derivation.id JOIN ops.demand_use ON ops.demand_use.derivation_id = ops.data_derivation.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = d.project_id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM source_entries 
WHERE (source_entries.entry ->> 'product') = ops.data_derivation_output.product_id)) AND ops.demand_use.fate = 'fulfilled' AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.demand_use.created_at, ops.demand_use.created_xid, boundary) UNION SELECT CAST('original' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.original_source_admission.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.original_source_admission 
WHERE ops.original_source_admission.demand_id = d.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.original_source_admission.created_at, ops.original_source_admission.created_xid, boundary)), 
support_closure(kind, id) AS 
(SELECT support_seed.kind AS kind, support_seed.id AS id 
FROM support_seed 
WHERE support_seed.id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT support_edge.kind AS kind, support_edge.id AS id 
FROM support_closure JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN (ops.data_derivation_support.admission_use_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(coalesce(ops.data_derivation_support.admission_use_id, ops.data_derivation_support.support_derivation_id) AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation_support 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation_support.derivation_id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('original' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_derivation_original_support.admission_id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation_original_support 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation_original_support.derivation_id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('episode' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.derivation_id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN 'original' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_id' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id' ELSE selected_support_reference.value ->> 'derivation_id' END AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ops.demand_use.selection['support'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS selected_support_reference(value) ON true 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND true UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_population.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ops.demand_use.selection['populations'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS selected_population_reference(value) ON true JOIN ops.data_population ON ops.data_population.id = (selected_population_reference.value ->> 'population_id') AND ops.data_population.demand_id = ops.demand_use.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND true UNION ALL SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population JOIN ops.demand_use ON ops.demand_use.id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'admission_use_id') AND ops.demand_use.derivation_id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'derivation_id') AND ops.demand_use.demand_id = ops.data_population.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST((ops.data_population.evidence['selection']) ->> 'parent_population_id' AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id) AS support_edge ON true 
WHERE support_edge.id IS NOT NULL), 
support_sources AS 
(SELECT direct_sources.source AS source 
FROM direct_sources UNION SELECT ops.data_request.original_source AS source 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.data_derivation ON support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = d.project_id UNION SELECT ops.original_source_admission.original_source AS source 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.original_source_admission ON support_closure.kind = 'original' AND ops.original_source_admission.id = support_closure.id 
WHERE ops.original_source_admission.project_id = d.project_id)
 SELECT ops.ddo_scope(d.project_id, support_sources.source) AS scope 
FROM support_sources UNION SELECT record_grade_scope.scope 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.data_derivation ON support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id JOIN ops.ddo_record_grade_dependency_scopes(ops.data_derivation.id) AS record_grade_scope(scope) ON true 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = d.project_id UNION SELECT record_fit_scope.scope 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.data_derivation ON support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id JOIN ops.ddo_record_fit_dependency_scopes(ops.data_derivation.id) AS record_fit_scope(scope) ON true 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = d.project_id UNION SELECT operation_event_scope.scope 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.data_derivation ON support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id JOIN ops.ddo_operation_event_dependency_scopes(ops.data_derivation.id) AS operation_event_scope(scope) ON true 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = d.project_id ORDER BY scope) required ON required.scope=scope.scope WHERE scope.project_id=d.project_id;
 snapshot:=ops.ddo_trust_snapshot_meaning(snapshot);
 IF snapshot IS DISTINCT FROM ops.ddo_trust_snapshot_meaning(p_trust) OR (boundary.id IS NOT NULL AND ops.ddo_trust_snapshot_meaning(boundary.trust_snapshot) IS DISTINCT FROM snapshot) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'binding trust snapshot changed'; END IF;
 PERFORM ops.ddo_authorize(kind.universe) FROM sem.data_operation_definition operation CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(operation.input_roles) input_role(value) JOIN sem.data_kind_contract kind ON kind.kind_contract=input_role.value->>'kind_contract' WHERE operation.release_id=d.release_id AND operation.operation_id=p_operation;
 RETURN QUERY WITH declared_pins AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT entry.value AS entry 
FROM sem.data_operation_definition JOIN jsonb_array_elements(sem.data_operation_definition.input_roles) AS input_role(value) ON true JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(d.selection['source_sets'][(((input_role.value['support']) ->> 'source_set'))], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS entry(value) ON true 
WHERE sem.data_operation_definition.release_id = d.release_id AND sem.data_operation_definition.operation_id = p_operation), 
admitted AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT DISTINCT ON (episode.id, outp.role, outp.position, x.id, outp.member_id) x.id AS product_id, x.kind_contract AS parent_kind, x.subject AS parent_subject, x.subject_definition AS parent_subject_definition, x.original_source AS parent_source, x.analyzed_scope AS parent_scope, x.canonical_body AS canonical_body, outp.member_id AS output_member, outp.position AS output_position, outp.multiplicity AS output_multiplicity, episode.id AS episode_id, u.id AS use_id, producer.operation_id AS producer_operation 
FROM ops.demand_use AS u JOIN ops.data_derivation AS episode ON episode.id = u.derivation_id JOIN ops.data_request AS producer ON producer.id = episode.request_id JOIN ops.data_derivation_output AS outp ON outp.derivation_id = episode.id JOIN kb.data_product AS x ON x.id = outp.product_id 
WHERE (u.demand_id = d.id OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM declared_pins 
WHERE (declared_pins.entry ->> 'product') = x.id AND ((declared_pins.entry ->> 'member') IS NULL AND outp.member_id IS NULL OR (declared_pins.entry ->> 'member') IS NOT NULL AND (outp.member_id IS NULL OR outp.member_id = (declared_pins.entry ->> 'member')))))) AND u.fate = 'fulfilled' AND x.project_id = d.project_id AND (p_selected IS NULL OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_selected) AS selected_binding_key(value) 
WHERE (selected_binding_key.value ->> 'product_id') = x.id))) AND ops.ddo_read_visible(u.created_at, u.created_xid, boundary) AND ops.ddo_use_valid(u, boundary) AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(d.selection['operations']) AS selected_operation(value) 
WHERE (selected_operation.value ->> 'operation') = p_operation AND (jsonb_array_length(selected_operation.value['dependencies']) = 0 OR producer.operation_id = any(ops.ddo_consumed_producers(d.selection, p_operation))))) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM declared_pins 
WHERE (declared_pins.entry ->> 'product') = x.id AND ((declared_pins.entry ->> 'member') IS NULL AND outp.member_id IS NULL OR (declared_pins.entry ->> 'member') IS NOT NULL AND (outp.member_id IS NULL OR outp.member_id = (declared_pins.entry ->> 'member'))))) OR NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.demand_use AS later 
WHERE later.obligation_id = u.obligation_id AND (later.created_at > u.created_at OR later.created_at = u.created_at AND later.id > u.id) AND ops.ddo_read_visible(later.created_at, later.created_xid, boundary)))) ORDER BY episode.id, outp.role, outp.position, x.id, outp.member_id, u.id), 
candidates AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT admitted.product_id AS product_id, admitted.parent_kind AS parent_kind, admitted.parent_subject AS parent_subject, admitted.parent_subject_definition AS parent_subject_definition, admitted.parent_source AS parent_source, admitted.parent_scope AS parent_scope, admitted.canonical_body AS canonical_body, admitted.output_member AS output_member, admitted.output_position AS output_position, admitted.output_multiplicity AS output_multiplicity, admitted.episode_id AS episode_id, admitted.use_id AS use_id, admitted.producer_operation AS producer_operation, projected.member_id AS member_id, projected.projected_kind AS projected_kind, projected.projected_subject AS projected_subject, projected.projected_subject_definition AS projected_subject_definition, projected.projected_source AS projected_source, projected.projected_scope AS projected_scope, projected.projected_body AS projected_body, CAST(coalesce(member_role.position, admitted.output_position) AS BIGINT) AS occurrence_position, CAST(coalesce(member_role.multiplicity, admitted.output_multiplicity) AS BIGINT) AS occurrence_multiplicity 
FROM admitted JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS member_id, admitted.parent_kind AS projected_kind, admitted.parent_subject AS projected_subject, admitted.parent_subject_definition AS projected_subject_definition, admitted.parent_source AS projected_source, admitted.parent_scope AS projected_scope, admitted.canonical_body AS projected_body 
WHERE admitted.output_member IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT m.member_id AS member_id, m.kind_contract AS kind_contract, m.subject AS subject, m.subject_definition AS subject_definition, m.original_source AS original_source, m.analyzed_scope AS analyzed_scope, m.body AS body 
FROM kb.data_product_member AS m 
WHERE m.product_id = admitted.product_id AND (admitted.output_member IS NULL OR admitted.output_member = m.member_id)) AS projected ON true LEFT OUTER JOIN kb.data_member_role AS member_role ON member_role.product_id = admitted.product_id AND member_role.member_id = projected.member_id 
WHERE (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM sem.data_operation_definition JOIN jsonb_array_elements(sem.data_operation_definition.input_roles) AS input_role(value) ON true 
WHERE sem.data_operation_definition.release_id = d.release_id AND sem.data_operation_definition.operation_id = p_operation AND CASE WHEN ((input_role.value['accepted_kind_contracts'] ? projected.projected_kind) AND (coalesce(input_role.value['support']['origins'], CAST('["computation"]' AS JSONB)) ? 'computation') AND (p_scope IS NULL OR (input_role.value ->> 'subject_field') IS NOT NULL OR (input_role.value ->> 'subject_target') = 'source-set' OR projected.projected_scope IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_scope)) THEN CASE WHEN (ops.ddo_kind_access(admitted.parent_kind) AND ops.ddo_body_access(projected.projected_kind, projected.projected_body)) THEN (p_subject IS NULL OR ops.ddo_binding_subject(input_role.value, jsonb_build_object('subject', projected.projected_subject, 'meaning_body', projected.projected_body), p_subject, CAST(p_source #>> '{}' AS TEXT))) AND (p_source IS NULL AND ((input_role.value['support']) ->> 'source_set') IS NULL OR ops.ddo_binding_source(input_role.value, jsonb_build_object('product', admitted.product_id, 'member', projected.member_id, 'subject', projected.projected_subject, 'subject_definition', projected.projected_subject_definition, 'original_source', projected.projected_source, 'analyzed_scope', projected.projected_scope, 'meaning_body', projected.projected_body), CAST(p_source #>> '{}' AS TEXT), coalesce(d.selection['source_sets'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)))) ELSE false END ELSE false END)) AND (p_selected IS NULL OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_selected) AS selected_binding_key(value) 
WHERE (selected_binding_key.value ->> 'product_id') = admitted.product_id AND (selected_binding_key.value ->> 'member_id') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM projected.member_id))))
 SELECT CAST(candidates.product_id AS TEXT) AS product, CAST(candidates.projected_kind AS TEXT) AS kind_contract, CAST(candidates.projected_subject AS TEXT) AS subject, CAST(candidates.projected_subject_definition AS TEXT) AS subject_definition, CAST(candidates.projected_source AS TEXT) AS original_source, CAST(candidates.projected_scope AS JSONB) AS analyzed_scope, CAST((SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg((to_jsonb(coverage_row) - 'product_id') - 'member_id' ORDER BY coverage_row.ordinal), CAST('[]' AS JSONB)) AS coalesce_1 
FROM kb.data_member_coverage AS coverage_row 
WHERE coverage_row.product_id = candidates.product_id AND coverage_row.member_id = candidates.member_id) AS JSONB) AS coverage, CAST(jsonb_build_array(candidates.episode_id) AS JSONB) AS support_episodes, CAST(jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('kind', 'computation', 'derivation_id', candidates.episode_id, 'admission_use_id', candidates.use_id)) AS JSONB) AS support_references, CAST(jsonb_build_object('demand_id', d.id, 'use_id', candidates.use_id, 'trust_snapshot', snapshot, 'read_id', boundary.id, 'read_snapshot', boundary.read_snapshot, 'frontier_at', boundary.frontier_at) AS JSONB) AS support_evidence, CAST(candidates.occurrence_position AS BIGINT) AS position, CAST(candidates.occurrence_multiplicity AS BIGINT) AS multiplicity, CAST(candidates.member_id AS TEXT) AS member, CAST(ops.ddo_episode_provider_identity(candidates.episode_id) AS TEXT) AS provider_identity, CAST(candidates.producer_operation AS TEXT) AS alternative_identity, CAST(CASE WHEN p_decode_body THEN data.ddo_json(candidates.projected_body) ELSE NULL END AS JSONB) AS body, CAST(candidates.projected_body AS JSONB) AS meaning_body 
FROM candidates 
WHERE ops.ddo_kind_access(candidates.parent_kind) AND ops.ddo_body_access(candidates.projected_kind, candidates.projected_body);
 RETURN QUERY WITH factual AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT admission.id AS id, admission.demand_id AS demand_id, admission.project_id AS project_id, admission.release_id AS release_id, admission.selection_name AS selection_name, admission.source_reference AS source_reference, admission.reference AS reference, admission.selectors AS selectors, admission.product_id AS product_id, admission.subject AS subject, admission.original_source AS original_source, admission.analyzed_scope AS analyzed_scope, admission.trust_snapshot AS trust_snapshot, admission.evidence AS evidence, admission.created_at AS created_at, admission.created_xid AS created_xid, x.kind_contract AS kind_contract, x.subject_definition AS subject_definition, x.canonical_body AS canonical_body 
FROM ops.original_source_admission AS admission JOIN kb.data_product AS x ON x.id = admission.product_id 
WHERE admission.demand_id = d.id AND admission.project_id = d.project_id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(admission.created_at, admission.created_xid, boundary) AND ops.ddo_original_admission_valid(admission, boundary) AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM sem.data_operation_definition JOIN jsonb_array_elements(sem.data_operation_definition.input_roles) AS input_role(value) ON true 
WHERE sem.data_operation_definition.release_id = d.release_id AND sem.data_operation_definition.operation_id = p_operation AND CASE WHEN ((input_role.value['accepted_kind_contracts'] ? x.kind_contract) AND (coalesce(input_role.value['support']['origins'], CAST('["computation"]' AS JSONB)) ? CASE WHEN ((admission.reference ->> 'kind') = 'authored-fact') THEN 'authored' ELSE 'original-source' END) AND (p_scope IS NULL OR (input_role.value ->> 'subject_field') IS NOT NULL OR (input_role.value ->> 'subject_target') = 'source-set' OR admission.analyzed_scope IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_scope) AND (p_source IS NULL AND ((input_role.value['support']) ->> 'source_set') IS NULL OR ops.ddo_binding_source(input_role.value, jsonb_build_object('product', admission.product_id, 'member', CAST(NULL AS TEXT), 'subject', admission.subject, 'subject_definition', x.subject_definition, 'original_source', admission.original_source, 'analyzed_scope', admission.analyzed_scope, 'meaning_body', x.canonical_body), CAST(p_source #>> '{}' AS TEXT), coalesce(d.selection['source_sets'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB))))) THEN CASE WHEN ops.ddo_body_access(x.kind_contract, x.canonical_body) THEN p_subject IS NULL OR ops.ddo_binding_subject(input_role.value, jsonb_build_object('product', admission.product_id, 'member', CAST(NULL AS TEXT), 'subject', admission.subject, 'subject_definition', x.subject_definition, 'original_source', admission.original_source, 'analyzed_scope', admission.analyzed_scope, 'meaning_body', x.canonical_body), p_subject, CAST(p_source #>> '{}' AS TEXT)) ELSE false END ELSE false END)) AND (p_selected IS NULL OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_selected) AS selected_binding_key(value) 
WHERE (selected_binding_key.value ->> 'product_id') = admission.product_id AND (selected_binding_key.value ->> 'member_id') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM CAST(NULL AS TEXT)))))
 SELECT CAST(factual.product_id AS TEXT) AS product, CAST(factual.kind_contract AS TEXT) AS kind_contract, CAST(factual.subject AS TEXT) AS subject, CAST(factual.subject_definition AS TEXT) AS subject_definition, CAST(factual.original_source AS TEXT) AS original_source, CAST(factual.analyzed_scope AS JSONB) AS analyzed_scope, CAST(CAST('[]' AS JSONB) AS JSONB) AS coverage, CAST(CAST('[]' AS JSONB) AS JSONB) AS support_episodes, CAST(coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('kind', CASE WHEN ((factual.reference ->> 'kind') = 'authored-fact') THEN 'authored' ELSE 'original-source' END, 'admission_id', factual.id, 'source_reference', factual.source_reference) ORDER BY factual.id), CAST('[]' AS JSONB)) AS JSONB) AS support_references, CAST(jsonb_build_object('demand_id', d.id, 'original_admissions', coalesce(jsonb_agg(factual.id ORDER BY factual.id), CAST('[]' AS JSONB)), 'trust_snapshot', snapshot, 'read_id', boundary.id, 'read_snapshot', boundary.read_snapshot, 'frontier_at', boundary.frontier_at) AS JSONB) AS support_evidence, CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS position, CAST(1 AS BIGINT) AS multiplicity, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS member, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS provider_identity, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS alternative_identity, CAST(CASE WHEN p_decode_body THEN data.ddo_json(factual.canonical_body) ELSE NULL END AS JSONB) AS body, CAST(factual.canonical_body AS JSONB) AS meaning_body 
FROM factual 
WHERE ops.ddo_body_access(factual.kind_contract, factual.canonical_body) GROUP BY factual.product_id, factual.kind_contract, factual.subject, factual.subject_definition, factual.original_source, factual.analyzed_scope, factual.canonical_body;
END $$

DECLARE definition sem.data_operation_definition;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO STRICT definition FROM sem.data_operation_definition
 WHERE release_id=r.release_id AND operation_id=r.operation_id;
 IF r.operation_id NOT IN ('structure.definition_applicability/declared','structure.definition_declaration_components/declared',
 'structure.definition_components/declared','structure.definition_named_components/declared')
 OR definition.support_contract->'capabilities'->'prepared_factory'->>'entrypoint' IS DISTINCT FROM
 (CASE WHEN r.operation_id='structure.definition_applicability/declared'
 THEN 'corpus_structure.methods.definition_applicability_declared.DefinitionApplicabilityOperation.acquire_port'
 WHEN r.operation_id='structure.definition_declaration_components/declared' THEN 'corpus_structure.methods.definition_declared.DefinitionDeclarationOperation.acquire_port'
 WHEN r.operation_id='structure.definition_components/declared' THEN 'corpus_structure.methods.definition_components_declared.DefinitionComponentsOperation.acquire_port'
 ELSE 'corpus_structure.methods.definition_named_declared.NamedDefinitionComponentsOperation.acquire_port' END)
 OR (definition.support_contract->'capabilities'->'prepared_factory'->>'source_digest' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') IS NOT TRUE
 OR (definition.implementation_revision LIKE 'implementation-slice:%') IS NOT TRUE
 OR definition.profile IS DISTINCT FROM 'derivation' OR definition.recipe IS DISTINCT FROM r.recipe
 OR definition.support_contract->'capabilities'->'forms' IS DISTINCT FROM '["scalar"]'::jsonb
 OR definition.support_contract->'capabilities'->>'preparation' IS DISTINCT FROM 'resource'
 OR definition.support_contract->'effects' IS DISTINCT FROM '[]'::jsonb
 OR jsonb_array_length(coalesce(completion->'execution_evidence'->'cpu_receipts','[]'))<>1
 OR completion->>'implementation_revision' IS DISTINCT FROM definition.implementation_revision THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'contextual applicability lacks its actual captured scalar producer' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
END

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ops.ddo_require_definition_producer(r ops.data_request,completion jsonb)
RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=pg_catalog,pg_temp AS $definition$
DECLARE definition sem.data_operation_definition;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO STRICT definition FROM sem.data_operation_definition
 WHERE release_id=r.release_id AND operation_id=r.operation_id;
 IF r.operation_id NOT IN ('structure.definition_applicability/declared','structure.definition_declaration_components/declared',
 'structure.definition_components/declared','structure.definition_named_components/declared')
 OR definition.support_contract->'capabilities'->'prepared_factory'->>'entrypoint' IS DISTINCT FROM
 (CASE WHEN r.operation_id='structure.definition_applicability/declared'

DECLARE inventory_ jsonb:=data.record_source_json(p_inventory->'inventory');
 inventory_key text:=inventory_->>'inventory_id'; profile_key text;
 target_keys text[]:=ARRAY(SELECT value->>'target_id' FROM jsonb_array_elements(inventory_->'targets') ORDER BY (value->>'target_id') COLLATE "C");
 query_vector public.vector; observed jsonb; lexical_query text:=p_query->>'lexical_query';
 channel_budget integer:=(p_policy->>'channel_budget')::integer;
 text_configuration text:=numerics->>'text_configuration'; membership jsonb; hits jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF (current_setting('server_version_num')::integer IS DISTINCT FROM (numerics->>'postgres_version_num')::integer)
 OR (SELECT extversion FROM pg_extension WHERE extname='vector') IS DISTINCT FROM numerics->>'pgvector_extension_version'
 OR numerics->>'target_collation' IS DISTINCT FROM 'C'
 OR text_configuration IS DISTINCT FROM 'pg_catalog.english'
 OR numerics->>'linguistic_policy' IS DISTINCT FROM 'postgres-english-default-locale-observation-1'
 OR numerics->>'alias_target_normalization' IS DISTINCT FROM 'python-str.lower'
 OR numerics->>'alias_query_normalization' IS DISTINCT FROM 'postgres-default-lower'
 OR numerics->>'distance_operator' IS DISTINCT FROM 'pgvector-vector-cosine'
 OR numerics->>'score_transport' IS DISTINCT FROM 'postgres-float8'
 OR lexical_query IS NULL OR length(btrim(lexical_query))=0
 OR (1<=(p_policy->>'budget')::integer AND (p_policy->>'budget')::integer<=channel_budget) IS NOT TRUE THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'native score backend/query/budgets differ from exact declared policy' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 SELECT value INTO STRICT observed FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_vectors->'vectors'->'items')
 WHERE (data.report_field(value,'object_id')->>'text') COLLATE "C"=(p_query->>'occurrence_id') COLLATE "C"
 AND data.report_field(value,'vector_id')->>'text'=p_query->>'query_vector_id';
 query_vector:=ops.ddo_contextual_observed_vector(observed);
 profile_key:=data.report_field(observed,'profile_id')->>'text';
 WITH score_rows AS (WITH eligible_concept_vectors AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT anon_1.inventory_id AS inventory_id, anon_1.profile_id AS profile_id, anon_1.target_id AS target_id, anon_1.vector AS vector, anon_1.search_text AS search_text, anon_1.exact_forms AS exact_forms 
FROM ops.ddo_contextual_vector_rows(p_inventory, p_vectors) AS anon_1 
WHERE anon_1.inventory_id = inventory_key AND anon_1.profile_id = profile_key AND (anon_1.target_id COLLATE "C") = ANY (target_keys))
 SELECT retrieval_rows.kind, retrieval_rows.channel, retrieval_rows.target_id, retrieval_rows.rank, retrieval_rows.score 
FROM (SELECT 'membership' AS kind, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS channel, eligible_concept_vectors.target_id AS target_id, CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS rank, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS score 
FROM eligible_concept_vectors UNION ALL SELECT 'hit' AS anon_2, 'dense' AS anon_3, dense_hits.target_id AS target_id, dense_hits.rank AS rank, dense_hits.score AS score 
FROM (SELECT eligible_concept_vectors.target_id AS target_id, CAST(1 - (eligible_concept_vectors.vector OPERATOR(public.<=>) query_vector) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS score, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY eligible_concept_vectors.vector OPERATOR(public.<=>) query_vector, eligible_concept_vectors.target_id COLLATE "C") AS rank 
FROM eligible_concept_vectors ORDER BY eligible_concept_vectors.vector OPERATOR(public.<=>) query_vector, eligible_concept_vectors.target_id COLLATE "C" 
 LIMIT channel_budget) AS dense_hits UNION ALL SELECT 'hit' AS anon_4, 'lexical' AS anon_5, lexical_hits.target_id AS target_id, lexical_hits.rank AS rank, lexical_hits.score AS score 
FROM (SELECT eligible_concept_vectors.target_id AS target_id, CAST(ts_rank_cd(to_tsvector(CAST(text_configuration AS REGCONFIG), eligible_concept_vectors.search_text), websearch_to_tsquery(CAST(text_configuration AS REGCONFIG), lexical_query)) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS score, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY ts_rank_cd(to_tsvector(CAST(text_configuration AS REGCONFIG), eligible_concept_vectors.search_text), websearch_to_tsquery(CAST(text_configuration AS REGCONFIG), lexical_query)) DESC, eligible_concept_vectors.target_id COLLATE "C") AS rank 
FROM eligible_concept_vectors 
WHERE to_tsvector(CAST(text_configuration AS REGCONFIG), eligible_concept_vectors.search_text) @@ websearch_to_tsquery(CAST(text_configuration AS REGCONFIG), lexical_query) ORDER BY ts_rank_cd(to_tsvector(CAST(text_configuration AS REGCONFIG), eligible_concept_vectors.search_text), websearch_to_tsquery(CAST(text_configuration AS REGCONFIG), lexical_query)) DESC, eligible_concept_vectors.target_id COLLATE "C" 
 LIMIT channel_budget) AS lexical_hits UNION ALL SELECT 'hit' AS anon_6, 'alias' AS anon_7, alias_hits.target_id AS target_id, alias_hits.rank AS rank, alias_hits.score AS score 
FROM (SELECT eligible_concept_vectors.target_id AS target_id, CAST(1.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS score, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY eligible_concept_vectors.target_id COLLATE "C") AS rank 
FROM eligible_concept_vectors 
WHERE lower(lexical_query) = ANY (eligible_concept_vectors.exact_forms) ORDER BY eligible_concept_vectors.target_id COLLATE "C" 
 LIMIT channel_budget) AS alias_hits) AS retrieval_rows ORDER BY retrieval_rows.kind DESC, retrieval_rows.channel, retrieval_rows.rank, retrieval_rows.target_id COLLATE "C")
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(target_id) ORDER BY target_id COLLATE "C") FILTER(WHERE kind='membership'),'[]'),
 coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('channel',channel,'target_id',target_id,'rank',rank,
 'score_float8_hex',encode(float8send(score),'hex')) ORDER BY channel COLLATE "C",rank,target_id COLLATE "C") FILTER(WHERE kind='hit'),'[]')
 INTO membership,hits FROM score_rows;
 IF membership IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(target_keys) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'native scoring membership is incomplete or duplicated' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('version','contextual-native-scores-2','inventory_id',inventory_key,
 'profile_id',profile_key,'occurrence_id',p_query->>'occurrence_id','query_vector_id',p_query->>'query_vector_id',
 'lexical_query',lexical_query,'membership',membership,'hits',hits,
 'linguistic_observation',data.record_json_source(ops.ddo_contextual_linguistic_context()));
END

DECLARE operation sem.data_operation_definition; factory text;
BEGIN
 IF r.operation_id NOT IN ('retrieve.contextual_query/declared','retrieve.contextual_query/selected-context',
 'retrieve.contextual_target_vector/declared','retrieve.contextual_vectors/selection',
 'retrieve.contextual_targets/curated','retrieve.contextual_targets/components',
 'retrieve.contextual_target/declared','retrieve.contextual_inventory/declared',
 'retrieve.contextual_scores/declared','retrieve.contextual/declared',
 'retrieve.contextual_witnesses/declared','retrieve.contextual/with-witnesses') THEN RETURN; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT operation FROM sem.data_operation_definition
 WHERE release_id=r.release_id AND operation_id=r.operation_id;
 factory:=CASE r.operation_id
 WHEN 'retrieve.contextual_query/declared' THEN 'corpus_structure.methods.contextual_encoding.ContextualEncodingOperation.acquire_port'
 WHEN 'retrieve.contextual_query/selected-context' THEN 'corpus_structure.methods.contextual_encoding.SelectedContextEncodingOperation.acquire_port'
 WHEN 'retrieve.contextual_target_vector/declared' THEN 'corpus_structure.methods.contextual_encoding.ContextualTargetEncodingOperation.acquire_port'
 WHEN 'retrieve.contextual_vectors/selection' THEN 'corpus_structure.methods.contextual_targets.ContextualVectorSelectionOperation.acquire_port'
 WHEN 'retrieve.contextual_targets/curated' THEN 'corpus_structure.methods.contextual_targets.CuratedContextualTargetsOperation.acquire_port'
 WHEN 'retrieve.contextual_targets/components' THEN 'corpus_structure.methods.contextual_targets.SourceContextualTargetsOperation.acquire_port'
 WHEN 'retrieve.contextual_target/declared' THEN 'corpus_structure.methods.contextual_targets.ContextualTargetOperation.acquire_port'
 WHEN 'retrieve.contextual_inventory/declared' THEN 'corpus_structure.methods.contextual_declared.ContextualInventoryOperation.acquire_port'
 WHEN 'retrieve.contextual_scores/declared' THEN 'corpus_structure.methods.contextual_scoring.ContextualScoringOperation.acquire_port'
 WHEN 'retrieve.contextual/declared' THEN 'corpus_structure.methods.contextual_declared.ContextualRetrievalOperation.acquire_port'
 WHEN 'retrieve.contextual_witnesses/declared' THEN 'corpus_structure.methods.contextual_witnesses.ContextualWitnessOperation.acquire_port'
 WHEN 'retrieve.contextual/with-witnesses' THEN 'corpus_structure.methods.contextual_witnesses.ContextualWitnessedRetrievalOperation.acquire_port' END;
 IF operation.support_contract->'capabilities'->'prepared_factory'->>'entrypoint' IS DISTINCT FROM factory
 OR (operation.support_contract->'capabilities'->'prepared_factory'->>'source_digest' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') IS NOT TRUE
 OR (operation.implementation_revision LIKE 'implementation-slice:%') IS NOT TRUE
 OR operation.profile IS DISTINCT FROM (CASE WHEN r.operation_id IN
 ('retrieve.contextual_targets/curated','retrieve.contextual_targets/components') THEN 'discovery' ELSE 'derivation' END)
 OR operation.recipe IS DISTINCT FROM r.recipe
 OR operation.support_contract->'capabilities'->'forms' IS DISTINCT FROM '["scalar"]'::jsonb
 OR operation.support_contract->'capabilities'->>'preparation' IS DISTINCT FROM 'resource'
 OR operation.support_contract->'effects' IS DISTINCT FROM '[]'::jsonb
 OR jsonb_array_length(coalesce(completion->'execution_evidence'->'cpu_receipts','[]'))<>
 (CASE WHEN r.operation_id='retrieve.contextual_scores/declared' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)
 OR completion->>'implementation_revision' IS DISTINCT FROM operation.implementation_revision THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'contextual completion lacks its actual admitted captured producer' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
END

 WHEN 'retrieve.contextual_query/selected-context' THEN 'corpus_structure.methods.contextual_encoding.SelectedContextEncodingOperation.acquire_port'
 WHEN 'retrieve.contextual_target_vector/declared' THEN 'corpus_structure.methods.contextual_encoding.ContextualTargetEncodingOperation.acquire_port'
 WHEN 'retrieve.contextual_vectors/selection' THEN 'corpus_structure.methods.contextual_targets.ContextualVectorSelectionOperation.acquire_port'
 WHEN 'retrieve.contextual_targets/curated' THEN 'corpus_structure.methods.contextual_targets.CuratedContextualTargetsOperation.acquire_port'
 WHEN 'retrieve.contextual_targets/components' THEN 'corpus_structure.methods.contextual_targets.SourceContextualTargetsOperation.acquire_port'
 WHEN 'retrieve.contextual_target/declared' THEN 'corpus_structure.methods.contextual_targets.ContextualTargetOperation.acquire_port'
 WHEN 'retrieve.contextual_inventory/declared' THEN 'corpus_structure.methods.contextual_declared.ContextualInventoryOperation.acquire_port'
 WHEN 'retrieve.contextual_scores/declared' THEN 'corpus_structure.methods.contextual_scoring.ContextualScoringOperation.acquire_port'
 WHEN 'retrieve.contextual/declared' THEN 'corpus_structure.methods.contextual_declared.ContextualRetrievalOperation.acquire_port'
 WHEN 'retrieve.contextual_witnesses/declared' THEN 'corpus_structure.methods.contextual_witnesses.ContextualWitnessOperation.acquire_port'
 WHEN 'retrieve.contextual/with-witnesses' THEN 'corpus_structure.methods.contextual_witnesses.ContextualWitnessedRetrievalOperation.acquire_port' END;
 IF operation.support_contract->'capabilities'->'prepared_factory'->>'entrypoint' IS DISTINCT FROM factory
 OR (operation.support_contract->'capabilities'->'prepared_factory'->>'source_digest' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') IS NOT TRUE
 OR (operation.implementation_revision LIKE 'implementation-slice:%') IS NOT TRUE
 OR operation.profile IS DISTINCT FROM (CASE WHEN r.operation_id IN
 ('retrieve.contextual_targets/curated','retrieve.contextual_targets/components') THEN 'discovery' ELSE 'derivation' END)
 OR operation.recipe IS DISTINCT FROM r.recipe
 OR operation.support_contract->'capabilities'->'forms' IS DISTINCT FROM '["scalar"]'::jsonb
 OR operation.support_contract->'capabilities'->>'preparation' IS DISTINCT FROM 'resource'
 OR operation.support_contract->'effects' IS DISTINCT FROM '[]'::jsonb
 OR jsonb_array_length(coalesce(completion->'execution_evidence'->'cpu_receipts','[]'))<>
 (CASE WHEN r.operation_id='retrieve.contextual_scores/declared' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)
 OR completion->>'implementation_revision' IS DISTINCT FROM operation.implementation_revision THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'contextual completion lacks its actual admitted captured producer' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
END $contextual$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ops.ddo_require_structural_dossier_completion(r ops.data_request,completion jsonb)
RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=pg_catalog,pg_temp AS $structural$
DECLARE definition sem.data_operation_definition; selected jsonb; conclusion kb.data_product;
 comparison_product kb.data_product; admission_value jsonb; actual_count bigint;
BEGIN
 IF r.operation_id<>'structure.dossier/declared' THEN RETURN; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT definition FROM sem.data_operation_definition WHERE release_id=r.release_id AND operation_id=r.operation_id;
 IF definition.profile IS DISTINCT FROM 'derivation' OR definition.support_contract->'effects' IS DISTINCT FROM '[]'::jsonb
 OR definition.support_contract->'capabilities'->'prepared_factory'->>'entrypoint' IS DISTINCT FROM 'corpus_structure.methods.dossier_declared.DossierOperation.acquire_port'
 OR (definition.support_contract->'capabilities'->'prepared_factory'->>'source_digest' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') IS NOT TRUE
 OR (definition.implementation_revision LIKE 'implementation-slice:%') IS NOT TRUE THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'structural dossier requires its actual captured preparation factory' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 FOR selected IN SELECT item FROM jsonb_array_elements(completion->'inputs') item WHERE item->>'role'='admissions' LOOP
 IF selected->>'member_id' IS NOT NULL OR (selected->>'multiplicity')::integer IS DISTINCT FROM 1 THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'dossier admission requires an exact whole conclusion' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT conclusion FROM kb.data_product WHERE id=selected->>'product_id' AND project_id=r.project_id;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM sem.data_kind_contract kind WHERE kind.kind_contract=conclusion.kind_contract
 AND kind.kind='urn:corpus:structural-admission:DdoStructuralAdmission' AND kind.universe='ordinary') THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'dossier admission differs from its actual ordinary structural kind' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 -- Ordinary consumption proves the issuer's committed common receipt and exact
 -- output. It never reads protected pass bodies or invokes evaluator issuance.
 -- The enclosing common support guard authenticates use visibility, locks and
 -- full protected revocation closure, including direct issuer revocation.
 SELECT count(*) INTO actual_count FROM ops.data_derivation episode
 JOIN ops.data_derivation_output output ON output.derivation_id=episode.id
 JOIN ops.data_publication_receipt receipt ON receipt.derivation_id=episode.id AND receipt.intent_id=episode.intent_id
 JOIN ops.data_completion_intent intent ON intent.id=episode.intent_id
 JOIN ops.data_request request ON request.id=episode.request_id
 JOIN sem.data_operation_definition issuer ON issuer.release_id=episode.release_id AND issuer.operation_id=request.operation_id
 WHERE output.product_id=conclusion.id AND output.member_id IS NULL AND output.role='admission'
 AND output.position=0 AND output.multiplicity=1 AND episode.outcome='success'
 AND ops.ddo_structural_command_eligible(issuer) AND episode.recipe=issuer.recipe
 AND intent.payload->>'implementation_revision'=issuer.implementation_revision
 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM ops.data_derivation_output other WHERE other.derivation_id=episode.id)=1
 AND data.ddo_normalize(intent.payload->'outputs'->0->'product'->'body')=conclusion.canonical_body
 AND EXISTS(SELECT FROM ops.ddo_input_support_refs(r.binding,'admissions',selected->'position',conclusion.id,NULL) support
 WHERE support->>'kind'='computation' AND support->>'derivation_id'=episode.id);
 IF actual_count<>1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'dossier admission lacks its exact actual native issuer receipt' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 admission_value:=data.ddo_json(conclusion.canonical_body);
 SELECT product.* INTO STRICT comparison_product FROM kb.data_product product
 JOIN jsonb_array_elements(completion->'inputs') input ON input->>'product_id'=product.id
 WHERE input->>'role'='comparisons' AND input->>'member_id' IS NULL
 AND product.id=admission_value->'report'->>'product_id' AND product.project_id=r.project_id;
 IF jsonb_strip_nulls(admission_value->'report') IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_strip_nulls(ops.ddo_structural_product_reference(comparison_product))
 OR admission_value->>'statement_encoding' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ddo-semantic-value-v1'
 OR admission_value->>'statement_meaning_json' IS DISTINCT FROM data.canonical_json(ops.ddo_structural_comparison_statement(comparison_product.canonical_body)) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'dossier admission differs from the actual retained comparison and exact statement' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 END LOOP;
EXCEPTION WHEN no_data_found OR too_many_rows THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'dossier admission cannot resolve exact ordinary issuer/report custody' USING ERRCODE='23514';
END $structural$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ops.ddo_operation_event_require_fit(r ops.data_request,body jsonb)
RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=pg_catalog,pg_temp AS $event$
DECLARE specification jsonb:=ops.ddo_record_grade_input(r,'specification')->'body'; selected jsonb:=specification->'frame';
 selection_ jsonb:=selected->'selection'; d ops.data_demand; boundary ops.data_demand_read; p jsonb;
 p_use text:=selected->>'use_id'; p_product text:=selected->'reference'->>'product_id'; p_derivation text:=selected->>'derivation_id';
 admitted boolean; scope_key text; epoch bigint; current_trust jsonb:='{}'; chosen jsonb;
 producer ops.data_derivation; frame_request ops.data_request; intent ops.data_completion_intent; actual kb.data_product; definition sem.data_operation_definition;
BEGIN
 IF selection_->>'project_id' IS DISTINCT FROM r.project_id
 OR selected->'reference'->>'member_id' IS NOT NULL
 OR selection_->>'cut_id' IS DISTINCT FROM 'cut-selection:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(selection_->>'cut_canonical_json','UTF8')),'hex') THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'event fit changes exact selected frame project/cut' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 FOR scope_key IN SELECT * FROM ops.ddo_record_fit_cut_scopes(r.project_id,selection_) LOOP
 SELECT coalesce((SELECT scope.epoch FROM ops.data_trust_scope scope WHERE scope.scope=scope_key AND scope.project_id=r.project_id),0) INTO epoch;
 current_trust:=current_trust||jsonb_build_object(scope_key,epoch);
 END LOOP;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT d FROM ops.data_demand WHERE id=selection_->>'demand_id' AND project_id=r.project_id;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT boundary FROM ops.data_demand_read WHERE id=selection_->>'read_id' AND demand_id=d.id;
 IF ops.ddo_trust_snapshot_meaning(current_trust) IS DISTINCT FROM ops.ddo_trust_snapshot_meaning(boundary.trust_snapshot) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'event frame current trust differs from original selected fit cut' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 p:=jsonb_build_object('scope',boundary.scope);
 WITH RECURSIVE scoped_obligations AS 
(SELECT ops.data_obligation.id AS id, ops.data_obligation.demand_id AS demand_id, ops.data_obligation.operation_id AS operation_id, ops.data_obligation.subject AS subject, ops.data_obligation.original_source AS original_source, ops.data_obligation.analyzed_scope AS analyzed_scope, ops.data_obligation.parameters AS parameters, ops.data_obligation.created_at AS created_at, ops.data_obligation.created_xid AS created_xid 
FROM ops.data_obligation 
WHERE ops.data_obligation.demand_id = d.id AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'operation_id') OR ops.data_obligation.operation_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'operation_id')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'subject') OR ops.data_obligation.subject IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'subject')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'original_source') OR ops.data_obligation.original_source IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'original_source')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'product_ids') OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.demand_use AS scope_use JOIN ops.data_derivation_output ON ops.data_derivation_output.derivation_id = scope_use.derivation_id JOIN jsonb_array_elements_text((coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)))['product_ids']) AS scope_product(value) ON ops.data_derivation_output.product_id = scope_product.value 
WHERE scope_use.obligation_id = ops.data_obligation.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_use.created_at, scope_use.created_xid, boundary) AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.demand_use AS scope_later_use 
WHERE scope_later_use.obligation_id = scope_use.obligation_id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_later_use.created_at, scope_later_use.created_xid, boundary) AND (scope_later_use.created_at > scope_use.created_at OR scope_later_use.created_at = scope_use.created_at AND scope_later_use.id > scope_use.id))))) OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.original_source_admission AS scope_original JOIN jsonb_array_elements_text((coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)))['product_ids']) AS scope_product(value) ON scope_original.product_id = scope_product.value 
WHERE scope_original.demand_id = d.id AND scope_original.project_id = d.project_id AND scope_original.subject = ops.data_obligation.subject AND scope_original.original_source IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ops.data_obligation.original_source AND scope_original.analyzed_scope = ops.data_obligation.analyzed_scope AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_original.created_at, scope_original.created_xid, boundary)))) AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.data_obligation.created_at, ops.data_obligation.created_xid, boundary)), 
selected_uses AS 
(SELECT latest.id AS id, latest.demand_id AS demand_id, latest.obligation_id AS obligation_id, latest.fate AS fate, latest.request_id AS request_id, latest.generation AS generation, latest.derivation_id AS derivation_id, latest.selection AS selection, latest.trust_snapshot AS trust_snapshot, latest.created_at AS created_at, latest.created_xid AS created_xid 
FROM scoped_obligations JOIN LATERAL (SELECT ops.demand_use.id AS id, ops.demand_use.demand_id AS demand_id, ops.demand_use.obligation_id AS obligation_id, ops.demand_use.fate AS fate, ops.demand_use.request_id AS request_id, ops.demand_use.generation AS generation, ops.demand_use.derivation_id AS derivation_id, ops.demand_use.selection AS selection, ops.demand_use.trust_snapshot AS trust_snapshot, ops.demand_use.created_at AS created_at, ops.demand_use.created_xid AS created_xid 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE ops.demand_use.obligation_id = scoped_obligations.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.demand_use.created_at, ops.demand_use.created_xid, boundary) ORDER BY ops.demand_use.created_at DESC, ops.demand_use.id DESC 
 LIMIT 1) AS latest ON true), 
selected_output_seed AS 
(SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(selected_uses.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM selected_uses 
WHERE selected_uses.id = p_use AND selected_uses.fate = 'fulfilled' AND ops.ddo_use_valid(selected_uses, boundary)), 
support_closure(kind, id) AS 
(SELECT selected_output_seed.kind AS kind, selected_output_seed.id AS id 
FROM selected_output_seed 
WHERE selected_output_seed.id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT support_edge.kind AS kind, support_edge.id AS id 
FROM support_closure JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN (ops.data_derivation_support.admission_use_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(coalesce(ops.data_derivation_support.admission_use_id, ops.data_derivation_support.support_derivation_id) AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation_support 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation_support.derivation_id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('original' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_derivation_original_support.admission_id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation_original_support 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation_original_support.derivation_id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('episode' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.derivation_id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN 'original' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_id' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id' ELSE selected_support_reference.value ->> 'derivation_id' END AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ops.demand_use.selection['support'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS selected_support_reference(value) ON true 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND true UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_population.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ops.demand_use.selection['populations'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS selected_population_reference(value) ON true JOIN ops.data_population ON ops.data_population.id = (selected_population_reference.value ->> 'population_id') AND ops.data_population.demand_id = ops.demand_use.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND true UNION ALL SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population JOIN ops.demand_use ON ops.demand_use.id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'admission_use_id') AND ops.demand_use.derivation_id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'derivation_id') AND ops.demand_use.demand_id = ops.data_population.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST((ops.data_population.evidence['selection']) ->> 'parent_population_id' AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id) AS support_edge ON true 
WHERE support_edge.id IS NOT NULL), 
selected_whole_outputs AS 
(SELECT DISTINCT ops.data_derivation.id AS derivation_id, ops.data_derivation_output.product_id AS product_id 
FROM ops.data_derivation JOIN ops.data_derivation_output ON ops.data_derivation_output.derivation_id = ops.data_derivation.id JOIN kb.data_product ON kb.data_product.id = ops.data_derivation_output.product_id 
WHERE (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM support_closure 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id)) AND ops.data_derivation_output.member_id IS NULL AND kb.data_product.project_id = d.project_id AND ops.ddo_support_valid(ops.data_derivation.id, boundary) AND ops.ddo_kind_access(kb.data_product.kind_contract) AND ops.ddo_body_access(kb.data_product.kind_contract, kb.data_product.canonical_body))
 SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM selected_whole_outputs 
WHERE selected_whole_outputs.derivation_id = p_derivation AND selected_whole_outputs.product_id = p_product) AS anon_1 INTO admitted;
 IF NOT coalesce(admitted,false) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'event frame is outside exact native selected support' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 SELECT value INTO STRICT chosen FROM jsonb_array_elements(r.binding->'inputs') item(value)
 WHERE value->>'role'='frame' AND value->>'product_id'=p_product AND value->>'member_id' IS NULL AND (value->>'multiplicity')::integer=1;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(r.binding->'support') support WHERE support->>'role'='frame' AND support->>'derivation_id'=p_derivation) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'event fit changes exact frame producing support' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT producer FROM ops.data_derivation WHERE id=p_derivation AND outcome='success';
 SELECT * INTO STRICT frame_request FROM ops.data_request WHERE id=producer.request_id AND project_id=r.project_id;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT intent FROM ops.data_completion_intent WHERE id=producer.intent_id
 AND request_id=producer.request_id AND generation=producer.generation;
 IF (intent.producer_task_id,intent.producer_attempt,intent.runtime_id) IS DISTINCT FROM
 (producer.producer_task_id,producer.producer_attempt,producer.runtime_id) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'event frame differs from original producer fences' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 frame_request.release_id:=producer.release_id; frame_request.runtime_id:=producer.runtime_id;
 frame_request.recipe:=producer.recipe; frame_request.generation:=producer.generation;
 frame_request.binding:=frame_request.binding||jsonb_build_object('inputs',intent.payload->'inputs','support',intent.payload->'support');
 SELECT * INTO STRICT definition FROM sem.data_operation_definition WHERE release_id=producer.release_id AND operation_id=frame_request.operation_id;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT actual FROM kb.data_product WHERE id=p_product AND project_id=r.project_id;
 IF selected->'reference' IS DISTINCT FROM ops.ddo_structural_product_reference(actual)
 OR data.ddo_json(actual.canonical_body)->>'frame_digest' IS DISTINCT FROM selected->>'frame_digest'
 OR definition.operation_id IS DISTINCT FROM 'operation_event.frame'
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM ops.data_publication_receipt receipt JOIN ops.data_derivation_output output ON output.derivation_id=receipt.derivation_id
 WHERE receipt.derivation_id=producer.id AND receipt.intent_id=intent.id AND output.product_id=p_product AND output.member_id IS NULL AND output.role='frame') THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'event fit lacks actual selected current frame CPU/common receipt' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 PERFORM ops.ddo_require_operation_event_completion(frame_request,intent.payload);
 IF data.ddo_normalize(intent.payload->'outputs'->0->'product'->'body') IS DISTINCT FROM actual.canonical_body THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'event frame differs from actual original CPU completion body' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF body->'specification' IS DISTINCT FROM specification OR body->'result'->>'frame_digest' IS DISTINCT FROM selected->>'frame_digest'
 OR (body->'result'->'parameters' IS NOT NULL AND body->'result'->'parameters'<>'null'::jsonb AND
 (body->'result'->'parameters'->'algorithm' IS DISTINCT FROM specification->'algorithm'
 OR body->'result'->'parameters'->>'frame_digest' IS DISTINCT FROM selected->>'frame_digest')) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'event fit changes actual frame identity or declared algorithm' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
END $event$

DECLARE p jsonb:=p_payload; d ops.data_demand; boundary ops.data_demand_read;
 p_use text:=p->>'use_id'; p_product text:=p->>'product_id'; p_derivation text:=p->>'derivation_id';
 scope_key text; epoch bigint; snapshot jsonb:='{}'; admitted boolean; cut jsonb;
 grade jsonb; receipt_id text; result jsonb; definition sem.data_operation_definition;
 episode ops.data_derivation; intent ops.data_completion_intent; variant text:=p->>'variant';
 expected_operation text; expected_factory text; expected_kind text; expected_role text;
BEGIN
 PERFORM ops.ddo_require_feature_fit_principal();
 CASE variant
 WHEN 'record-feature-grade' THEN
 expected_operation:='record_policy.grade'; expected_factory:='corpus_structure.methods.declared_record_policy.RecordPolicyGrade.acquire_port';
 expected_kind:='https://corpus-structure.dev/semantic/data-operation-record-policy/protected/DdoRecordGrade'; expected_role:='grade';
 WHEN 'operation-event-frame' THEN
 expected_operation:='operation_event.frame'; expected_factory:='corpus_structure.methods.operation_events.OperationEventFrame.acquire_port';
 expected_kind:='https://corpus-structure.dev/semantic/operation-events/protected/DdoOperationEventFrame'; expected_role:='frame';
 ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'unknown selected feature fit frame variant' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END CASE;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT d FROM ops.data_demand WHERE id=p->>'demand_id' AND project_id=p->>'project_id';
 SELECT * INTO STRICT boundary FROM ops.data_demand_read WHERE id=p->>'read_id' AND demand_id=d.id;
 p:=p||jsonb_build_object('scope',boundary.scope);
 FOR scope_key IN WITH RECURSIVE source_entries AS 
(SELECT source_entry.value AS entry 
FROM jsonb_each(coalesce(d.selection['source_sets'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB))) AS source_set(key, value) JOIN jsonb_array_elements(source_set.value) AS source_entry(value) ON true), 
direct_sources AS 
(SELECT root.value ->> 'original_source' AS source 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(d.root) AS root(value) UNION SELECT source_entries.entry ->> 'original_source' AS anon_1 
FROM source_entries), 
selected_use_seeds AS 
(SELECT DISTINCT ON (ops.demand_use.obligation_id) ops.demand_use.obligation_id AS obligation_id, ops.demand_use.id AS id, ops.demand_use.fate AS fate 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE ops.demand_use.demand_id = d.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.demand_use.created_at, ops.demand_use.created_xid, boundary) ORDER BY ops.demand_use.obligation_id, ops.demand_use.created_at DESC, ops.demand_use.id DESC), 
support_seed AS 
(SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(selected_use_seeds.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM selected_use_seeds 
WHERE true UNION SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_population.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population 
WHERE ops.data_population.demand_id = d.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.data_population.created_at, ops.data_population.created_xid, boundary) UNION SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation JOIN ops.data_derivation_output ON ops.data_derivation_output.derivation_id = ops.data_derivation.id JOIN ops.demand_use ON ops.demand_use.derivation_id = ops.data_derivation.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = d.project_id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM source_entries 
WHERE (source_entries.entry ->> 'product') = ops.data_derivation_output.product_id)) AND ops.demand_use.fate = 'fulfilled' AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.demand_use.created_at, ops.demand_use.created_xid, boundary) UNION SELECT CAST('original' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.original_source_admission.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.original_source_admission 
WHERE ops.original_source_admission.demand_id = d.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.original_source_admission.created_at, ops.original_source_admission.created_xid, boundary)), 
support_closure(kind, id) AS 
(SELECT support_seed.kind AS kind, support_seed.id AS id 
FROM support_seed 
WHERE support_seed.id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT support_edge.kind AS kind, support_edge.id AS id 
FROM support_closure JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN (ops.data_derivation_support.admission_use_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(coalesce(ops.data_derivation_support.admission_use_id, ops.data_derivation_support.support_derivation_id) AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation_support 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation_support.derivation_id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('original' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_derivation_original_support.admission_id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation_original_support 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation_original_support.derivation_id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('episode' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.derivation_id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN 'original' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_id' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id' ELSE selected_support_reference.value ->> 'derivation_id' END AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ops.demand_use.selection['support'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS selected_support_reference(value) ON true 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND true UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_population.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ops.demand_use.selection['populations'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS selected_population_reference(value) ON true JOIN ops.data_population ON ops.data_population.id = (selected_population_reference.value ->> 'population_id') AND ops.data_population.demand_id = ops.demand_use.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND true UNION ALL SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population JOIN ops.demand_use ON ops.demand_use.id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'admission_use_id') AND ops.demand_use.derivation_id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'derivation_id') AND ops.demand_use.demand_id = ops.data_population.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST((ops.data_population.evidence['selection']) ->> 'parent_population_id' AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id) AS support_edge ON true 
WHERE support_edge.id IS NOT NULL), 
support_sources AS 
(SELECT direct_sources.source AS source 
FROM direct_sources UNION SELECT ops.data_request.original_source AS source 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.data_derivation ON support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = d.project_id UNION SELECT ops.original_source_admission.original_source AS source 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.original_source_admission ON support_closure.kind = 'original' AND ops.original_source_admission.id = support_closure.id 
WHERE ops.original_source_admission.project_id = d.project_id)
 SELECT ops.ddo_scope(d.project_id, support_sources.source) AS scope 
FROM support_sources UNION SELECT record_grade_scope.scope 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.data_derivation ON support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id JOIN ops.ddo_record_grade_dependency_scopes(ops.data_derivation.id) AS record_grade_scope(scope) ON true 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = d.project_id UNION SELECT record_fit_scope.scope 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.data_derivation ON support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id JOIN ops.ddo_record_fit_dependency_scopes(ops.data_derivation.id) AS record_fit_scope(scope) ON true 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = d.project_id UNION SELECT operation_event_scope.scope 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.data_derivation ON support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id JOIN ops.ddo_operation_event_dependency_scopes(ops.data_derivation.id) AS operation_event_scope(scope) ON true 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = d.project_id ORDER BY scope LOOP
 SELECT s.epoch INTO STRICT epoch FROM ops.data_trust_scope s WHERE s.scope=scope_key AND s.project_id=d.project_id FOR SHARE;
 snapshot:=snapshot||jsonb_build_object(scope_key,epoch);
 END LOOP;
 IF ops.ddo_trust_snapshot_meaning(snapshot) IS DISTINCT FROM ops.ddo_trust_snapshot_meaning(boundary.trust_snapshot) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'feature fit current trust differs from retained cut' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 WITH RECURSIVE scoped_obligations AS 
(SELECT ops.data_obligation.id AS id, ops.data_obligation.demand_id AS demand_id, ops.data_obligation.operation_id AS operation_id, ops.data_obligation.subject AS subject, ops.data_obligation.original_source AS original_source, ops.data_obligation.analyzed_scope AS analyzed_scope, ops.data_obligation.parameters AS parameters, ops.data_obligation.created_at AS created_at, ops.data_obligation.created_xid AS created_xid 
FROM ops.data_obligation 
WHERE ops.data_obligation.demand_id = d.id AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'operation_id') OR ops.data_obligation.operation_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'operation_id')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'subject') OR ops.data_obligation.subject IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'subject')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'original_source') OR ops.data_obligation.original_source IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'original_source')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'product_ids') OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.demand_use AS scope_use JOIN ops.data_derivation_output ON ops.data_derivation_output.derivation_id = scope_use.derivation_id JOIN jsonb_array_elements_text((coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)))['product_ids']) AS scope_product(value) ON ops.data_derivation_output.product_id = scope_product.value 
WHERE scope_use.obligation_id = ops.data_obligation.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_use.created_at, scope_use.created_xid, boundary) AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.demand_use AS scope_later_use 
WHERE scope_later_use.obligation_id = scope_use.obligation_id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_later_use.created_at, scope_later_use.created_xid, boundary) AND (scope_later_use.created_at > scope_use.created_at OR scope_later_use.created_at = scope_use.created_at AND scope_later_use.id > scope_use.id))))) OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.original_source_admission AS scope_original JOIN jsonb_array_elements_text((coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)))['product_ids']) AS scope_product(value) ON scope_original.product_id = scope_product.value 
WHERE scope_original.demand_id = d.id AND scope_original.project_id = d.project_id AND scope_original.subject = ops.data_obligation.subject AND scope_original.original_source IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ops.data_obligation.original_source AND scope_original.analyzed_scope = ops.data_obligation.analyzed_scope AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_original.created_at, scope_original.created_xid, boundary)))) AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.data_obligation.created_at, ops.data_obligation.created_xid, boundary)), 
selected_uses AS 
(SELECT latest.id AS id, latest.demand_id AS demand_id, latest.obligation_id AS obligation_id, latest.fate AS fate, latest.request_id AS request_id, latest.generation AS generation, latest.derivation_id AS derivation_id, latest.selection AS selection, latest.trust_snapshot AS trust_snapshot, latest.created_at AS created_at, latest.created_xid AS created_xid 
FROM scoped_obligations JOIN LATERAL (SELECT ops.demand_use.id AS id, ops.demand_use.demand_id AS demand_id, ops.demand_use.obligation_id AS obligation_id, ops.demand_use.fate AS fate, ops.demand_use.request_id AS request_id, ops.demand_use.generation AS generation, ops.demand_use.derivation_id AS derivation_id, ops.demand_use.selection AS selection, ops.demand_use.trust_snapshot AS trust_snapshot, ops.demand_use.created_at AS created_at, ops.demand_use.created_xid AS created_xid 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE ops.demand_use.obligation_id = scoped_obligations.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.demand_use.created_at, ops.demand_use.created_xid, boundary) ORDER BY ops.demand_use.created_at DESC, ops.demand_use.id DESC 
 LIMIT 1) AS latest ON true), 
selected_output_seed AS 
(SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(selected_uses.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM selected_uses 
WHERE selected_uses.id = p_use AND selected_uses.fate = 'fulfilled' AND ops.ddo_use_valid(selected_uses, boundary)), 
support_closure(kind, id) AS 
(SELECT selected_output_seed.kind AS kind, selected_output_seed.id AS id 
FROM selected_output_seed 
WHERE selected_output_seed.id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT support_edge.kind AS kind, support_edge.id AS id 
FROM support_closure JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN (ops.data_derivation_support.admission_use_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(coalesce(ops.data_derivation_support.admission_use_id, ops.data_derivation_support.support_derivation_id) AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation_support 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation_support.derivation_id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('original' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_derivation_original_support.admission_id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation_original_support 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation_original_support.derivation_id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('episode' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.derivation_id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN 'original' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_id' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id' ELSE selected_support_reference.value ->> 'derivation_id' END AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ops.demand_use.selection['support'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS selected_support_reference(value) ON true 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND true UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_population.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ops.demand_use.selection['populations'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS selected_population_reference(value) ON true JOIN ops.data_population ON ops.data_population.id = (selected_population_reference.value ->> 'population_id') AND ops.data_population.demand_id = ops.demand_use.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND true UNION ALL SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population JOIN ops.demand_use ON ops.demand_use.id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'admission_use_id') AND ops.demand_use.derivation_id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'derivation_id') AND ops.demand_use.demand_id = ops.data_population.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST((ops.data_population.evidence['selection']) ->> 'parent_population_id' AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id) AS support_edge ON true 
WHERE support_edge.id IS NOT NULL), 
selected_whole_outputs AS 
(SELECT DISTINCT ops.data_derivation.id AS derivation_id, ops.data_derivation_output.product_id AS product_id 
FROM ops.data_derivation JOIN ops.data_derivation_output ON ops.data_derivation_output.derivation_id = ops.data_derivation.id JOIN kb.data_product ON kb.data_product.id = ops.data_derivation_output.product_id 
WHERE (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM support_closure 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id)) AND ops.data_derivation_output.member_id IS NULL AND kb.data_product.project_id = d.project_id AND ops.ddo_support_valid(ops.data_derivation.id, boundary) AND ops.ddo_feature_fit_body_access(kb.data_product.kind_contract, kb.data_product.canonical_body))
 SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM selected_whole_outputs 
WHERE selected_whole_outputs.derivation_id = p_derivation AND selected_whole_outputs.product_id = p_product) AS anon_1 INTO admitted;
 IF NOT coalesce(admitted,false) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'feature fit grade is outside exact current selected support' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('demand_id', d.id, 'project_id', d.project_id, 'release_id', d.release_id, 'runtime_id', d.runtime_id, 'selection', d.selection, 'trust_snapshot', boundary.trust_snapshot, 'read_id', boundary.id, 'read_snapshot', boundary.read_snapshot, 'frontier_at', boundary.frontier_at, 'scope', boundary.scope) AS jsonb_build_object_1 INTO cut;
 IF (p->>'cut_canonical_json')::jsonb IS DISTINCT FROM cut
 OR p->>'expected_cut' IS DISTINCT FROM 'cut-selection:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(p->>'cut_canonical_json','UTF8')),'hex') THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'feature fit cut bytes or native pins differ' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT episode FROM ops.data_derivation WHERE id=p_derivation AND outcome='success';
 SELECT operation.* INTO STRICT definition FROM sem.data_operation_definition operation
 JOIN ops.data_request request ON operation.release_id=episode.release_id AND request.operation_id=operation.operation_id
 WHERE request.id=episode.request_id AND request.project_id=d.project_id;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT intent FROM ops.data_completion_intent WHERE id=episode.intent_id
 AND request_id=episode.request_id AND generation=episode.generation;
 IF (intent.producer_task_id,intent.producer_attempt,intent.runtime_id) IS DISTINCT FROM
 (episode.producer_task_id,episode.producer_attempt,episode.runtime_id) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'feature fit frame differs from original producer fences' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 SELECT receipt.id INTO STRICT receipt_id FROM ops.data_publication_receipt receipt
 JOIN ops.data_derivation_output output ON output.derivation_id=receipt.derivation_id
 WHERE receipt.derivation_id=episode.id AND receipt.intent_id=episode.intent_id
 AND output.product_id=p_product AND output.member_id IS NULL AND output.role=expected_role
 AND output.position=0 AND output.multiplicity=1;
 IF definition.operation_id IS DISTINCT FROM expected_operation
 OR definition.profile IS DISTINCT FROM 'derivation'
 OR definition.support_contract->'effects' IS DISTINCT FROM '[]'::jsonb
 OR definition.support_contract->'capabilities'->'prepared_factory'->>'entrypoint' IS DISTINCT FROM expected_factory
 OR (definition.support_contract->'capabilities'->'prepared_factory'->>'source_digest' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') IS NOT TRUE
 OR (definition.implementation_revision LIKE 'implementation-slice:%') IS NOT TRUE
 OR intent.payload->>'implementation_revision' IS DISTINCT FROM definition.implementation_revision
 OR jsonb_array_length(coalesce(intent.payload->'execution_evidence'->'cpu_receipts','[]'))<>1
 OR episode.recipe IS DISTINCT FROM definition.recipe THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'feature fit requires the actual admitted protected grade implementation' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.data_product product JOIN sem.data_kind_contract kind
 ON kind.kind_contract=product.kind_contract WHERE product.id=p_product AND product.project_id=d.project_id
 AND kind.kind=expected_kind AND kind.universe='evaluator') THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'feature fit variant differs from actual protected frame kind' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 SELECT data.ddo_json(product.canonical_body) INTO STRICT grade FROM kb.data_product product WHERE id=p_product AND project_id=d.project_id;
 IF grade->>'frame_digest' IS DISTINCT FROM p->>'frame_digest'
 OR grade->>'frame_digest' IS DISTINCT FROM encode(sha256(convert_to(grade->>'frame_canonical_json','UTF8')),'hex')
 OR (grade->>'frame_canonical_json')::jsonb IS DISTINCT FROM grade->'frame'
 OR (CASE variant WHEN 'record-feature-grade' THEN grade->'frame'->>'project_id'
 ELSE grade->'frame'->'question'->'prediction_selection'->>'project_id' END) IS DISTINCT FROM d.project_id THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'feature fit grade canonical frame differs' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 result:=jsonb_build_object('variant',variant,'cut',cut,'product_id',p_product,'derivation_id',p_derivation,'receipt_id',receipt_id,'frame',grade);
 IF octet_length(data.canonical_json(result))>coalesce((p->>'max_bytes')::bigint,8388608) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'feature fit frame exceeds explicit byte bound' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 RETURN result;
END
