CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ops.ddo_impl_read_selected_feature_fit_frame(p_payload jsonb) RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp' AS $$
DECLARE p jsonb:=p_payload; d ops.data_demand; boundary ops.data_demand_read;
 p_use text:=p->>'use_id'; p_product text:=p->>'product_id'; p_derivation text:=p->>'derivation_id';
 scope_key text; epoch bigint; snapshot jsonb:='{}'; admitted boolean; cut jsonb;
 grade jsonb; receipt_id text; result jsonb; definition sem.data_operation_definition;
 episode ops.data_derivation; intent ops.data_completion_intent; variant text:=p->>'variant';
 expected_operation text; expected_factory text; expected_kind text; expected_role text;
BEGIN
 PERFORM ops.ddo_require_feature_fit_principal();
 CASE variant
 WHEN 'record-feature-grade' THEN
 expected_operation:='record_policy.grade'; expected_factory:='corpus_structure.methods.declared_record_policy.RecordPolicyGrade.acquire_port';
 expected_kind:='https://corpus-structure.dev/semantic/data-operation-record-policy/protected/DdoRecordGrade'; expected_role:='grade';
 WHEN 'operation-event-frame' THEN
 expected_operation:='operation_event.frame'; expected_factory:='corpus_structure.methods.operation_events.OperationEventFrame.acquire_port';
 expected_kind:='https://corpus-structure.dev/semantic/operation-events/protected/DdoOperationEventFrame'; expected_role:='frame';
 ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'unknown selected feature fit frame variant' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END CASE;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT d FROM ops.data_demand WHERE id=p->>'demand_id' AND project_id=p->>'project_id';
 SELECT * INTO STRICT boundary FROM ops.data_demand_read WHERE id=p->>'read_id' AND demand_id=d.id;
 p:=p||jsonb_build_object('scope',boundary.scope);
 FOR scope_key IN WITH RECURSIVE source_entries AS 
(SELECT source_entry.value AS entry 
FROM jsonb_each(coalesce(d.selection['source_sets'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB))) AS source_set(key, value) JOIN jsonb_array_elements(source_set.value) AS source_entry(value) ON true), 
direct_sources AS 
(SELECT root.value ->> 'original_source' AS source 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(d.root) AS root(value) UNION SELECT source_entries.entry ->> 'original_source' AS anon_1 
FROM source_entries), 
selected_use_seeds AS 
(SELECT DISTINCT ON (ops.demand_use.obligation_id) ops.demand_use.obligation_id AS obligation_id, ops.demand_use.id AS id, ops.demand_use.fate AS fate 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE ops.demand_use.demand_id = d.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.demand_use.created_at, ops.demand_use.created_xid, boundary) ORDER BY ops.demand_use.obligation_id, ops.demand_use.created_at DESC, ops.demand_use.id DESC), 
support_seed AS 
(SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(selected_use_seeds.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM selected_use_seeds 
WHERE true UNION SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_population.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population 
WHERE ops.data_population.demand_id = d.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.data_population.created_at, ops.data_population.created_xid, boundary) UNION SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation JOIN ops.data_derivation_output ON ops.data_derivation_output.derivation_id = ops.data_derivation.id JOIN ops.demand_use ON ops.demand_use.derivation_id = ops.data_derivation.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = d.project_id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM source_entries 
WHERE (source_entries.entry ->> 'product') = ops.data_derivation_output.product_id)) AND ops.demand_use.fate = 'fulfilled' AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.demand_use.created_at, ops.demand_use.created_xid, boundary) UNION SELECT CAST('original' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.original_source_admission.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.original_source_admission 
WHERE ops.original_source_admission.demand_id = d.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.original_source_admission.created_at, ops.original_source_admission.created_xid, boundary)), 
support_closure(kind, id) AS 
(SELECT support_seed.kind AS kind, support_seed.id AS id 
FROM support_seed 
WHERE support_seed.id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT support_edge.kind AS kind, support_edge.id AS id 
FROM support_closure JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN (ops.data_derivation_support.admission_use_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(coalesce(ops.data_derivation_support.admission_use_id, ops.data_derivation_support.support_derivation_id) AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation_support 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation_support.derivation_id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('original' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_derivation_original_support.admission_id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation_original_support 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation_original_support.derivation_id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('episode' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.derivation_id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN 'original' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_id' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id' ELSE selected_support_reference.value ->> 'derivation_id' END AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ops.demand_use.selection['support'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS selected_support_reference(value) ON true 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND true UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_population.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ops.demand_use.selection['populations'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS selected_population_reference(value) ON true JOIN ops.data_population ON ops.data_population.id = (selected_population_reference.value ->> 'population_id') AND ops.data_population.demand_id = ops.demand_use.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND true UNION ALL SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population JOIN ops.demand_use ON ops.demand_use.id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'admission_use_id') AND ops.demand_use.derivation_id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'derivation_id') AND ops.demand_use.demand_id = ops.data_population.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST((ops.data_population.evidence['selection']) ->> 'parent_population_id' AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id) AS support_edge ON true 
WHERE support_edge.id IS NOT NULL), 
support_sources AS 
(SELECT direct_sources.source AS source 
FROM direct_sources UNION SELECT ops.data_request.original_source AS source 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.data_derivation ON support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = d.project_id UNION SELECT ops.original_source_admission.original_source AS source 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.original_source_admission ON support_closure.kind = 'original' AND ops.original_source_admission.id = support_closure.id 
WHERE ops.original_source_admission.project_id = d.project_id)
 SELECT ops.ddo_scope(d.project_id, support_sources.source) AS scope 
FROM support_sources UNION SELECT record_grade_scope.scope 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.data_derivation ON support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id JOIN ops.ddo_record_grade_dependency_scopes(ops.data_derivation.id) AS record_grade_scope(scope) ON true 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = d.project_id UNION SELECT record_fit_scope.scope 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.data_derivation ON support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id JOIN ops.ddo_record_fit_dependency_scopes(ops.data_derivation.id) AS record_fit_scope(scope) ON true 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = d.project_id UNION SELECT operation_event_scope.scope 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.data_derivation ON support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id JOIN ops.ddo_operation_event_dependency_scopes(ops.data_derivation.id) AS operation_event_scope(scope) ON true 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = d.project_id ORDER BY scope LOOP
 SELECT s.epoch INTO STRICT epoch FROM ops.data_trust_scope s WHERE s.scope=scope_key AND s.project_id=d.project_id FOR SHARE;
 snapshot:=snapshot||jsonb_build_object(scope_key,epoch);
 END LOOP;
 IF ops.ddo_trust_snapshot_meaning(snapshot) IS DISTINCT FROM ops.ddo_trust_snapshot_meaning(boundary.trust_snapshot) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'feature fit current trust differs from retained cut' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 WITH RECURSIVE scoped_obligations AS 
(SELECT ops.data_obligation.id AS id, ops.data_obligation.demand_id AS demand_id, ops.data_obligation.operation_id AS operation_id, ops.data_obligation.subject AS subject, ops.data_obligation.original_source AS original_source, ops.data_obligation.analyzed_scope AS analyzed_scope, ops.data_obligation.parameters AS parameters, ops.data_obligation.created_at AS created_at, ops.data_obligation.created_xid AS created_xid 
FROM ops.data_obligation 
WHERE ops.data_obligation.demand_id = d.id AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'operation_id') OR ops.data_obligation.operation_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'operation_id')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'subject') OR ops.data_obligation.subject IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'subject')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'original_source') OR ops.data_obligation.original_source IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'original_source')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'product_ids') OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.demand_use AS scope_use JOIN ops.data_derivation_output ON ops.data_derivation_output.derivation_id = scope_use.derivation_id JOIN jsonb_array_elements_text((coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)))['product_ids']) AS scope_product(value) ON ops.data_derivation_output.product_id = scope_product.value 
WHERE scope_use.obligation_id = ops.data_obligation.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_use.created_at, scope_use.created_xid, boundary) AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.demand_use AS scope_later_use 
WHERE scope_later_use.obligation_id = scope_use.obligation_id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_later_use.created_at, scope_later_use.created_xid, boundary) AND (scope_later_use.created_at > scope_use.created_at OR scope_later_use.created_at = scope_use.created_at AND scope_later_use.id > scope_use.id))))) OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.original_source_admission AS scope_original JOIN jsonb_array_elements_text((coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)))['product_ids']) AS scope_product(value) ON scope_original.product_id = scope_product.value 
WHERE scope_original.demand_id = d.id AND scope_original.project_id = d.project_id AND scope_original.subject = ops.data_obligation.subject AND scope_original.original_source IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ops.data_obligation.original_source AND scope_original.analyzed_scope = ops.data_obligation.analyzed_scope AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_original.created_at, scope_original.created_xid, boundary)))) AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.data_obligation.created_at, ops.data_obligation.created_xid, boundary)), 
selected_uses AS 
(SELECT latest.id AS id, latest.demand_id AS demand_id, latest.obligation_id AS obligation_id, latest.fate AS fate, latest.request_id AS request_id, latest.generation AS generation, latest.derivation_id AS derivation_id, latest.selection AS selection, latest.trust_snapshot AS trust_snapshot, latest.created_at AS created_at, latest.created_xid AS created_xid 
FROM scoped_obligations JOIN LATERAL (SELECT ops.demand_use.id AS id, ops.demand_use.demand_id AS demand_id, ops.demand_use.obligation_id AS obligation_id, ops.demand_use.fate AS fate, ops.demand_use.request_id AS request_id, ops.demand_use.generation AS generation, ops.demand_use.derivation_id AS derivation_id, ops.demand_use.selection AS selection, ops.demand_use.trust_snapshot AS trust_snapshot, ops.demand_use.created_at AS created_at, ops.demand_use.created_xid AS created_xid 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE ops.demand_use.obligation_id = scoped_obligations.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.demand_use.created_at, ops.demand_use.created_xid, boundary) ORDER BY ops.demand_use.created_at DESC, ops.demand_use.id DESC 
 LIMIT 1) AS latest ON true), 
selected_output_seed AS 
(SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(selected_uses.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM selected_uses 
WHERE selected_uses.id = p_use AND selected_uses.fate = 'fulfilled' AND ops.ddo_use_valid(selected_uses, boundary)), 
support_closure(kind, id) AS 
(SELECT selected_output_seed.kind AS kind, selected_output_seed.id AS id 
FROM selected_output_seed 
WHERE selected_output_seed.id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT support_edge.kind AS kind, support_edge.id AS id 
FROM support_closure JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN (ops.data_derivation_support.admission_use_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(coalesce(ops.data_derivation_support.admission_use_id, ops.data_derivation_support.support_derivation_id) AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation_support 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation_support.derivation_id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('original' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_derivation_original_support.admission_id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation_original_support 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation_original_support.derivation_id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('episode' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.derivation_id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN 'original' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_id' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id' ELSE selected_support_reference.value ->> 'derivation_id' END AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ops.demand_use.selection['support'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS selected_support_reference(value) ON true 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND true UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_population.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ops.demand_use.selection['populations'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS selected_population_reference(value) ON true JOIN ops.data_population ON ops.data_population.id = (selected_population_reference.value ->> 'population_id') AND ops.data_population.demand_id = ops.demand_use.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND true UNION ALL SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population JOIN ops.demand_use ON ops.demand_use.id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'admission_use_id') AND ops.demand_use.derivation_id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'derivation_id') AND ops.demand_use.demand_id = ops.data_population.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST((ops.data_population.evidence['selection']) ->> 'parent_population_id' AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id) AS support_edge ON true 
WHERE support_edge.id IS NOT NULL), 
selected_whole_outputs AS 
(SELECT DISTINCT ops.data_derivation.id AS derivation_id, ops.data_derivation_output.product_id AS product_id 
FROM ops.data_derivation JOIN ops.data_derivation_output ON ops.data_derivation_output.derivation_id = ops.data_derivation.id JOIN kb.data_product ON kb.data_product.id = ops.data_derivation_output.product_id 
WHERE (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM support_closure 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id)) AND ops.data_derivation_output.member_id IS NULL AND kb.data_product.project_id = d.project_id AND ops.ddo_support_valid(ops.data_derivation.id, boundary) AND ops.ddo_feature_fit_body_access(kb.data_product.kind_contract, kb.data_product.canonical_body))
 SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM selected_whole_outputs 
WHERE selected_whole_outputs.derivation_id = p_derivation AND selected_whole_outputs.product_id = p_product) AS anon_1 INTO admitted;
 IF NOT coalesce(admitted,false) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'feature fit grade is outside exact current selected support' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('demand_id', d.id, 'project_id', d.project_id, 'release_id', d.release_id, 'runtime_id', d.runtime_id, 'selection', d.selection, 'trust_snapshot', boundary.trust_snapshot, 'read_id', boundary.id, 'read_snapshot', boundary.read_snapshot, 'frontier_at', boundary.frontier_at, 'scope', boundary.scope) AS jsonb_build_object_1 INTO cut;
 IF (p->>'cut_canonical_json')::jsonb IS DISTINCT FROM cut
 OR p->>'expected_cut' IS DISTINCT FROM 'cut-selection:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(p->>'cut_canonical_json','UTF8')),'hex') THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'feature fit cut bytes or native pins differ' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT episode FROM ops.data_derivation WHERE id=p_derivation AND outcome='success';
 SELECT operation.* INTO STRICT definition FROM sem.data_operation_definition operation
 JOIN ops.data_request request ON operation.release_id=episode.release_id AND request.operation_id=operation.operation_id
 WHERE request.id=episode.request_id AND request.project_id=d.project_id;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT intent FROM ops.data_completion_intent WHERE id=episode.intent_id
 AND request_id=episode.request_id AND generation=episode.generation;
 IF (intent.producer_task_id,intent.producer_attempt,intent.runtime_id) IS DISTINCT FROM
 (episode.producer_task_id,episode.producer_attempt,episode.runtime_id) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'feature fit frame differs from original producer fences' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 SELECT receipt.id INTO STRICT receipt_id FROM ops.data_publication_receipt receipt
 JOIN ops.data_derivation_output output ON output.derivation_id=receipt.derivation_id
 WHERE receipt.derivation_id=episode.id AND receipt.intent_id=episode.intent_id
 AND output.product_id=p_product AND output.member_id IS NULL AND output.role=expected_role
 AND output.position=0 AND output.multiplicity=1;
 IF definition.operation_id IS DISTINCT FROM expected_operation
 OR definition.profile IS DISTINCT FROM 'derivation'
 OR definition.support_contract->'effects' IS DISTINCT FROM '[]'::jsonb
 OR definition.support_contract->'capabilities'->'prepared_factory'->>'entrypoint' IS DISTINCT FROM expected_factory
 OR (definition.support_contract->'capabilities'->'prepared_factory'->>'source_digest' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') IS NOT TRUE
 OR (definition.implementation_revision LIKE 'implementation-slice:%') IS NOT TRUE
 OR intent.payload->>'implementation_revision' IS DISTINCT FROM definition.implementation_revision
 OR jsonb_array_length(coalesce(intent.payload->'execution_evidence'->'cpu_receipts','[]'))<>1
 OR episode.recipe IS DISTINCT FROM definition.recipe THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'feature fit requires the actual admitted protected grade implementation' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.data_product product JOIN sem.data_kind_contract kind
 ON kind.kind_contract=product.kind_contract WHERE product.id=p_product AND product.project_id=d.project_id
 AND kind.kind=expected_kind AND kind.universe='evaluator') THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'feature fit variant differs from actual protected frame kind' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 SELECT data.ddo_json(product.canonical_body) INTO STRICT grade FROM kb.data_product product WHERE id=p_product AND project_id=d.project_id;
 IF grade->>'frame_digest' IS DISTINCT FROM p->>'frame_digest'
 OR grade->>'frame_digest' IS DISTINCT FROM encode(sha256(convert_to(grade->>'frame_canonical_json','UTF8')),'hex')
 OR (grade->>'frame_canonical_json')::jsonb IS DISTINCT FROM grade->'frame'
 OR (CASE variant WHEN 'record-feature-grade' THEN grade->'frame'->>'project_id'
 ELSE grade->'frame'->'question'->'prediction_selection'->>'project_id' END) IS DISTINCT FROM d.project_id THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'feature fit grade canonical frame differs' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 result:=jsonb_build_object('variant',variant,'cut',cut,'product_id',p_product,'derivation_id',p_derivation,'receipt_id',receipt_id,'frame',grade);
 IF octet_length(data.canonical_json(result))>coalesce((p->>'max_bytes')::bigint,8388608) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'feature fit frame exceeds explicit byte bound' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 RETURN result;
END $$

DECLARE feature_grade jsonb:=data.ddo_json(feature_meaning); calibration_grade jsonb:=data.ddo_json(calibration_meaning);
 specification jsonb:=data.ddo_json(specification_meaning); basis jsonb:=data.ddo_json(basis_meaning);

 instance_meaning jsonb:=data.ddo_field(basis_meaning,'instance'); instance jsonb:=basis->'instance';
 feature jsonb:=instance->'feature'; calibration jsonb:=instance->'calibration';
 feature_coverage text; calibration_coverage text; judgment_basis text;
 first_positive bigint; first_negative bigint; first_groups bigint; second_positive bigint; second_negative bigint; second_groups bigint; wrong_final boolean;
BEGIN
 feature_coverage:=ops.ddo_digest(first_->'coverage'); calibration_coverage:=ops.ddo_digest(second_->'coverage');
 judgment_basis:=ops.ddo_digest(data.ddo_normalize(jsonb_build_array('sequence',jsonb_build_array(
 jsonb_build_array('string',feature_grade->>'frame_digest'),jsonb_build_array('string',calibration_grade->>'frame_digest'),specification_meaning))));
 IF data.ddo_field(instance_meaning,'feature') IS DISTINCT FROM data.ddo_field(specification_meaning,'frozen_feature')
 OR data.ddo_field(instance_meaning,'threshold') IS DISTINCT FROM data.ddo_field(specification_meaning,'threshold')
 OR data.ddo_field(instance_meaning,'threshold_procedure') IS DISTINCT FROM data.ddo_field(specification_meaning,'threshold_procedure')
 OR data.ddo_field(instance_meaning,'conditioning_assumptions') IS DISTINCT FROM data.ddo_field(specification_meaning,'assumptions')
 OR data.ddo_field(basis_meaning,'applicability') IS DISTINCT FROM data.ddo_field(specification_meaning,'applicability')
 OR data.ddo_field(basis_meaning,'family_contract') IS DISTINCT FROM data.ddo_field(specification_meaning,'family_contract')
 OR data.ddo_field(basis_meaning,'reading_recipe') IS DISTINCT FROM data.ddo_field(specification_meaning,'reading_recipe')
 OR basis->>'judgment_basis_digest' IS DISTINCT FROM judgment_basis THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'fitted policy differs from actual frozen feature, typed specification or judgment basis' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF (first_->>'partition',second_->>'partition') IS DISTINCT FROM ('feature_fit','final_event_calibration')
 OR specification->'feature_selection'->>'frame_digest' IS DISTINCT FROM feature_grade->>'frame_digest'
 OR specification->'calibration_selection'->>'frame_digest' IS DISTINCT FROM calibration_grade->>'frame_digest'
 OR feature_grade->>'frame_digest' IS NOT DISTINCT FROM calibration_grade->>'frame_digest'
 OR first_->>'reference_digest' IS NOT DISTINCT FROM second_->>'reference_digest'
 OR NOT coalesce(second_->'held_out_from' ? (feature_grade->>'frame_digest'),false)
 OR (first_->>'project_id',first_->>'family_contract',first_->>'reading_recipe') IS DISTINCT FROM
 (specification->'applicability'->>'project_id',specification->>'family_contract',specification->>'reading_recipe')
 OR (second_->>'project_id',second_->>'family_contract',second_->>'reading_recipe') IS DISTINCT FROM
 (first_->>'project_id',first_->>'family_contract',first_->>'reading_recipe')
 OR (first_->>'family',first_->>'subset',first_->>'rubric_digest') IS DISTINCT FROM
 (second_->>'family',second_->>'subset',second_->>'rubric_digest') THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'fit inputs differ from actual separate declared grade frames and interpretation' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF (feature->'fit'->>'frame_digest',feature->'fit'->>'reference_digest',feature->'fit'->>'coverage_digest') IS DISTINCT FROM
 (feature_grade->>'frame_digest',first_->>'reference_digest',feature_coverage)
 OR (calibration->'fit'->>'frame_digest',calibration->'fit'->>'reference_digest',calibration->'fit'->>'coverage_digest') IS DISTINCT FROM
 (calibration_grade->>'frame_digest',second_->>'reference_digest',calibration_coverage)
 OR feature->'fit'->>'provenance' IS DISTINCT FROM 'declared-selected-complete-record-grade-1'
 OR calibration->'fit'->>'provenance' IS DISTINCT FROM 'declared-selected-complete-record-grade-1'
 OR feature->'fit'->>'conditioning_assumptions' IS DISTINCT FROM specification->>'assumptions'
 OR calibration->'fit'->>'conditioning_assumptions' IS DISTINCT FROM specification->>'assumptions'
 OR (feature->'applicability'->>'release_id',feature->'applicability'->>'family',feature->'applicability'->>'subset',feature->'applicability'->>'assumptions') IS DISTINCT FROM
 (first_->>'prediction_release_id',first_->>'family',first_->>'subset',specification->>'assumptions')
 OR calibration->>'coverage_digest' IS DISTINCT FROM calibration_coverage
 OR calibration->>'event_procedure' IS DISTINCT FROM specification->>'event_procedure'
 OR calibration->>'assumptions' IS DISTINCT FROM specification->>'assumptions'
 OR calibration->>'feature_instance_digest' IS DISTINCT FROM encode(sha256(convert_to(basis->>'feature_canonical_json','UTF8')),'hex') THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'fitted feature/calibration provenance differs from actual input frames and procedure' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 -- Population facts are conclusions about the exact retained grade, not free
 -- diagnostic labels. The numerical coefficients/convergence remain CPU-owned.
 SELECT count(*) FILTER(WHERE event->>'correct'='true'),count(*) FILTER(WHERE event->>'correct'='false'),count(DISTINCT event->>'origin_group')
 INTO first_positive,first_negative,first_groups FROM jsonb_array_elements(first_->'events') event;
 SELECT count(*) FILTER(WHERE event->>'correct'='true'),count(*) FILTER(WHERE event->>'correct'='false'),count(DISTINCT event->>'origin_group'),
 bool_or(event->'final_event'->>'feature_instance_digest' IS DISTINCT FROM calibration->>'feature_instance_digest'
 OR event->'final_event'->>'event_procedure' IS DISTINCT FROM specification->>'event_procedure')
 INTO second_positive,second_negative,second_groups,wrong_final FROM jsonb_array_elements(second_->'events') event;
 IF (feature->'fit'->>'positive_count')::bigint IS DISTINCT FROM first_positive
 OR (feature->'fit'->>'negative_count')::bigint IS DISTINCT FROM first_negative
 OR (calibration->'fit'->>'positive_count')::bigint IS DISTINCT FROM second_positive
 OR (calibration->'fit'->>'negative_count')::bigint IS DISTINCT FROM second_negative
 OR (feature->'fit'->>'declared_origin_group_count')::bigint IS DISTINCT FROM first_groups
 OR (calibration->'fit'->>'declared_origin_group_count')::bigint IS DISTINCT FROM second_groups
 OR coalesce(wrong_final,false) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'fitted diagnostics or final events differ from complete actual grade populations' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(first_->'origin_groups') a CROSS JOIN jsonb_array_elements(second_->'origin_groups') b
 WHERE a->>'origin_group'=b->>'origin_group')
 OR EXISTS(WITH a AS (SELECT value->'source'->>'original_source' id FROM jsonb_array_elements(first_->'origin_groups')
 UNION SELECT copy->>'original_source' FROM jsonb_array_elements(first_->'origin_groups') origin_ CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(origin_->'copied_from') copy),
 b AS (SELECT value->'source'->>'original_source' id FROM jsonb_array_elements(second_->'origin_groups')
 UNION SELECT copy->>'original_source' FROM jsonb_array_elements(second_->'origin_groups') origin_ CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(origin_->'copied_from') copy)
 SELECT FROM a JOIN b USING(id)) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'fit and calibration share an original, known copied source or origin group' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
END

DECLARE p jsonb:=jsonb_build_object('scope',boundary.scope); node record;
BEGIN
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(d.selection->'operations') selected
 WHERE selected->>'operation' IN ('record_policy.fit','record_policy.authorize')) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'fit grade selection cannot select a fit or authorization census' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 FOR node IN WITH RECURSIVE selected_use_seeds AS 
(SELECT DISTINCT ON (ops.demand_use.obligation_id) ops.demand_use.obligation_id AS obligation_id, ops.demand_use.id AS id, ops.demand_use.fate AS fate 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE ops.demand_use.demand_id = d.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.demand_use.created_at, ops.demand_use.created_xid, boundary) ORDER BY ops.demand_use.obligation_id, ops.demand_use.created_at DESC, ops.demand_use.id DESC), 
source_entries AS 
(SELECT source_entry.value AS entry 
FROM jsonb_each(coalesce(d.selection['source_sets'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB))) AS source_set(key, value) JOIN jsonb_array_elements(source_set.value) AS source_entry(value) ON true), 
support_seed AS 
(SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(selected_use_seeds.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM selected_use_seeds 
WHERE true UNION SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_population.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population 
WHERE ops.data_population.demand_id = d.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.data_population.created_at, ops.data_population.created_xid, boundary) UNION SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation JOIN ops.data_derivation_output ON ops.data_derivation_output.derivation_id = ops.data_derivation.id JOIN ops.demand_use ON ops.demand_use.derivation_id = ops.data_derivation.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = d.project_id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM source_entries 
WHERE (source_entries.entry ->> 'product') = ops.data_derivation_output.product_id)) AND ops.demand_use.fate = 'fulfilled' AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.demand_use.created_at, ops.demand_use.created_xid, boundary) UNION SELECT CAST('original' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.original_source_admission.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.original_source_admission 
WHERE ops.original_source_admission.demand_id = d.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.original_source_admission.created_at, ops.original_source_admission.created_xid, boundary)), 
support_closure(kind, id) AS 
(SELECT support_seed.kind AS kind, support_seed.id AS id 
FROM support_seed 
WHERE support_seed.id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT support_edge.kind AS kind, support_edge.id AS id 
FROM support_closure JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN (ops.data_derivation_support.admission_use_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(coalesce(ops.data_derivation_support.admission_use_id, ops.data_derivation_support.support_derivation_id) AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation_support 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation_support.derivation_id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('original' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_derivation_original_support.admission_id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation_original_support 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation_original_support.derivation_id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('episode' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.derivation_id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN 'original' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_id' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id' ELSE selected_support_reference.value ->> 'derivation_id' END AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ops.demand_use.selection['support'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS selected_support_reference(value) ON true 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND true UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_population.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ops.demand_use.selection['populations'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS selected_population_reference(value) ON true JOIN ops.data_population ON ops.data_population.id = (selected_population_reference.value ->> 'population_id') AND ops.data_population.demand_id = ops.demand_use.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND true UNION ALL SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population JOIN ops.demand_use ON ops.demand_use.id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'admission_use_id') AND ops.demand_use.derivation_id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'derivation_id') AND ops.demand_use.demand_id = ops.data_population.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST((ops.data_population.evidence['selection']) ->> 'parent_population_id' AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id) AS support_edge ON true 
WHERE support_edge.id IS NOT NULL)
 SELECT support_closure.kind, support_closure.id 
FROM support_closure LOOP
 IF node.kind='episode' AND EXISTS(SELECT FROM ops.data_derivation producer JOIN ops.data_request request ON request.id=producer.request_id
 WHERE producer.id=node.id AND (request.operation_id IN ('record_policy.fit','record_policy.authorize')
 OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM ops.data_derivation_output output JOIN kb.data_product product ON product.id=output.product_id
 JOIN sem.data_kind_contract kind ON kind.kind_contract=product.kind_contract WHERE output.derivation_id=producer.id
 AND kind.kind IN ('https://corpus-structure.dev/semantic/data-operation-record-policy/protected/DdoFittedRecordPolicy','https://corpus-structure.dev/semantic/data-operation-record-policy/DdoRecordPolicyAuthorization')))) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'fit grade selection support reaches fitted policy authority' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 END LOOP;
END

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ops.ddo_record_fit_selections(r ops.data_request)
RETURNS TABLE(role_name text,selection jsonb) LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=pg_catalog,pg_temp AS $fit$
DECLARE specification jsonb:=ops.ddo_record_grade_input(r,'specification')->'body'; selected jsonb; name_ text;
BEGIN
 FOR name_,selected IN SELECT 'feature_grade',specification->'feature_selection' UNION ALL SELECT 'calibration_grade',specification->'calibration_selection' LOOP
 IF selected->>'project_id' IS DISTINCT FROM r.project_id
 OR (selected->>'cut_canonical_json')::jsonb->>'project_id' IS DISTINCT FROM r.project_id
 OR (selected->>'cut_canonical_json')::jsonb->>'demand_id' IS DISTINCT FROM selected->>'demand_id'
 OR (selected->>'cut_canonical_json')::jsonb->>'read_id' IS DISTINCT FROM selected->>'read_id'
 OR selected->>'expected_cut' IS DISTINCT FROM 'cut-selection:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(selected->>'cut_canonical_json','UTF8')),'hex') THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'fit selection differs from its actual original project/cut/read pins' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 role_name:=name_; selection:=selected; RETURN NEXT;
 END LOOP;
END $fit$

DECLARE d ops.data_demand; boundary ops.data_demand_read; p jsonb; actual jsonb; scope_key text; current_trust jsonb:='{}'; epoch bigint;

 chosen jsonb; grade jsonb; producer ops.data_derivation; definition sem.data_operation_definition; intent ops.data_completion_intent;
BEGIN
 -- scopes() authenticates the exact project/cut and refuses recursive fit graphs
 -- before invoking ordinary read validity. The enclosing owner locks this same
 -- scope union once in canonical order before request/task fences.
 FOR scope_key IN SELECT * FROM ops.ddo_record_fit_cut_scopes(r.project_id,selection) LOOP
 SELECT coalesce((SELECT scope.epoch FROM ops.data_trust_scope scope WHERE scope.scope=scope_key AND scope.project_id=r.project_id),0) INTO epoch;
 current_trust:=current_trust||jsonb_build_object(scope_key,epoch);
 END LOOP;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT boundary FROM ops.data_demand_read WHERE id=selection->>'read_id' AND demand_id=selection->>'demand_id';
 IF ops.ddo_trust_snapshot_meaning(current_trust) IS DISTINCT FROM ops.ddo_trust_snapshot_meaning(boundary.trust_snapshot) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'fit grade current trust differs from original retained cut' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF NOT authenticate_output THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT d FROM ops.data_demand WHERE id=boundary.demand_id AND project_id=r.project_id;
 p:=jsonb_build_object('scope',boundary.scope);
 WITH RECURSIVE scoped_obligations AS 
(SELECT ops.data_obligation.id AS id, ops.data_obligation.demand_id AS demand_id, ops.data_obligation.operation_id AS operation_id, ops.data_obligation.subject AS subject, ops.data_obligation.original_source AS original_source, ops.data_obligation.analyzed_scope AS analyzed_scope, ops.data_obligation.parameters AS parameters, ops.data_obligation.created_at AS created_at, ops.data_obligation.created_xid AS created_xid 
FROM ops.data_obligation 
WHERE ops.data_obligation.demand_id = d.id AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'operation_id') OR ops.data_obligation.operation_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'operation_id')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'subject') OR ops.data_obligation.subject IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'subject')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'original_source') OR ops.data_obligation.original_source IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'original_source')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'product_ids') OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.demand_use AS scope_use JOIN ops.data_derivation_output ON ops.data_derivation_output.derivation_id = scope_use.derivation_id JOIN jsonb_array_elements_text((coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)))['product_ids']) AS scope_product(value) ON ops.data_derivation_output.product_id = scope_product.value 
WHERE scope_use.obligation_id = ops.data_obligation.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_use.created_at, scope_use.created_xid, boundary) AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.demand_use AS scope_later_use 
WHERE scope_later_use.obligation_id = scope_use.obligation_id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_later_use.created_at, scope_later_use.created_xid, boundary) AND (scope_later_use.created_at > scope_use.created_at OR scope_later_use.created_at = scope_use.created_at AND scope_later_use.id > scope_use.id))))) OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.original_source_admission AS scope_original JOIN jsonb_array_elements_text((coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)))['product_ids']) AS scope_product(value) ON scope_original.product_id = scope_product.value

(SELECT latest.id AS id, latest.demand_id AS demand_id, latest.obligation_id AS obligation_id, latest.fate AS fate, latest.request_id AS request_id, latest.generation AS generation, latest.derivation_id AS derivation_id, latest.selection AS selection, latest.trust_snapshot AS trust_snapshot, latest.created_at AS created_at, latest.created_xid AS created_xid 
FROM scoped_obligations JOIN LATERAL (SELECT ops.demand_use.id AS id, ops.demand_use.demand_id AS demand_id, ops.demand_use.obligation_id AS obligation_id, ops.demand_use.fate AS fate, ops.demand_use.request_id AS request_id, ops.demand_use.generation AS generation, ops.demand_use.derivation_id AS derivation_id, ops.demand_use.selection AS selection, ops.demand_use.trust_snapshot AS trust_snapshot, ops.demand_use.created_at AS created_at, ops.demand_use.created_xid AS created_xid

FROM ops.data_derivation_support 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation_support.derivation_id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('original' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_derivation_original_support.admission_id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation_original_support 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation_original_support.derivation_id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('episode' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.derivation_id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN 'original' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_id' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id' ELSE selected_support_reference.value ->> 'derivation_id' END AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ops.demand_use.selection['support'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS selected_support_reference(value) ON true 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND true UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_population.id AS TEXT) AS id

WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND true UNION ALL SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population JOIN ops.demand_use ON ops.demand_use.id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'admission_use_id') AND ops.demand_use.derivation_id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'derivation_id') AND ops.demand_use.demand_id = ops.data_population.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST((ops.data_population.evidence['selection']) ->> 'parent_population_id' AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population

WHERE support_edge.id IS NOT NULL), 
selected_whole_outputs AS 
(SELECT DISTINCT ops.data_derivation.id AS derivation_id, ops.data_derivation_output.product_id AS product_id 
FROM ops.data_derivation JOIN ops.data_derivation_output ON ops.data_derivation_output.derivation_id = ops.data_derivation.id JOIN kb.data_product ON kb.data_product.id = ops.data_derivation_output.product_id 
WHERE (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM support_closure

 SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM selected_whole_outputs 
WHERE selected_whole_outputs.derivation_id = p_derivation AND selected_whole_outputs.product_id = p_product) AS anon_1 INTO admitted;

 WHERE value->>'role'=role_name AND value->>'product_id'=p_product AND value->>'member_id' IS NULL
 AND (value->>'multiplicity')::integer=1;

 WHERE request.id=producer.request_id AND request.project_id=r.project_id AND operation.release_id=producer.release_id;

 AND request_id=producer.request_id AND generation=producer.generation;

 (producer.producer_task_id,producer.producer_attempt,producer.runtime_id) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'fit grade differs from original producer fences' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF definition.operation_id IS DISTINCT FROM 'record_policy.grade' OR definition.profile IS DISTINCT FROM 'derivation'
 OR definition.support_contract->'effects' IS DISTINCT FROM '[]'::jsonb
 OR definition.support_contract->'capabilities'->'prepared_factory'->>'entrypoint' IS DISTINCT FROM 'corpus_structure.methods.declared_record_policy.RecordPolicyGrade.acquire_port'
 OR intent.payload->>'implementation_revision' IS DISTINCT FROM definition.implementation_revision
 OR producer.recipe IS DISTINCT FROM definition.recipe
 OR jsonb_array_length(coalesce(intent.payload->'execution_evidence'->'cpu_receipts','[]'))<>1
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM ops.data_publication_receipt receipt JOIN ops.data_derivation_output output ON output.derivation_id=receipt.derivation_id
 JOIN kb.data_product product ON product.id=output.product_id JOIN sem.data_kind_contract kind ON kind.kind_contract=product.kind_contract
 WHERE receipt.derivation_id=producer.id AND receipt.intent_id=intent.id AND output.product_id=p_product AND output.member_id IS NULL
 AND output.role='grade' AND output.position=0 AND output.multiplicity=1 AND kind.kind='https://corpus-structure.dev/semantic/data-operation-record-policy/protected/DdoRecordGrade' AND kind.universe='evaluator') THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'fit grade lacks actual protected grade CPU/common producer custody' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 SELECT canonical_body INTO STRICT grade FROM kb.data_product WHERE id=p_product AND project_id=r.project_id;
 IF data.ddo_json(grade)->>'frame_digest' IS DISTINCT FROM selection->>'frame_digest'
 OR data.ddo_json(grade)->'frame'->>'partition' IS DISTINCT FROM (CASE WHEN role_name='feature_grade' THEN 'feature_fit' ELSE 'final_event_calibration' END) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'fit grade frame or partition differs from its actual selected input' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 RETURN grade;
END

DECLARE definition sem.data_operation_definition; output jsonb;

 IF r.operation_id IS DISTINCT FROM 'record_policy.fit' THEN RETURN; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT definition FROM sem.data_operation_definition WHERE release_id=r.release_id AND operation_id=r.operation_id;
 IF definition.profile IS DISTINCT FROM 'derivation' OR definition.support_contract->'effects' IS DISTINCT FROM '[]'::jsonb
 OR definition.support_contract->'capabilities'->'prepared_factory'->>'entrypoint' IS DISTINCT FROM 'corpus_structure.methods.declared_record_policy.RecordPolicyFit.acquire_port'
 OR (definition.support_contract->'capabilities'->'prepared_factory'->>'source_digest' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') IS NOT TRUE
 OR (definition.implementation_revision LIKE 'implementation-slice:%') IS NOT TRUE
 OR completion->>'implementation_revision' IS DISTINCT FROM definition.implementation_revision
 OR r.recipe IS DISTINCT FROM definition.recipe
 OR completion->'inputs' IS DISTINCT FROM r.binding->'inputs'
 OR completion->'support' IS DISTINCT FROM r.binding->'support'
 OR jsonb_array_length(coalesce(completion->'execution_evidence'->'cpu_receipts','[]'))<>1 THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'fit completion requires actual protected fit factory/CPU and exact declared inputs' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF completion->>'outcome'='empty' AND completion->'outputs'='[]'::jsonb THEN RETURN; END IF;
 IF completion->>'outcome' IS DISTINCT FROM 'success' OR jsonb_array_length(completion->'outputs')<>1 THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'fit completion requires one fitted scalar or a non-authoritative empty result' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 output:=completion->'outputs'->0;
 IF output->>'role' IS DISTINCT FROM 'fitted' OR output->>'member_id' IS NOT NULL
 OR (output->>'position')::integer IS DISTINCT FROM 0 OR (output->>'multiplicity')::integer IS DISTINCT FROM 1
 OR output->'product'->'members' IS DISTINCT FROM '[]'::jsonb
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM sem.data_kind_contract kind WHERE kind.kind_contract=output->'product'->>'kind_contract'
 AND kind.kind='https://corpus-structure.dev/semantic/data-operation-record-policy/protected/DdoFittedRecordPolicy' AND kind.universe='evaluator') THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'fit output differs from exact protected fitted scalar contract' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
END $fit$

SELECT jsonb_typeof(reference)='object' AND reference ? 'product_id'
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_object_keys(reference) name WHERE name NOT IN ('product_id','member_id'))
 AND jsonb_typeof(reference->'product_id')='string' AND nullif(reference->>'product_id','') IS NOT NULL
 AND (NOT reference ? 'member_id' OR (jsonb_typeof(reference->'member_id')='string' AND nullif(reference->>'member_id','') IS NOT NULL))

statements:
-- Trusted finite interpreter of the frozen shared binding AST. No candidate SQL.
-- Subject association retains the producing member's original subject. A role
-- may bind its declared identifier property to the consuming operation subject.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ops.ddo_semantic_source_reference(reference jsonb) RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE STRICT SET search_path=pg_catalog,pg_temp AS $$
 SELECT jsonb_typeof(reference)='object' AND reference ? 'product_id'
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_object_keys(reference) name WHERE name NOT IN ('product_id','member_id'))
 AND jsonb_typeof(reference->'product_id')='string' AND nullif(reference->>'product_id','') IS NOT NULL
 AND (NOT reference ? 'member_id' OR (jsonb_typeof(reference->'member_id')='string' AND nullif(reference->>'member_id','') IS NOT NULL))
$$

DECLARE rows_ jsonb; following integer; result jsonb;
BEGIN

 IF mapped IS NULL THEN
 IF (p->>'after')::integer<>0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'visual evidence has no mapped continuation' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 result:=jsonb_build_object('kind','rows','items','[]'::jsonb,'next_after',NULL);
 ELSE
 -- Parent-before-child identities and actual cell ownership remain unchanged.
 WITH RECURSIVE entries AS (
 SELECT value body,ordinality::integer ordinal FROM jsonb_array_elements(mapped->'rows') WITH ORDINALITY),
 anchor AS (SELECT body FROM entries WHERE body->>'occurrence_id'=p->>'occurrence_id'),
 cell_root AS (SELECT body->'cells'->((p->>'cell_index')::integer)->>'content_occurrence_id' id FROM anchor),
 subtree AS (
 SELECT body,ordinal FROM entries WHERE body->>'occurrence_id'=(SELECT id FROM cell_root)
 UNION ALL SELECT e.body,e.ordinal FROM entries e JOIN subtree parent ON e.body->>'parent_occurrence_id'=parent.body->>'occurrence_id'),
 text_matches AS (
 SELECT body FROM entries WHERE body->>'kind' IN ('picture_text','picture_description','caption','caption_candidate')
 AND strpos(btrim(regexp_replace(casefold((body->>'text') COLLATE pg_catalog.pg_unicode_fast),U&'[\0009-\000D\001C-\0020\0085\00A0\1680\2000-\200A\2028\2029\202F\205F\3000]+',' ','g'),' '),btrim(regexp_replace(casefold((p->>'query') COLLATE pg_catalog.pg_unicode_fast),U&'[\0009-\000D\001C-\0020\0085\00A0\1680\2000-\200A\2028\2029\202F\205F\3000]+',' ','g'),' '))>0),
 text_ancestors AS (
 SELECT body FROM text_matches UNION ALL SELECT e.body FROM entries e JOIN text_ancestors child
 ON e.body->>'occurrence_id'=child.body->>'parent_occurrence_id'),
 targets AS (
 SELECT body->>'occurrence_id' id FROM text_ancestors WHERE body->>'kind'='picture'
 UNION SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(body->'parser_attachment_occurrence_ids') FROM text_matches
 UNION SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(body->'associated_picture_occurrence_ids') FROM text_matches),
 candidates AS (
 SELECT * FROM entries e WHERE ordinal>(p->>'after')::integer
 AND (p->>'kind' IS NULL OR body->>'kind'=p->>'kind')
 AND (p->>'occurrence_id' IS NULL OR CASE WHEN p->>'cell_index' IS NULL
 THEN body->>'occurrence_id'=p->>'occurrence_id' ELSE ordinal IN (SELECT ordinal FROM subtree) END)
 AND (p->>'query' IS NULL OR (body->>'kind'='picture' AND body->>'occurrence_id' IN (SELECT id FROM targets)))
 AND (jsonb_array_length(p->'regions')=0 OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(p->'regions') region
 WHERE body->'source_region' IS NOT NULL AND body->'source_region'<>'null'::jsonb
 AND (body->'source_region'->>'left')::numeric<(region->>'right')::numeric
 AND (region->>'left')::numeric<(body->'source_region'->>'right')::numeric
 AND (body->'source_region'->>'top')::numeric<(region->>'bottom')::numeric
 AND (region->>'top')::numeric<(body->'source_region'->>'bottom')::numeric))
 ORDER BY ordinal LIMIT (p->>'limit')::integer+1)
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(body ORDER BY ordinal) FILTER(WHERE n<=(p->>'limit')::integer),'[]'::jsonb),
 CASE WHEN max(n)>(p->>'limit')::integer THEN max(ordinal) FILTER(WHERE n<=(p->>'limit')::integer) ELSE NULL END
 INTO rows_,following FROM (SELECT *,row_number() OVER(ORDER BY ordinal) n FROM candidates) ranked;
 IF p->>'occurrence_id' IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(mapped->'rows') e WHERE e->>'occurrence_id'=p->>'occurrence_id') THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'visual occurrence is outside candidate artifact' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF p->>'cell_index' IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(mapped->'rows') e
 WHERE e->>'occurrence_id'=p->>'occurrence_id' AND e->>'kind'='table'
 AND e->'cells'->((p->>'cell_index')::integer)->>'content_occurrence_id' IS NOT NULL) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'visual cell has no exact retained content group' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF (p->>'after')::integer>0 AND jsonb_array_length(rows_)=0 THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'visual continuation is outside selected scope' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 result:=jsonb_build_object('kind','rows','items',rows_,'next_after',following);
 END IF;
 RETURN result;
END

-- BEGIN pdf-context-selection
 WITH RECURSIVE published AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT * FROM ops.read_pdf_published_revision(p_task,p_key,p_digest)
 ), access AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT a.* FROM kb.pdf_record_access a JOIN published p
  ON a.product_id=p.build_id AND a.revision_id=p.build_id
 ), scope_pointers(pointer) AS (
  SELECT unnest(p_pointers) UNION SELECT p_section
  UNION SELECT a.parent_pointer FROM access a JOIN scope_pointers s ON a.pointer=s.pointer
  WHERE a.parent_pointer IS NOT NULL
 ), selected AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT c.* FROM kb.pdf_record_companion c JOIN published p ON c.product_id=p.build_id AND c.revision_id=p.build_id
  WHERE c.family='occurrence' AND c.body->>'pointer'=ANY(p_pointers)
 ), related AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT e.relation_id FROM kb.pdf_record_endpoint e JOIN published p ON e.product_id=p.build_id AND e.revision_id=p.build_id
  JOIN selected c ON c.local_id=e.occurrence_id
  WHERE (e.target_task_id=p_task AND e.target_product_key=p_key AND e.target_content_digest=p_digest)
   OR (e.target_task_id=0 AND e.target_product_key='@self' AND e.target_content_digest='@self')
 ), endpoints AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT e.* FROM kb.pdf_record_endpoint e JOIN published p ON e.product_id=p.build_id AND e.revision_id=p.build_id
  JOIN related r USING(relation_id)
 ), pages AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT (o.body->>'page_no')::bigint AS page_no FROM selected o
  WHERE o.body->>'page_no' ~ '^[0-9]+$'
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT (prov->>'page_no')::bigint FROM access a
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(a.native_json->'prov','[]')) prov
  WHERE a.pointer=ANY(p_pointers) AND prov->>'page_no' ~ '^[0-9]+$'
 ), covered AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT c.* FROM kb.pdf_record_companion c JOIN published p ON c.product_id=p.build_id AND c.revision_id=p.build_id
  WHERE c.family='coverage' AND (c.body->>'scope'='whole_document'
   OR c.body->>'scope' IN (SELECT pointer||':'||membership FROM scope_pointers
    CROSS JOIN (VALUES('direct'),('descendants')) m(membership))
   OR c.body->>'scope' IN (SELECT 'page:'||page_no::text FROM pages)
   OR CASE WHEN c.body->>'scope' ~ '^pages:[0-9]+-[0-9]+$' THEN EXISTS(
    SELECT FROM pages WHERE page_no BETWEEN
     split_part(split_part(c.body->>'scope',':',2),'-',1)::bigint AND
     split_part(split_part(c.body->>'scope',':',2),'-',2)::bigint) ELSE false END)
 ), inputs AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT c.* FROM kb.pdf_record_companion c JOIN published p ON c.product_id=p.build_id AND c.revision_id=p.build_id
  WHERE c.family='input' AND (EXISTS(SELECT FROM endpoints e WHERE e.role<>'output' AND
   (e.target_task_id,e.target_product_key,e.target_content_digest)=
   ((c.body->>'task_id')::bigint,c.body->>'product_key',c.body->>'content_digest')) OR
   c.local_id IN (SELECT support->>'input_index' FROM covered x
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(x.body->'supports','[]')) support))
 ), chosen AS (
  SELECT * FROM selected UNION ALL SELECT * FROM covered UNION ALL SELECT * FROM inputs
  UNION ALL SELECT c.* FROM kb.pdf_record_companion c JOIN published p ON c.product_id=p.build_id AND c.revision_id=p.build_id
   WHERE c.family='relation' AND c.local_id IN (SELECT relation_id FROM related)
  UNION ALL SELECT c.* FROM kb.pdf_record_companion c JOIN published p ON c.product_id=p.build_id AND c.revision_id=p.build_id
   WHERE c.family='mapping_report' AND c.body->>'input_index' IN (SELECT local_id FROM inputs)
 )
 -- END pdf-context-selection
 SELECT c.family,c.local_id,c.ordinal,ops.pdf_companion_body(c.product_id,c.revision_id,c.family,c.local_id,c.body) FROM chosen c

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ops.pdf_stage_owner_current(p_task bigint,p_attempt bigint,p_holder text)
RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path=pg_catalog,pg_temp AS $stage$
DECLARE job ops.task; request ops.data_request;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO job FROM ops.task WHERE id=p_task;
 IF NOT FOUND OR p_attempt IS NULL OR nullif(p_holder,'') IS NULL
 OR job.attempt IS DISTINCT FROM p_attempt OR job.claimed_by IS DISTINCT FROM p_holder
 OR job.status<>'running' OR job.lease_until IS NULL OR job.lease_until<=clock_timestamp() THEN
 RETURN false; END IF;
 IF job.data_request_id IS NULL THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO request FROM ops.data_request WHERE id=job.data_request_id;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 PERFORM ops.ddo_authorize_request(request);
 RETURN request.generation IS NOT DISTINCT FROM job.data_generation
 AND request.live_task_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM job.id
 AND request.release_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM job.release_id
 AND EXISTS(SELECT FROM sem.data_operation_definition definition
 WHERE definition.release_id=request.release_id AND definition.operation_id=request.operation_id
 AND coalesce(ops.ddo_pdf_command_eligible(definition),false))
 AND EXISTS(SELECT FROM ops.demand_use use_ WHERE use_.request_id=request.id
 AND use_.generation=request.generation AND use_.fate='attached'
 AND ops.ddo_demand_active(use_.demand_id))
 AND ops.ddo_support_available(request,request.binding->'support')
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM ops.data_revocation revoked
 WHERE revoked.scope=ops.ddo_scope(request.project_id,request.original_source)
 AND ((revoked.selector_kind='runtime' AND revoked.selector=request.runtime_id)
 OR (revoked.selector_kind='recipe' AND revoked.selector=request.recipe)));
END $stage$

DECLARE owner record; build ops.pdf_stage_build; id text;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO STRICT owner FROM ops.require_pdf_stage_owner(p_task,p_attempt,p_holder);
 PERFORM ops.require_pdf_operation(owner.release_id,'begin_pdf_build');
 IF p_source IS NULL OR p_recipe IS NULL OR p_schema IS DISTINCT FROM
 encode(sha256(ops.pdf_contract_input(owner.release_id,
 'implementation/pdf/docling-validation.schema.json')),'hex')
 OR p_key IS NULL OR p_key=''
 OR octet_length(p_key)>1024 OR NOT
 EXISTS(SELECT FROM ops.source_build s WHERE s.task_id=p_task
 AND s.release_id=owner.release_id AND s.artifact_digest=p_source
 AND (s.recipe_digest=p_recipe OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM ops.pdf_stage_recipe sr
 WHERE sr.task_id=p_task AND sr.source_digest=p_source
 AND sr.root_recipe_digest=s.recipe_digest AND sr.stage_recipe_digest=p_recipe)))
 OR p_source IS DISTINCT FROM owner.source_digest
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.document d WHERE d.id=owner.document_id
 AND d.project_id=owner.project_id AND d.content_hash=p_source) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'private PDF build source custody differs' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 id:=encode(sha256(convert_to(jsonb_build_array(p_task,p_source,p_recipe,p_schema,p_key)::text,
 'UTF8')),'hex');
 INSERT INTO ops.pdf_stage_build VALUES(id,p_task,owner.release_id,p_source,p_recipe,
 p_schema,p_key,p_attempt,p_holder,'open')
 ON CONFLICT(task_id,replay_key) DO NOTHING;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT build FROM ops.pdf_stage_build WHERE task_id=p_task AND replay_key=p_key;
 IF build.build_id IS DISTINCT FROM id OR build.attempt IS DISTINCT FROM p_attempt
 OR build.holder IS DISTINCT FROM p_holder OR
 build.state<>'open' THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'private PDF build replay differs or requires explicit resume' USING
 ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 RETURN NEXT build;
END

 ON CONFLICT(task_id,replay_key) DO NOTHING;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT build FROM ops.pdf_stage_build WHERE task_id=p_task AND replay_key=p_key;
 IF build.build_id IS DISTINCT FROM id OR build.attempt IS DISTINCT FROM p_attempt
 OR build.holder IS DISTINCT FROM p_holder OR
 build.state<>'open' THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'private PDF build replay differs or requires explicit resume' USING
 ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 RETURN NEXT build;
END $stage$

BEGIN
 IF scratch IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_class WHERE oid=scratch
 AND relowner='corpus_sem_publisher'::regrole AND relnamespace=pg_my_temp_schema()
 AND relkind='r' AND relpersistence='t' AND NOT relrowsecurity) OR
 EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgrelid=scratch) OR
 EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_rewrite WHERE ev_class=scratch) OR
 EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_inherits WHERE inhrelid=scratch OR inhparent=scratch) OR
 EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_attrdef WHERE adrelid=scratch) OR
 EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_index WHERE indrelid=scratch) OR
 EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid=scratch
 AND (contype NOT IN ('c','n') OR NOT convalidated)) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'untrusted private PDF scratch' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF ARRAY(SELECT ROW(attnum,attname,atttypid,atttypmod,attnotnull,attgenerated,attidentity)::text
 FROM pg_attribute WHERE attrelid=scratch AND attnum>0 AND NOT attisdropped ORDER BY attnum)
 IS DISTINCT FROM
 ARRAY(SELECT ROW(attnum,attname,atttypid,atttypmod,attnotnull,attgenerated,attidentity)::text
 FROM pg_attribute WHERE attrelid=p_relation AND attnum>0 AND NOT attisdropped ORDER BY attnum)
 OR ARRAY(SELECT pg_get_constraintdef(oid,true) FROM pg_constraint
 WHERE conrelid=scratch AND contype='c' ORDER BY 1) IS DISTINCT FROM
 ARRAY(SELECT pg_get_constraintdef(oid,true) FROM pg_constraint
 WHERE conrelid=p_relation AND contype='c' ORDER BY 1) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'private PDF scratch schema differs' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
END
