DECLARE bad_owner_ boolean; unreachable_ boolean;
BEGIN
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_native n WHERE n.product_id=p_build AND
 n.revision_id=p_build AND
 ops.pdf_native_record_shape(n.native_type,n.scalars_json,n.structure_json->'fields') IS NOT
 TRUE) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'native schema field/required/primitive constraint differs' USING
 ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_native n WHERE n.product_id=p_build AND
 n.revision_id=p_build AND
 (jsonb_typeof(n.structure_json->'fields') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR
 EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_each(n.structure_json->'fields') f WHERE f.value->>'kind' NOT IN
 ('object','array','map','parts')) OR
 EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_object_keys(n.scalars_json) k WHERE n.structure_json->'fields' ?
 k))) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid native field decomposition' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_membership m LEFT JOIN kb.pdf_record_native n ON
 n.product_id=p_build AND n.revision_id=p_build AND n.record_id=m.parent_id
 WHERE m.product_id=p_build AND m.revision_id=p_build AND (n.record_id IS NULL OR
 n.structure_json->'fields'->m.field_name->>'kind' NOT IN ('array','map'))) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'membership outside declared collection' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_native n WHERE n.product_id=p_build AND
 n.revision_id=p_build AND n.scalars_json ? 'self_ref'
 GROUP BY n.scalars_json->>'self_ref' HAVING count(*)<>1) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'native self-reference is not unique' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(WITH ref_index AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT reference_id,source_id,native_pointer,native_pointer_stream_id
 FROM kb.pdf_record_reference WHERE product_id=p_build AND revision_id=p_build AND field_name='$ref'
 ) SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_native n LEFT JOIN ref_index r ON r.source_id=n.record_id
 WHERE n.product_id=p_build AND n.revision_id=p_build AND n.native_type IN
 ('RefItem','FineRef') AND
 (r.reference_id IS NULL OR CASE
 WHEN r.native_pointer_stream_id IS NULL
  AND n.structure_json->'fields'->'$ref'->>'stream_id' IS NULL
 THEN (r.native_pointer COLLATE "C" = (n.scalars_json->>'$ref') COLLATE "C") IS NOT TRUE
 ELSE NOT ops.pdf_reference_bytes_equal(p_build,p_build,r.native_pointer,r.native_pointer_stream_id,
 n.scalars_json->>'$ref',n.structure_json->'fields'->'$ref'->>'stream_id') END)) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'native reference index does not correspond to supplied spelling' USING
 ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 WITH RECURSIVE owner_edges AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT n.record_id parent_id,f.value->>'target' child_id FROM kb.pdf_record_native n
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(n.structure_json->'fields') f
 WHERE n.product_id=p_build AND n.revision_id=p_build AND f.value->>'kind'='object'
 UNION ALL SELECT parent_id,record_id FROM kb.pdf_record_membership
 WHERE product_id=p_build AND revision_id=p_build AND value_kind='record'
 ), owner_counts AS (
 SELECT child_id,count(parent_id) owners FROM owner_edges GROUP BY child_id
 ), reachable(record_id) AS (
 SELECT root_id FROM ops.pdf_record_document
 WHERE product_id=p_build AND revision_id=p_build
 UNION SELECT e.child_id FROM reachable r JOIN owner_edges e ON e.parent_id=r.record_id
 ) SELECT COALESCE(bool_or(COALESCE(owners.owners,0)<>CASE WHEN n.record_id=(
 SELECT root_id FROM ops.pdf_record_document
 WHERE product_id=p_build AND revision_id=p_build) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END),true),
 COALESCE(bool_or(reachable.record_id IS NULL),true) INTO bad_owner_,unreachable_
 FROM kb.pdf_record_native n LEFT JOIN owner_counts owners ON owners.child_id=n.record_id
 LEFT JOIN reachable ON reachable.record_id=n.record_id
 WHERE n.product_id=p_build AND n.revision_id=p_build
 ;
 IF bad_owner_ THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'native orphan or repeated containment owner' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF unreachable_ THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'native containment cycle or unreachable record'
 USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_access parent JOIN kb.pdf_record_access child ON
 child.product_id=parent.product_id AND child.revision_id=parent.revision_id
 AND child.parent_pointer=parent.pointer
 WHERE parent.product_id=p_build AND parent.revision_id=p_build AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM
 jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(parent.native_json->'children','[]')) c WHERE
 c->>'$ref'=child.pointer))
 OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_access parent CROSS JOIN LATERAL
 jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(parent.native_json->'children','[]')) c
 LEFT JOIN kb.pdf_record_access child ON child.product_id=p_build AND
 child.revision_id=p_build AND child.pointer=c->>'$ref'
 WHERE parent.product_id=p_build AND parent.revision_id=p_build AND (child.pointer IS NULL OR
 child.parent_pointer IS DISTINCT FROM parent.pointer)) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'native parent/child backpointer differs' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_native n CROSS JOIN LATERAL
 jsonb_each(n.structure_json->'fields') f
 LEFT JOIN kb.pdf_record_native target ON target.product_id=p_build AND
 target.revision_id=p_build AND target.record_id=f.value->>'target'
 WHERE n.product_id=p_build AND n.revision_id=p_build AND f.value->>'kind'='object' AND
 target.record_id IS NULL) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'missing native object target' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(WITH member_counts AS (
 SELECT parent_id,field_name,count(*) count_,min(ordinal) min_,max(ordinal) max_
 FROM kb.pdf_record_membership WHERE product_id=p_build AND revision_id=p_build
 GROUP BY parent_id,field_name
 ) SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_native n CROSS JOIN LATERAL
 jsonb_each(n.structure_json->'fields') f LEFT JOIN member_counts members
 ON members.parent_id=n.record_id AND members.field_name=f.key
 WHERE n.product_id=p_build AND n.revision_id=p_build AND f.value->>'kind' IN ('array','map')
 AND
 (COALESCE(members.count_,0)<>(f.value->>'length')::bigint OR
 (members.count_>0 AND (members.min_<>0 OR members.max_<>members.count_-1)))) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'native ordered membership incomplete' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_native n LEFT JOIN ops.pdf_artifact_stream a ON
 a.product_id=p_build AND a.revision_id=p_build AND a.stream_id=n.native_address_stream_id
 WHERE n.product_id=p_build AND n.revision_id=p_build GROUP BY
 COALESCE(a.byte_length,octet_length(convert_to(n.native_address,'UTF8'))),
 COALESCE(a.byte_root,encode(ops.pdf_identity_byte_root(convert_to(n.native_address,'UTF8')),
 'hex')) HAVING count(*)>1) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'duplicate native address including overflow representation' USING
 ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_membership m LEFT JOIN ops.pdf_artifact_stream s ON
 s.product_id=p_build AND s.revision_id=p_build AND s.stream_id=m.member_key_stream_id
 WHERE m.product_id=p_build AND m.revision_id=p_build AND (m.member_key IS NOT NULL OR
 m.member_key_stream_id IS NOT NULL)
 GROUP BY
 m.parent_id,m.field_name,COALESCE(s.byte_length,octet_length(convert_to(m.member_key,'UTF8'))),
 COALESCE(s.byte_root,encode(ops.pdf_identity_byte_root(convert_to(m.member_key,'UTF8')),
 'hex')) HAVING count(*)>1) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'duplicate native map key including overflow representation' USING
 ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_reference r LEFT JOIN kb.pdf_record_native n
 ON n.product_id=p_build AND n.revision_id=p_build AND n.record_id=r.target_id WHERE
 r.product_id=p_build AND r.revision_id=p_build AND
 (n.record_id IS NULL OR (r.native_pointer IS NOT NULL AND r.field_name NOT IN
 ('source_cell_id','target_cell_id') AND NOT
 ops.pdf_reference_bytes_equal(p_build,p_build,n.native_address,n.native_address_stream_id,
 r.native_pointer,r.native_pointer_stream_id)))) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'native reference/address target differs' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_companion c LEFT JOIN ops.pdf_product input_ ON
 input_.task_id=(c.body->>'task_id')::bigint AND input_.product_key=c.body->>'product_key' AND
 input_.content_digest=c.body->>'content_digest'
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL ops.pdf_task_context(input_.task_id) input_context ON true
 WHERE c.product_id=p_build AND c.revision_id=p_build AND c.family='input' AND
 (input_.task_id IS NULL OR input_.artifact_digest IS DISTINCT FROM p_source OR
 input_context.project_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_project)) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'PDF input outside exact admitted source/project custody' USING
 ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_companion c JOIN ops.pdf_product_body o
 ON o.task_id=(c.body->>'task_id')::bigint AND o.product_key=c.body->>'product_key'
 WHERE c.product_id=p_build AND c.revision_id=p_build AND c.family='input'
 AND o.descriptor->'observation'->>'pass_role' IN ('chandra_page','chandra_crop')) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'visual observation cannot be an input to selected PDF publication' USING
 ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(WITH coverage_claims AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT kb.pdf_record_companion.local_id AS claim_id, kb.pdf_record_companion.body AS body, ops.pdf_frozen_build.kind AS product_kind 
FROM kb.pdf_record_companion JOIN ops.pdf_frozen_build ON ops.pdf_frozen_build.build_id = kb.pdf_record_companion.product_id 
WHERE kb.pdf_record_companion.product_id = p_build AND kb.pdf_record_companion.revision_id = p_build AND kb.pdf_record_companion.family = 'coverage'), 
coverage_support_edges AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT coverage_claims.claim_id AS claim_id, coverage_claims.body ->> 'scope' AS scope, coverage_claims.body ->> 'family' AS family, support.value ->> 'coverage_id' AS coverage_id, support_pin.task_id AS task_id, support_pin.product_key AS product_key, support_publication.build_id AS build_id 
FROM coverage_claims JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(nullif(coverage_claims.body['supports'], 'null'::jsonb), '[]'::jsonb)) AS support ON true LEFT OUTER JOIN kb.pdf_record_companion AS support_input ON support_input.product_id = p_build AND support_input.revision_id = p_build AND support_input.family = 'input' AND support_input.local_id = (support.value ->> 'input_index') LEFT OUTER JOIN ops.pdf_product AS support_pin ON support_pin.task_id = CAST((support_input.body ->> 'task_id') AS BIGINT) AND support_pin.product_key = (support_input.body ->> 'product_key') AND support_pin.content_digest = (support_input.body ->> 'content_digest') LEFT OUTER JOIN ops.pdf_published_revision AS support_publication ON support_publication.task_id = support_pin.task_id AND support_publication.product_key = support_pin.product_key AND support_publication.logical_digest = support_pin.content_digest), 
resolved_coverage_supports AS 
(SELECT coverage_support_edges.claim_id AS claim_id, coverage_support_edges.scope AS scope, coverage_support_edges.family AS family, recorded_coverage.local_id AS coverage_id, recorded_coverage.body AS body 
FROM coverage_support_edges LEFT OUTER JOIN kb.pdf_record_companion AS recorded_coverage ON recorded_coverage.product_id = coverage_support_edges.build_id AND recorded_coverage.revision_id = coverage_support_edges.build_id AND recorded_coverage.family = 'coverage' AND recorded_coverage.local_id = coverage_support_edges.coverage_id 
WHERE coverage_support_edges.build_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT coverage_support_edges.claim_id AS claim_id, coverage_support_edges.scope AS scope, coverage_support_edges.family AS family, retained_coverage.coverage_id AS coverage_id, retained_coverage.body AS body 
FROM coverage_support_edges LEFT OUTER JOIN kb.pdf_product_coverage AS retained_coverage ON retained_coverage.task_id = coverage_support_edges.task_id AND retained_coverage.product_key = coverage_support_edges.product_key AND retained_coverage.coverage_id = coverage_support_edges.coverage_id 
WHERE coverage_support_edges.build_id IS NULL), 
coverage_support_summary AS 
(SELECT resolved_coverage_supports.claim_id AS claim_id, bool_or(NOT (resolved_coverage_supports.coverage_id IS NOT NULL AND resolved_coverage_supports.scope IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (resolved_coverage_supports.body ->> 'scope') AND resolved_coverage_supports.family IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (resolved_coverage_supports.body ->> 'family'))) AS invalid_support, bool_or(resolved_coverage_supports.coverage_id IS NOT NULL AND resolved_coverage_supports.scope IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (resolved_coverage_supports.body ->> 'scope') AND resolved_coverage_supports.family IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (resolved_coverage_supports.body ->> 'family') AND (resolved_coverage_supports.body ->> 'outcome') = 'complete') AS complete_support 
FROM resolved_coverage_supports GROUP BY resolved_coverage_supports.claim_id)
 SELECT 1 AS anon_1 
FROM coverage_claims LEFT OUTER JOIN coverage_support_summary ON coverage_support_summary.claim_id = coverage_claims.claim_id 
WHERE coalesce(coverage_support_summary.invalid_support, false) OR coverage_claims.product_kind = 'integrated' AND (coverage_claims.body ->> 'outcome') = 'complete' AND NOT coalesce(coverage_support_summary.complete_support, false)) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'coverage support differs from exact input coverage scope/family/outcome'
 USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_companion o LEFT JOIN kb.pdf_record_access a ON
 a.product_id=p_build AND a.revision_id=p_build AND a.pointer=o.body->>'pointer' WHERE
 o.product_id=p_build AND o.revision_id=p_build AND o.family='occurrence'
 AND o.body->>'address_space' IN ('native_item','selected_item','native_cell') AND (a.pointer
 IS NULL OR
 (o.body ? 'cell_index' AND (o.body->>'cell_index')::bigint>=GREATEST(
 jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(a.native_json->'data'->'table_cells','[]')),
 jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(a.native_json->'meta'->'tabular_chart'->'chart_data'->'table_cells','[]')))))) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'companion occurrence outside native item/cell inventory' USING
 ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_endpoint e WHERE e.product_id=p_build AND
 e.revision_id=p_build AND
 ((e.target_task_id=0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_companion o WHERE
 o.product_id=p_build AND o.revision_id=p_build AND o.family='occurrence' AND
 o.local_id=e.occurrence_id)) OR
 (e.target_task_id<>0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM ops.pdf_product p WHERE
 p.task_id=e.target_task_id AND p.product_key=e.target_product_key AND
 p.content_digest=e.target_content_digest AND (EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_occurrence o WHERE
 o.task_id=p.task_id AND o.product_key=p.product_key AND o.occurrence_id=e.occurrence_id) OR
 EXISTS(SELECT FROM ops.pdf_published_revision pr JOIN kb.pdf_record_companion c ON
 c.product_id=pr.build_id AND c.revision_id=pr.build_id
 WHERE pr.task_id=p.task_id AND pr.product_key=p.product_key AND
 pr.logical_digest=p.content_digest AND c.family='occurrence' AND
 c.local_id=e.occurrence_id)))))) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'companion endpoint outside admitted occurrence inventory' USING
 ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_companion c WHERE c.product_id=p_build AND
 c.revision_id=p_build AND c.family='native_metadata'
 AND (c.body ? 'value' OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_companion_field f WHERE
 f.product_id=c.product_id AND f.revision_id=c.revision_id
 AND f.family=c.family AND f.local_id=c.local_id AND f.field_name='value'))) THEN RAISE
 EXCEPTION 'metadata value has no governed byte field'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_companion_field f JOIN kb.pdf_record_companion c
 USING(product_id,revision_id,family,local_id)
 JOIN ops.pdf_artifact_stream a USING(product_id,revision_id,stream_id) WHERE
 f.product_id=p_build AND f.revision_id=p_build
 AND (c.body ? f.field_name OR a.encoding_profile IS DISTINCT FROM CASE WHEN
 f.field_name='value' AND c.body->>'kind'='inline_candidate_pages' THEN 'pdf-ocr-candidate-ipc-v1'
 WHEN f.field_name IN ('value','endpoints') THEN 'pdf-companion-json-field-v1'
 ELSE 'pdf-record-scalar-v1:s'
 END))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid final companion field'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_native n WHERE n.product_id=p_build AND
 n.revision_id=p_build AND n.native_type IN
 ('TextItem','ListItem','SectionHeaderItem','FormulaItem','CodeItem','GroupItem','ListGroup',
 'PictureItem','TableItem')
 AND n.scalars_json ? 'self_ref' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_access a WHERE
 a.product_id=p_build AND a.revision_id=p_build
 AND a.pointer=n.scalars_json->>'self_ref')) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION
 'native access inventory incomplete' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
END

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ops.pdf_check_build_inventory(p_build text,p_source text,p_project text)
RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path=pg_catalog,pg_temp AS $$
DECLARE bad_owner_ boolean; unreachable_ boolean;
BEGIN
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_native n WHERE n.product_id=p_build AND
 n.revision_id=p_build AND
 ops.pdf_native_record_shape(n.native_type,n.scalars_json,n.structure_json->'fields') IS NOT
 TRUE) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'native schema field/required/primitive constraint differs' USING
 ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_native n WHERE n.product_id=p_build AND
 n.revision_id=p_build AND
 (jsonb_typeof(n.structure_json->'fields') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR
 EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_each(n.structure_json->'fields') f WHERE f.value->>'kind' NOT IN
 ('object','array','map','parts')) OR
 EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_object_keys(n.scalars_json) k WHERE n.structure_json->'fields' ?
 k))) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid native field decomposition' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_membership m LEFT JOIN kb.pdf_record_native n ON
 n.product_id=p_build AND n.revision_id=p_build AND n.record_id=m.parent_id
 WHERE m.product_id=p_build AND m.revision_id=p_build AND (n.record_id IS NULL OR
 n.structure_json->'fields'->m.field_name->>'kind' NOT IN ('array','map'))) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'membership outside declared collection' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_native n WHERE n.product_id=p_build AND
 n.revision_id=p_build AND n.scalars_json ? 'self_ref'
 GROUP BY n.scalars_json->>'self_ref' HAVING count(*)<>1) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'native self-reference is not unique' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(WITH ref_index AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT reference_id,source_id,native_pointer,native_pointer_stream_id
 FROM kb.pdf_record_reference WHERE product_id=p_build AND revision_id=p_build AND field_name='$ref'
 ) SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_native n LEFT JOIN ref_index r ON r.source_id=n.record_id
 WHERE n.product_id=p_build AND n.revision_id=p_build AND n.native_type IN
 ('RefItem','FineRef') AND
 (r.reference_id IS NULL OR CASE
 WHEN r.native_pointer_stream_id IS NULL
  AND n.structure_json->'fields'->'$ref'->>'stream_id' IS NULL
 THEN (r.native_pointer COLLATE "C" = (n.scalars_json->>'$ref') COLLATE "C") IS NOT TRUE
 ELSE NOT ops.pdf_reference_bytes_equal(p_build,p_build,r.native_pointer,r.native_pointer_stream_id,
 n.scalars_json->>'$ref',n.structure_json->'fields'->'$ref'->>'stream_id') END)) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'native reference index does not correspond to supplied spelling' USING
 ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 WITH RECURSIVE owner_edges AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT n.record_id parent_id,f.value->>'target' child_id FROM kb.pdf_record_native n
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(n.structure_json->'fields') f
 WHERE n.product_id=p_build AND n.revision_id=p_build AND f.value->>'kind'='object'
 UNION ALL SELECT parent_id,record_id FROM kb.pdf_record_membership
 WHERE product_id=p_build AND revision_id=p_build AND value_kind='record'
 ), owner_counts AS (
 SELECT child_id,count(parent_id) owners FROM owner_edges GROUP BY child_id
 ), reachable(record_id) AS (
 SELECT root_id FROM ops.pdf_record_document
 WHERE product_id=p_build AND revision_id=p_build
 UNION SELECT e.child_id FROM reachable r JOIN owner_edges e ON e.parent_id=r.record_id
 ) SELECT COALESCE(bool_or(COALESCE(owners.owners,0)<>CASE WHEN n.record_id=(
 SELECT root_id FROM ops.pdf_record_document
 WHERE product_id=p_build AND revision_id=p_build) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END),true),
 COALESCE(bool_or(reachable.record_id IS NULL),true) INTO bad_owner_,unreachable_
 FROM kb.pdf_record_native n LEFT JOIN owner_counts owners ON owners.child_id=n.record_id
 LEFT JOIN reachable ON reachable.record_id=n.record_id
 WHERE n.product_id=p_build AND n.revision_id=p_build
 ;
 IF bad_owner_ THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'native orphan or repeated containment owner' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF unreachable_ THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'native containment cycle or unreachable record'
 USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_access parent JOIN kb.pdf_record_access child ON
 child.product_id=parent.product_id AND child.revision_id=parent.revision_id
 AND child.parent_pointer=parent.pointer
 WHERE parent.product_id=p_build AND parent.revision_id=p_build AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM
 jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(parent.native_json->'children','[]')) c WHERE
 c->>'$ref'=child.pointer))
 OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_access parent CROSS JOIN LATERAL
 jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(parent.native_json->'children','[]')) c
 LEFT JOIN kb.pdf_record_access child ON child.product_id=p_build AND
 child.revision_id=p_build AND child.pointer=c->>'$ref'
 WHERE parent.product_id=p_build AND parent.revision_id=p_build AND (child.pointer IS NULL OR
 child.parent_pointer IS DISTINCT FROM parent.pointer)) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'native parent/child backpointer differs' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_native n CROSS JOIN LATERAL
 jsonb_each(n.structure_json->'fields') f
 LEFT JOIN kb.pdf_record_native target ON target.product_id=p_build AND
 target.revision_id=p_build AND target.record_id=f.value->>'target'
 WHERE n.product_id=p_build AND n.revision_id=p_build AND f.value->>'kind'='object' AND
 target.record_id IS NULL) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'missing native object target' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(WITH member_counts AS (
 SELECT parent_id,field_name,count(*) count_,min(ordinal) min_,max(ordinal) max_
 FROM kb.pdf_record_membership WHERE product_id=p_build AND revision_id=p_build
 GROUP BY parent_id,field_name
 ) SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_native n CROSS JOIN LATERAL
 jsonb_each(n.structure_json->'fields') f LEFT JOIN member_counts members
 ON members.parent_id=n.record_id AND members.field_name=f.key
 WHERE n.product_id=p_build AND n.revision_id=p_build AND f.value->>'kind' IN ('array','map')
 AND
 (COALESCE(members.count_,0)<>(f.value->>'length')::bigint OR
 (members.count_>0 AND (members.min_<>0 OR members.max_<>members.count_-1)))) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'native ordered membership incomplete' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_native n LEFT JOIN ops.pdf_artifact_stream a ON
 a.product_id=p_build AND a.revision_id=p_build AND a.stream_id=n.native_address_stream_id
 WHERE n.product_id=p_build AND n.revision_id=p_build GROUP BY
 COALESCE(a.byte_length,octet_length(convert_to(n.native_address,'UTF8'))),
 COALESCE(a.byte_root,encode(ops.pdf_identity_byte_root(convert_to(n.native_address,'UTF8')),
 'hex')) HAVING count(*)>1) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'duplicate native address including overflow representation' USING
 ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_membership m LEFT JOIN ops.pdf_artifact_stream s ON
 s.product_id=p_build AND s.revision_id=p_build AND s.stream_id=m.member_key_stream_id
 WHERE m.product_id=p_build AND m.revision_id=p_build AND (m.member_key IS NOT NULL OR
 m.member_key_stream_id IS NOT NULL)
 GROUP BY
 m.parent_id,m.field_name,COALESCE(s.byte_length,octet_length(convert_to(m.member_key,'UTF8'))),
 COALESCE(s.byte_root,encode(ops.pdf_identity_byte_root(convert_to(m.member_key,'UTF8')),
 'hex')) HAVING count(*)>1) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'duplicate native map key including overflow representation' USING
 ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_reference r LEFT JOIN kb.pdf_record_native n
 ON n.product_id=p_build AND n.revision_id=p_build AND n.record_id=r.target_id WHERE
 r.product_id=p_build AND r.revision_id=p_build AND
 (n.record_id IS NULL OR (r.native_pointer IS NOT NULL AND r.field_name NOT IN
 ('source_cell_id','target_cell_id') AND NOT
 ops.pdf_reference_bytes_equal(p_build,p_build,n.native_address,n.native_address_stream_id,
 r.native_pointer,r.native_pointer_stream_id)))) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'native reference/address target differs' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_companion c LEFT JOIN ops.pdf_product input_ ON
 input_.task_id=(c.body->>'task_id')::bigint AND input_.product_key=c.body->>'product_key' AND
 input_.content_digest=c.body->>'content_digest'
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL ops.pdf_task_context(input_.task_id) input_context ON true
 WHERE c.product_id=p_build AND c.revision_id=p_build AND c.family='input' AND
 (input_.task_id IS NULL OR input_.artifact_digest IS DISTINCT FROM p_source OR
 input_context.project_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_project)) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'PDF input outside exact admitted source/project custody' USING
 ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_companion c JOIN ops.pdf_product_body o
 ON o.task_id=(c.body->>'task_id')::bigint AND o.product_key=c.body->>'product_key'
 WHERE c.product_id=p_build AND c.revision_id=p_build AND c.family='input'
 AND o.descriptor->'observation'->>'pass_role' IN ('chandra_page','chandra_crop')) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'visual observation cannot be an input to selected PDF publication' USING
 ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(WITH coverage_claims AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT kb.pdf_record_companion.local_id AS claim_id, kb.pdf_record_companion.body AS body, ops.pdf_frozen_build.kind AS product_kind 
FROM kb.pdf_record_companion JOIN ops.pdf_frozen_build ON ops.pdf_frozen_build.build_id = kb.pdf_record_companion.product_id 
WHERE kb.pdf_record_companion.product_id = p_build AND kb.pdf_record_companion.revision_id = p_build AND kb.pdf_record_companion.family = 'coverage'), 
coverage_support_edges AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT coverage_claims.claim_id AS claim_id, coverage_claims.body ->> 'scope' AS scope, coverage_claims.body ->> 'family' AS family, support.value ->> 'coverage_id' AS coverage_id, support_pin.task_id AS task_id, support_pin.product_key AS product_key, support_publication.build_id AS build_id 
FROM coverage_claims JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(nullif(coverage_claims.body['supports'], 'null'::jsonb), '[]'::jsonb)) AS support ON true LEFT OUTER JOIN kb.pdf_record_companion AS support_input ON support_input.product_id = p_build AND support_input.revision_id = p_build AND support_input.family = 'input' AND support_input.local_id = (support.value ->> 'input_index') LEFT OUTER JOIN ops.pdf_product AS support_pin ON support_pin.task_id = CAST((support_input.body ->> 'task_id') AS BIGINT) AND support_pin.product_key = (support_input.body ->> 'product_key') AND support_pin.content_digest = (support_input.body ->> 'content_digest') LEFT OUTER JOIN ops.pdf_published_revision AS support_publication ON support_publication.task_id = support_pin.task_id AND support_publication.product_key = support_pin.product_key AND support_publication.logical_digest = support_pin.content_digest), 
resolved_coverage_supports AS 
(SELECT coverage_support_edges.claim_id AS claim_id, coverage_support_edges.scope AS scope, coverage_support_edges.family AS family, recorded_coverage.local_id AS coverage_id, recorded_coverage.body AS body 
FROM coverage_support_edges LEFT OUTER JOIN kb.pdf_record_companion AS recorded_coverage ON recorded_coverage.product_id = coverage_support_edges.build_id AND recorded_coverage.revision_id = coverage_support_edges.build_id AND recorded_coverage.family = 'coverage' AND recorded_coverage.local_id = coverage_support_edges.coverage_id 
WHERE coverage_support_edges.build_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT coverage_support_edges.claim_id AS claim_id, coverage_support_edges.scope AS scope, coverage_support_edges.family AS family, retained_coverage.coverage_id AS coverage_id, retained_coverage.body AS body 
FROM coverage_support_edges LEFT OUTER JOIN kb.pdf_product_coverage AS retained_coverage ON retained_coverage.task_id = coverage_support_edges.task_id AND retained_coverage.product_key = coverage_support_edges.product_key AND retained_coverage.coverage_id = coverage_support_edges.coverage_id 
WHERE coverage_support_edges.build_id IS NULL), 
coverage_support_summary AS 
(SELECT resolved_coverage_supports.claim_id AS claim_id, bool_or(NOT (resolved_coverage_supports.coverage_id IS NOT NULL AND resolved_coverage_supports.scope IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (resolved_coverage_supports.body ->> 'scope') AND resolved_coverage_supports.family IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (resolved_coverage_supports.body ->> 'family'))) AS invalid_support, bool_or(resolved_coverage_supports.coverage_id IS NOT NULL AND resolved_coverage_supports.scope IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (resolved_coverage_supports.body ->> 'scope') AND resolved_coverage_supports.family IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (resolved_coverage_supports.body ->> 'family') AND (resolved_coverage_supports.body ->> 'outcome') = 'complete') AS complete_support 
FROM resolved_coverage_supports GROUP BY resolved_coverage_supports.claim_id)
 SELECT 1 AS anon_1 
FROM coverage_claims LEFT OUTER JOIN coverage_support_summary ON coverage_support_summary.claim_id = coverage_claims.claim_id 
WHERE coalesce(coverage_support_summary.invalid_support, false) OR coverage_claims.product_kind = 'integrated' AND (coverage_claims.body ->> 'outcome') = 'complete' AND NOT coalesce(coverage_support_summary.complete_support, false)) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'coverage support differs from exact input coverage scope/family/outcome'
 USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_companion o LEFT JOIN kb.pdf_record_access a ON

 o.product_id=p_build AND o.revision_id=p_build AND o.family='occurrence'
 AND o.body->>'address_space' IN ('native_item','selected_item','native_cell') AND (a.pointer
 IS NULL OR
 (o.body ? 'cell_index' AND (o.body->>'cell_index')::bigint>=GREATEST(
 jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(a.native_json->'data'->'table_cells','[]')),
 jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(a.native_json->'meta'->'tabular_chart'->'chart_data'->'table_cells','[]')))))) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'companion occurrence outside native item/cell inventory' USING
 ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_endpoint e WHERE e.product_id=p_build AND
 e.revision_id=p_build AND
 ((e.target_task_id=0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_companion o WHERE
 o.product_id=p_build AND o.revision_id=p_build AND o.family='occurrence' AND
 o.local_id=e.occurrence_id)) OR
 (e.target_task_id<>0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM ops.pdf_product p WHERE
 p.task_id=e.target_task_id AND p.product_key=e.target_product_key AND
 p.content_digest=e.target_content_digest AND (EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_occurrence o WHERE
 o.task_id=p.task_id AND o.product_key=p.product_key AND o.occurrence_id=e.occurrence_id) OR
 EXISTS(SELECT FROM ops.pdf_published_revision pr JOIN kb.pdf_record_companion c ON
 c.product_id=pr.build_id AND c.revision_id=pr.build_id
 WHERE pr.task_id=p.task_id AND pr.product_key=p.product_key AND
 pr.logical_digest=p.content_digest AND c.family='occurrence' AND
 c.local_id=e.occurrence_id)))))) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'companion endpoint outside admitted occurrence inventory' USING
 ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_companion c WHERE c.product_id=p_build AND
 c.revision_id=p_build AND c.family='native_metadata'
 AND (c.body ? 'value' OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_companion_field f WHERE
 f.product_id=c.product_id AND f.revision_id=c.revision_id
 AND f.family=c.family AND f.local_id=c.local_id AND f.field_name='value'))) THEN RAISE
 EXCEPTION 'metadata value has no governed byte field'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_companion_field f JOIN kb.pdf_record_companion c
 USING(product_id,revision_id,family,local_id)
 JOIN ops.pdf_artifact_stream a USING(product_id,revision_id,stream_id) WHERE
 f.product_id=p_build AND f.revision_id=p_build
 AND (c.body ? f.field_name OR a.encoding_profile IS DISTINCT FROM CASE WHEN
 f.field_name='value' AND c.body->>'kind'='inline_candidate_pages' THEN 'pdf-ocr-candidate-ipc-v1'
 WHEN f.field_name IN ('value','endpoints') THEN 'pdf-companion-json-field-v1'
 ELSE 'pdf-record-scalar-v1:s'
 END))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid final companion field'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_native n WHERE n.product_id=p_build AND
 n.revision_id=p_build AND n.native_type IN
 ('TextItem','ListItem','SectionHeaderItem','FormulaItem','CodeItem','GroupItem','ListGroup',
 'PictureItem','TableItem')
 AND n.scalars_json ? 'self_ref' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_access a WHERE
 a.product_id=p_build AND a.revision_id=p_build
 AND a.pointer=n.scalars_json->>'self_ref')) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION
 'native access inventory incomplete' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
END $$

DECLARE placement ops.pdf_published_revision;
BEGIN
 IF p_limit IS NULL OR p_limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1000 OR p_pointers IS NULL OR p_family IS NULL OR
 p_family NOT IN ('occurrence','relation','input','coverage','mapping_report','health') THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid published context page' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT placement FROM ops.read_pdf_published_revision(p_task,p_product,p_digest);
 RETURN QUERY
 WITH RECURSIVE published AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT * FROM ops.read_pdf_published_revision(p_task,p_product,p_digest)
 ), access AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT a.* FROM kb.pdf_record_access a JOIN published p
  ON a.product_id=p.build_id AND a.revision_id=p.build_id
 ), scope_pointers(pointer) AS (
  SELECT unnest(p_pointers) UNION SELECT p_section
  UNION SELECT a.parent_pointer FROM access a JOIN scope_pointers s ON a.pointer=s.pointer
  WHERE a.parent_pointer IS NOT NULL
 ), selected AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT c.* FROM kb.pdf_record_companion c JOIN published p ON c.product_id=p.build_id AND c.revision_id=p.build_id
  WHERE c.family='occurrence' AND c.body->>'pointer'=ANY(p_pointers)
 ), related AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT e.relation_id FROM kb.pdf_record_endpoint e JOIN published p ON e.product_id=p.build_id AND e.revision_id=p.build_id
  JOIN selected c ON c.local_id=e.occurrence_id
  WHERE (e.target_task_id=p_task AND e.target_product_key=p_product AND e.target_content_digest=p_digest)
   OR (e.target_task_id=0 AND e.target_product_key='@self' AND e.target_content_digest='@self')
 ), endpoints AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT e.* FROM kb.pdf_record_endpoint e JOIN published p ON e.product_id=p.build_id AND e.revision_id=p.build_id
  JOIN related r USING(relation_id)
 ), pages AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT (o.body->>'page_no')::bigint AS page_no FROM selected o
  WHERE o.body->>'page_no' ~ '^[0-9]+$'
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT (prov->>'page_no')::bigint FROM access a
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(a.native_json->'prov','[]')) prov
  WHERE a.pointer=ANY(p_pointers) AND prov->>'page_no' ~ '^[0-9]+$'
 ), covered AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT c.* FROM kb.pdf_record_companion c JOIN published p ON c.product_id=p.build_id AND c.revision_id=p.build_id
  WHERE c.family='coverage' AND (c.body->>'scope'='whole_document'
   OR c.body->>'scope' IN (SELECT pointer||':'||membership FROM scope_pointers
    CROSS JOIN (VALUES('direct'),('descendants')) m(membership))
   OR c.body->>'scope' IN (SELECT 'page:'||page_no::text FROM pages)
   OR CASE WHEN c.body->>'scope' ~ '^pages:[0-9]+-[0-9]+$' THEN EXISTS(
    SELECT FROM pages WHERE page_no BETWEEN
     split_part(split_part(c.body->>'scope',':',2),'-',1)::bigint AND
     split_part(split_part(c.body->>'scope',':',2),'-',2)::bigint) ELSE false END)
 ), inputs AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT c.* FROM kb.pdf_record_companion c JOIN published p ON c.product_id=p.build_id AND c.revision_id=p.build_id
  WHERE c.family='input' AND (EXISTS(SELECT FROM endpoints e WHERE e.role<>'output' AND
   (e.target_task_id,e.target_product_key,e.target_content_digest)=
   ((c.body->>'task_id')::bigint,c.body->>'product_key',c.body->>'content_digest')) OR
   c.local_id IN (SELECT support->>'input_index' FROM covered x
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(x.body->'supports','[]')) support))
 ), chosen AS (
  SELECT * FROM selected UNION ALL SELECT * FROM covered UNION ALL SELECT * FROM inputs
  UNION ALL SELECT c.* FROM kb.pdf_record_companion c JOIN published p ON c.product_id=p.build_id AND c.revision_id=p.build_id
   WHERE c.family='relation' AND c.local_id IN (SELECT relation_id FROM related)
  UNION ALL SELECT c.* FROM kb.pdf_record_companion c JOIN published p ON c.product_id=p.build_id AND c.revision_id=p.build_id
   WHERE c.family='mapping_report' AND c.body->>'input_index' IN (SELECT local_id FROM inputs)
 ), selected_context AS (
   SELECT c.product_id,c.revision_id,c.family,c.local_id,c.body FROM chosen c
   WHERE c.family=p_family
   UNION ALL
   SELECT c.product_id,c.revision_id,c.family,c.local_id,c.body
    FROM kb.pdf_record_companion c JOIN published p
    ON c.product_id=p.build_id AND c.revision_id=p.build_id
    WHERE p_family='health' AND c.family='health'
 ), requested_page AS MATERIALIZED (
   SELECT c.* FROM selected_context c
   WHERE c.local_id>COALESCE(p_after,'')
   ORDER BY c.local_id LIMIT p_limit
 )
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('local_id',c.local_id,'body',
   ops.pdf_companion_body(c.product_id,c.revision_id,c.family,c.local_id,c.body))
 FROM requested_page c ORDER BY c.local_id;
END

WITH RECURSIVE published AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT * FROM ops.read_pdf_published_revision(p_task,p_product,p_digest)
), nodes AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT n.* FROM kb.pdf_record_native n JOIN published p ON n.product_id=p.build_id AND n.revision_id=p.build_id
), members AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT m.* FROM kb.pdf_record_membership m JOIN published p ON m.product_id=p.build_id AND m.revision_id=p.build_id
), fields AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT record_id,name,value,kind,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY record_id ORDER BY name COLLATE "C")-1 AS slot
 FROM (
 SELECT n.record_id,x.key AS name,x.value,'scalar'::text AS kind FROM nodes n
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(n.scalars_json) x
 UNION ALL
 SELECT n.record_id,x.key,x.value,x.value->>'kind' FROM nodes n
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(n.structure_json->'fields') x
 ) f
), edges AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT f.record_id AS parent_id,f.value->>'target' AS child_id,ARRAY[1,f.slot,1]::bigint[] AS suffix
 FROM fields f WHERE f.kind='object'
 UNION ALL
 SELECT m.parent_id,m.record_id,ARRAY[1,f.slot,1,1,m.ordinal,1]::bigint[] FROM members m
 JOIN fields f ON f.record_id=m.parent_id AND f.name=m.field_name WHERE m.value_kind='record'
), walk(record_id,path) AS (
 SELECT h.root_id,ARRAY[]::bigint[] FROM ops.pdf_record_document h JOIN published p
 ON h.product_id=p.build_id AND h.revision_id=p.build_id
 UNION ALL
 SELECT e.child_id,w.path||e.suffix FROM walk w JOIN edges e ON e.parent_id=w.record_id
), events(path,kind,value,prefix) AS (
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[0]::bigint[],'literal',to_jsonb(CASE WHEN n.native_type='NativeArray' THEN '' ELSE '{' END),''
 FROM walk w JOIN nodes n USING(record_id)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[1,f.slot,0]::bigint[],'literal',to_jsonb(CASE WHEN n.native_type='NativeArray' THEN ''
 ELSE (CASE WHEN f.slot>0 THEN ',' ELSE '' END)||to_jsonb(f.name)::text||':' END),''
 FROM walk w JOIN nodes n USING(record_id) JOIN fields f USING(record_id)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[1,f.slot,1]::bigint[],CASE WHEN f.kind='scalar' THEN 'inline' ELSE 'parts' END,
 CASE WHEN f.kind='scalar' THEN f.value ELSE to_jsonb(f.value->>'stream_id') END,''
 FROM walk w JOIN fields f USING(record_id) WHERE f.kind IN ('scalar','parts')
 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[1,f.slot,1,0]::bigint[],'literal',to_jsonb(CASE WHEN f.kind='map' THEN '{' ELSE '[' END),''
 FROM walk w JOIN fields f USING(record_id) WHERE f.kind IN ('array','map')
 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[1,f.slot,1,1,m.ordinal,0]::bigint[],
 CASE WHEN f.kind='map' AND m.member_key IS NULL THEN 'key_parts' ELSE 'literal' END,
 CASE WHEN f.kind='map' AND m.member_key IS NULL THEN to_jsonb(m.member_key_stream_id)
 ELSE to_jsonb((CASE WHEN m.ordinal>0 THEN ',' ELSE '' END)||
 CASE WHEN f.kind='map' THEN to_jsonb(m.member_key)::text||':' ELSE '' END) END,
 CASE WHEN m.ordinal>0 THEN ',' ELSE '' END
 FROM walk w JOIN fields f USING(record_id) JOIN members m ON m.parent_id=f.record_id AND m.field_name=f.name
 WHERE f.kind IN ('array','map')
 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[1,f.slot,1,1,m.ordinal,1]::bigint[],
 CASE WHEN m.value_kind='scalar' THEN 'inline' ELSE 'parts' END,
 CASE WHEN m.value_kind='scalar' THEN m.scalar_json ELSE to_jsonb(m.stream_id) END,''
 FROM walk w JOIN fields f USING(record_id) JOIN members m ON m.parent_id=f.record_id AND m.field_name=f.name
 WHERE m.value_kind IN ('scalar','parts')
 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[1,f.slot,1,2]::bigint[],'literal',to_jsonb(CASE WHEN f.kind='map' THEN '}' ELSE ']' END),''
 FROM walk w JOIN fields f USING(record_id) WHERE f.kind IN ('array','map')
 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[1,(SELECT count(*) FROM fields f WHERE f.record_id=n.record_id),0]::bigint[],
 'extension',n.structure_json->'extensions'->'stream_id',
 CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT FROM fields f WHERE f.record_id=n.record_id) THEN ',' ELSE '' END
 FROM walk w JOIN nodes n USING(record_id) WHERE n.structure_json ? 'extensions'
 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[2]::bigint[],'literal',to_jsonb(CASE WHEN n.native_type='NativeArray' THEN '' ELSE '}' END),''
 FROM walk w JOIN nodes n USING(record_id)
) SELECT jsonb_build_object('kind',kind,'value',value,'prefix',prefix) FROM events ORDER BY path

 RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid published source context selector' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT published FROM ops.read_pdf_published_revision(p_task,p_key,p_digest);
 -- Budgeted reads count before materialization. Ordinary section contexts use
 -- one set-shaped pass, without repeated scans for each continuation page.
 IF p_row_budget IS NOT NULL THEN
 SELECT count(*)+COALESCE(sum(CASE WHEN c.family='relation' THEN jsonb_array_length(c.body->'endpoints') ELSE 0 END),0)

 IF actual_rows>p_row_budget THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'PDF mandatory companion exceeds requested row budget' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 END IF;
 WITH chosen AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT * FROM ops.pdf_record_context_rows(p_task,p_key,p_digest,p_pointers,p_section)
 ), wrapped AS (
  SELECT c.family,c.ordinal,c.local_id,jsonb_build_object('task_id',p_task,'product_key',p_key)||
  CASE c.family
   WHEN 'input' THEN jsonb_build_object('input_index',c.local_id::bigint,'role',c.body->'role',

   WHEN 'relation' THEN jsonb_build_object('relation_id',c.local_id,'kind',c.body->'kind','body',c.body-'endpoints',

 ), grouped AS (

END

DECLARE publication ops.pdf_published_revision; build ops.pdf_stage_build; context record;
 health jsonb;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO STRICT publication FROM ops.pdf_published_revision
 WHERE build_id=p_receipt->'publication'->>'build_id';
 SELECT * INTO STRICT build FROM ops.pdf_stage_build WHERE build_id=publication.build_id;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT context FROM ops.pdf_task_context(p_task);
 IF p_attempt IS NULL OR p_attempt<1 OR nullif(p_holder,'') IS NULL
 OR to_jsonb(publication) IS DISTINCT FROM p_receipt->'publication'
 OR publication.task_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_task OR build.task_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_task
 OR build.attempt IS DISTINCT FROM (p_receipt->>'publisher_attempt')::bigint
 OR build.holder IS DISTINCT FROM p_receipt->>'publisher_holder'
 OR build.attempt>p_attempt OR (build.attempt=p_attempt AND build.holder IS DISTINCT FROM p_holder)
 OR build.state<>'published' OR (build.release_id,build.source_digest,build.schema_digest,
 build.recipe_digest) IS DISTINCT FROM (publication.release_id,publication.source_digest,
 publication.schema_digest,publication.recipe_digest)
 OR (publication.release_id,publication.source_digest) IS DISTINCT FROM
 (context.release_id,context.source_digest)
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM ops.pdf_frozen_build frozen JOIN ops.pdf_build_validation valid
 ON valid.build_id=frozen.build_id AND valid.frozen_digest=frozen.frozen_digest
 WHERE frozen.build_id=publication.build_id AND frozen.kind=publication.kind
 AND frozen.frozen_digest=publication.frozen_digest AND valid.native_callbacks
 AND valid.logical_digest=publication.logical_digest
 AND valid.native_contract_digest=ops.pdf_validation_contract(publication.release_id)) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'PDF execution receipt differs from actual sealed publisher' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;
 SELECT companion.body INTO STRICT health FROM kb.pdf_record_companion companion
 WHERE companion.product_id=publication.build_id AND companion.revision_id=publication.build_id
 AND companion.family='health' AND companion.body ? 'conversion';
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('document',(SELECT key FROM kb.document WHERE id=context.document_id),
 'source_digest',publication.source_digest,
 'logical_digest',publication.logical_digest,'schema_digest',publication.schema_digest,
 'recipe_digest',publication.recipe_digest,'kind',publication.kind,'health',jsonb_build_object(
 'conversion',health->'conversion','display_coverage',health->'display_coverage',
 'inline_coverage',health->'inline_coverage','cell_coverage',health->'cell_coverage'));
END

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ops.read_pdf_published_validation(p_task bigint, p_key text, p_digest text)
 RETURNS SETOF ops.pdf_build_validation
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
BEGIN ATOMIC
 SELECT pdf_build_validation.build_id,
     pdf_build_validation.frozen_digest,
     pdf_build_validation.logical_digest,
     pdf_build_validation.contract_digest,
     pdf_build_validation.native_callbacks,
     pdf_build_validation.native_contract_digest
    FROM (((((ops.pdf_published_revision
      JOIN ops.pdf_stage_build ON (((pdf_stage_build.build_id = pdf_published_revision.build_id) AND (pdf_stage_build.task_id = pdf_published_revision.task_id) AND (pdf_stage_build.release_id = pdf_published_revision.release_id) AND (pdf_stage_build.source_digest = pdf_published_revision.source_digest) AND (pdf_stage_build.schema_digest = pdf_published_revision.schema_digest) AND (pdf_stage_build.recipe_digest = pdf_published_revision.recipe_digest))))
      JOIN ops.pdf_frozen_build ON (((pdf_frozen_build.build_id = pdf_published_revision.build_id) AND (pdf_frozen_build.frozen_digest = pdf_published_revision.frozen_digest) AND (pdf_frozen_build.kind = pdf_published_revision.kind))))
      JOIN ops.pdf_product ON (((pdf_product.task_id = pdf_published_revision.task_id) AND (pdf_product.product_key = pdf_published_revision.product_key) AND (pdf_product.content_digest = pdf_published_revision.logical_digest) AND (pdf_product.release_id = pdf_published_revision.release_id) AND (pdf_product.artifact_digest = pdf_published_revision.source_digest) AND (pdf_product.kind = pdf_published_revision.kind))))
      JOIN ops.pdf_build_validation ON (((pdf_build_validation.build_id = pdf_published_revision.build_id) AND (pdf_build_validation.frozen_digest = pdf_published_revision.frozen_digest) AND (pdf_build_validation.logical_digest = pdf_published_revision.logical_digest) AND (pdf_build_validation.contract_digest = pdf_product.contract_digest))))
      JOIN ops.pdf_native_validation ON (((pdf_native_validation.build_id = pdf_build_validation.build_id) AND (pdf_native_validation.frozen_digest = pdf_build_validation.frozen_digest) AND (pdf_native_validation.contract_digest = pdf_build_validation.native_contract_digest))))
   WHERE ((pdf_published_revision.task_id = read_pdf_published_validation.p_task) AND (pdf_published_revision.product_key = read_pdf_published_validation.p_key) AND (pdf_published_revision.logical_digest = read_pdf_published_validation.p_digest) AND (pdf_stage_build.state = 'published'::text) AND (pdf_build_validation.native_callbacks IS TRUE) AND (pdf_native_validation.passed IS TRUE));
END

-- pdf-publication-records-v2 over the pdf-record-sha256-fold-v1 algorithm.
-- Only bounded per-record arrays are constructed; the ordered relation cursor spills normally.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ops.pdf_identity_text(p_value text)
RETURNS bytea LANGUAGE plpgsql IMMUTABLE STRICT SET search_path=pg_catalog,pg_temp AS $$
DECLARE payload_ bytea := convert_to(p_value,'UTF8');
BEGIN
 -- PostgreSQL text in a UTF8 database has already passed encoding validation.
 -- Keep the raw-byte validator for SQL_ASCII and every other database encoding.
 IF current_setting('server_encoding')<>'UTF8' THEN
  RETURN ops.pdf_identity_scalar('s',payload_);
 END IF;
 RETURN convert_to('s','UTF8')||int8send(octet_length(payload_)::bigint)||
  ops.pdf_identity_byte_root(payload_);
END $$

catalog.body:
DECLARE stream_ record; digest_ bytea;
BEGIN
 -- The protected validator resolves the optional predecessor from a compatible
 -- sealed receipt. A matching descriptor alone cannot prove its bytes unchanged.
 FOR stream_ IN
  SELECT current_.stream_id FROM ops.pdf_artifact_stream current_
  LEFT JOIN ops.pdf_artifact_stream prior ON prior.product_id=p_verified_predecessor
   AND prior.revision_id=p_verified_predecessor AND prior.stream_id=current_.stream_id
  WHERE current_.product_id=p_product AND current_.revision_id=p_revision
  AND (prior.stream_id IS NULL OR
   ROW(current_.byte_length,current_.serialization_sha256,current_.byte_root,current_.encoding_profile)
    IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(prior.byte_length,prior.serialization_sha256,prior.byte_root,prior.encoding_profile)
   OR EXISTS (
    SELECT FROM (
     SELECT ordinal,byte_offset,byte_length,body,sha256_digest FROM ops.pdf_artifact_part
     WHERE product_id=p_product AND revision_id=p_revision AND stream_id=current_.stream_id
    ) new_part FULL JOIN (
     SELECT ordinal,byte_offset,byte_length,body,sha256_digest FROM ops.pdf_artifact_part
     WHERE product_id=p_verified_predecessor AND revision_id=p_verified_predecessor
      AND stream_id=current_.stream_id
    ) old_part USING (ordinal)
    WHERE new_part IS DISTINCT FROM old_part
   ))
 LOOP
  PERFORM ops.pdf_identity_verify_artifact(p_product,p_revision,stream_.stream_id);
 END LOOP;
 SELECT f INTO STRICT digest_ FROM ops.pdf_record_identity_frames(p_product,p_revision,true) f;
 RETURN encode(digest_,'hex');
END

catalog.body:
BEGIN
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_access a LEFT JOIN kb.pdf_record_native n
 ON n.product_id=p_build AND n.revision_id=p_build AND n.native_address=a.pointer
 WHERE a.product_id=p_build AND (a.revision_id<>p_build OR n.record_id IS NULL OR
 a.native_json->>'self_ref' IS DISTINCT FROM a.pointer OR
 a.label IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(a.native_json->>'label','unspecified') OR
 a.content_layer IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(a.native_json->>'content_layer','body') OR
 a.text IS DISTINCT FROM a.native_json->>'text' OR
 a.parent_pointer IS DISTINCT FROM a.native_json#>>'{parent,$ref}')) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'native access fields do not correspond to frozen native item' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;

 IF EXISTS(WITH RECURSIVE projected(record_id,value) AS (
  SELECT n.record_id,a.native_json FROM kb.pdf_record_access a JOIN kb.pdf_record_native n
  ON n.product_id=p_build AND n.revision_id=p_build AND n.native_address=a.pointer WHERE a.product_id=p_build AND a.revision_id=p_build
  UNION ALL
  SELECT child.record_id,child.value FROM projected w JOIN kb.pdf_record_native n
  ON n.product_id=p_build AND n.revision_id=p_build AND n.record_id=w.record_id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT f.value->>'target' AS record_id,w.value->f.key AS value
   FROM jsonb_each(n.structure_json->'fields') f WHERE f.value->>'kind'='object'
   UNION ALL
   SELECT m.record_id,CASE WHEN f.value->>'kind'='map' THEN container.value->COALESCE(m.member_key,ops.pdf_projection_stream_value(p_build,m.member_key_stream_id)#>>'{}') ELSE container.value->m.ordinal::integer END
   FROM jsonb_each(n.structure_json->'fields') f JOIN kb.pdf_record_membership m
   ON m.product_id=p_build AND m.revision_id=p_build AND m.parent_id=w.record_id AND m.field_name=f.key
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CASE WHEN n.native_type='NativeArray' AND f.key='items' THEN w.value ELSE w.value->f.key END value) container
   WHERE f.value->>'kind' IN ('array','map') AND m.value_kind='record'
  ) child
 ) CYCLE record_id SET cycle_ USING path_
 SELECT FROM projected w LEFT JOIN kb.pdf_record_native n
 ON n.product_id=p_build AND n.revision_id=p_build AND n.record_id=w.record_id
 WHERE w.cycle_ OR n.record_id IS NULL OR w.value IS NULL OR
 (n.native_type='NativeArray' AND jsonb_typeof(w.value)<>'array') OR
 (n.native_type<>'NativeArray' AND (jsonb_typeof(w.value)<>'object' OR
  CASE WHEN n.structure_json ? 'extensions' THEN
    ops.pdf_projection_stream_matches(p_build,n.structure_json->'extensions'->>'stream_id',
     w.value-ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_object_keys(n.scalars_json) UNION SELECT jsonb_object_keys(n.structure_json->'fields'))) IS NOT TRUE
  ELSE w.value-ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_object_keys(n.scalars_json) UNION SELECT jsonb_object_keys(n.structure_json->'fields'))<>'{}'::jsonb END)) OR
 EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_each(n.scalars_json) s WHERE ops.pdf_projection_scalar_matches(w.value->s.key,s.value) IS NOT TRUE) OR
 EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_each(n.structure_json->'fields') f
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CASE WHEN n.native_type='NativeArray' AND f.key='items' THEN w.value ELSE w.value->f.key END value) container
 WHERE container.value IS NULL OR
 (f.value->>'kind'='object' AND jsonb_typeof(container.value)<>'object') OR
 (f.value->>'kind'='parts' AND ops.pdf_projection_stream_matches(p_build,f.value->>'stream_id',container.value) IS NOT TRUE) OR
 (f.value->>'kind'='array' AND (jsonb_typeof(container.value)<>'array' OR jsonb_array_length(container.value)<>(f.value->>'length')::bigint)) OR
 (f.value->>'kind'='map' AND (jsonb_typeof(container.value)<>'object' OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(container.value))<>(f.value->>'length')::bigint)) OR
 EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_membership m
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CASE WHEN f.value->>'kind'='map' THEN container.value->COALESCE(m.member_key,ops.pdf_projection_stream_value(p_build,m.member_key_stream_id)#>>'{}') ELSE container.value->m.ordinal::integer END value) actual
 WHERE m.product_id=p_build AND m.revision_id=p_build AND m.parent_id=w.record_id AND m.field_name=f.key AND
 (actual.value IS NULL OR (m.value_kind='scalar' AND ops.pdf_projection_scalar_matches(actual.value,m.scalar_json) IS NOT TRUE) OR
 (m.value_kind='parts' AND ops.pdf_projection_stream_matches(p_build,m.stream_id,actual.value) IS NOT TRUE))))) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'native access JSON differs from frozen record fields/members/scalars' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;

 -- Each pointer has one parent. Walk each rooted component once, carrying its
 -- nearest section owner. A cycle cannot be reached from a root in this graph,
 -- so missing expected rows detect cycles even when their section owner is null.
 IF EXISTS(WITH RECURSIVE scoped AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT pointer,parent_pointer,label,section_pointer FROM kb.pdf_record_access
  WHERE product_id=p_build AND revision_id=p_build
 ), section_owners(pointer,owner) AS (
  SELECT root.pointer,CASE WHEN root.label IN ('section','chapter') THEN root.pointer END
  FROM scoped root WHERE NOT EXISTS(
   SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_access parent WHERE parent.product_id=p_build
   AND parent.revision_id=p_build AND parent.pointer=root.parent_pointer
  )
  UNION ALL
  SELECT child.pointer,CASE WHEN child.label IN ('section','chapter') THEN child.pointer ELSE parent.owner END
  FROM section_owners parent JOIN scoped child ON child.parent_pointer=parent.pointer
 )
 SELECT pointer,section_pointer FROM scoped
 EXCEPT ALL SELECT pointer,owner FROM section_owners) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'native access section owner differs from native ancestry' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;

 IF EXISTS(WITH RECURSIVE roots(pointer,path) AS (
  SELECT target.scalars_json->>'self_ref',ARRAY[CASE f.key WHEN 'body' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END]::bigint[]
  FROM ops.pdf_record_document h JOIN kb.pdf_record_native root ON root.product_id=p_build AND root.revision_id=p_build AND root.record_id=h.root_id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(root.structure_json->'fields') f JOIN kb.pdf_record_native target
  ON target.product_id=p_build AND target.revision_id=p_build AND target.record_id=f.value->>'target' WHERE h.product_id=p_build AND h.revision_id=p_build AND f.key IN ('body','furniture')
 ), traversal(pointer,path) AS (
 SELECT pointer,path FROM roots UNION ALL
 SELECT c.value->>'$ref',t.path||(c.ordinality-1) FROM traversal t JOIN kb.pdf_record_access a
 ON a.product_id=p_build AND a.revision_id=p_build AND a.pointer=t.pointer CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(a.native_json->'children','[]')) WITH ORDINALITY c
 ) CYCLE pointer SET cycle_ USING cycle_path_
 SELECT FROM (SELECT a.pointer,a.ordinal,row_number() OVER(ORDER BY CASE WHEN t.pointer IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,t.path,a.pointer COLLATE "C")-1 expected,t.cycle_
 FROM kb.pdf_record_access a LEFT JOIN traversal t ON t.pointer=a.pointer WHERE a.product_id=p_build AND a.revision_id=p_build) ordered
 WHERE ordinal<>expected OR cycle_) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'native access order differs from native containment traversal' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;

 IF EXISTS(WITH region_counts AS (
 SELECT pointer,count(*) count_ FROM kb.pdf_record_region
 WHERE product_id=p_build AND revision_id=p_build GROUP BY pointer
 ) SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_access a LEFT JOIN region_counts counts ON counts.pointer=a.pointer
 WHERE a.product_id=p_build AND a.revision_id=p_build AND
 COALESCE(counts.count_,0)<>jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(a.native_json->'prov','[]'))) OR
 EXISTS(WITH page_sizes AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT pages.member_key,page_size.scalars_json AS dimensions
 FROM ops.pdf_record_document h JOIN kb.pdf_record_membership pages
 ON pages.product_id=p_build AND pages.revision_id=p_build
 AND pages.parent_id=h.root_id AND pages.field_name='pages'
 LEFT JOIN kb.pdf_record_native page ON page.product_id=p_build AND page.revision_id=p_build
 AND page.record_id=pages.record_id
 LEFT JOIN kb.pdf_record_native page_size ON page_size.product_id=p_build
 AND page_size.revision_id=p_build
 AND page_size.record_id=page.structure_json->'fields'->'size'->>'target'
 WHERE h.product_id=p_build AND h.revision_id=p_build
 ) SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_region r LEFT JOIN kb.pdf_record_access a ON a.product_id=p_build AND a.revision_id=p_build AND a.pointer=r.pointer
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT a.native_json->'prov'->r.region_index::integer value) prov ON true
 LEFT JOIN page_sizes size ON size.member_key=r.page_no::text
 WHERE r.product_id=p_build AND (r.revision_id<>p_build OR a.pointer IS NULL OR prov.value IS NULL OR
 (prov.value->>'page_no')::bigint IS DISTINCT FROM r.page_no OR
 ops.pdf_projection_scalar_matches(to_jsonb(r.page_width),size.dimensions->'width') IS NOT TRUE OR
 ops.pdf_projection_scalar_matches(to_jsonb(r.page_height),size.dimensions->'height') IS NOT TRUE OR
 to_jsonb(r.left) IS DISTINCT FROM prov.value->'bbox'->'l' OR to_jsonb(r.top) IS DISTINCT FROM prov.value->'bbox'->'t' OR
 to_jsonb(r.right) IS DISTINCT FROM prov.value->'bbox'->'r' OR to_jsonb(r.bottom) IS DISTINCT FROM prov.value->'bbox'->'b' OR
 r.origin IS DISTINCT FROM CASE prov.value->'bbox'->>'coord_origin' WHEN 'TOPLEFT' THEN 'top_left' WHEN 'BOTTOMLEFT' THEN 'bottom_left' END)) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'native access regions differ from native provenance/pages' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
END

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ops.pdf_check_access_correspondence(p_build text)
RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SET search_path=pg_catalog,pg_temp AS $$
BEGIN
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_access a LEFT JOIN kb.pdf_record_native n
 ON n.product_id=p_build AND n.revision_id=p_build AND n.native_address=a.pointer
 WHERE a.product_id=p_build AND (a.revision_id<>p_build OR n.record_id IS NULL OR
 a.native_json->>'self_ref' IS DISTINCT FROM a.pointer OR
 a.label IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(a.native_json->>'label','unspecified') OR
 a.content_layer IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(a.native_json->>'content_layer','body') OR
 a.text IS DISTINCT FROM a.native_json->>'text' OR
 a.parent_pointer IS DISTINCT FROM a.native_json#>>'{parent,$ref}')) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'native access fields do not correspond to frozen native item' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;

 IF EXISTS(WITH RECURSIVE projected(record_id,value) AS (
  SELECT n.record_id,a.native_json FROM kb.pdf_record_access a JOIN kb.pdf_record_native n
  ON n.product_id=p_build AND n.revision_id=p_build AND n.native_address=a.pointer WHERE a.product_id=p_build AND a.revision_id=p_build
  UNION ALL
  SELECT child.record_id,child.value FROM projected w JOIN kb.pdf_record_native n
  ON n.product_id=p_build AND n.revision_id=p_build AND n.record_id=w.record_id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT f.value->>'target' AS record_id,w.value->f.key AS value
   FROM jsonb_each(n.structure_json->'fields') f WHERE f.value->>'kind'='object'
   UNION ALL
   SELECT m.record_id,CASE WHEN f.value->>'kind'='map' THEN container.value->COALESCE(m.member_key,ops.pdf_projection_stream_value(p_build,m.member_key_stream_id)#>>'{}') ELSE container.value->m.ordinal::integer END
   FROM jsonb_each(n.structure_json->'fields') f JOIN kb.pdf_record_membership m
   ON m.product_id=p_build AND m.revision_id=p_build AND m.parent_id=w.record_id AND m.field_name=f.key
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CASE WHEN n.native_type='NativeArray' AND f.key='items' THEN w.value ELSE w.value->f.key END value) container
   WHERE f.value->>'kind' IN ('array','map') AND m.value_kind='record'
  ) child
 ) CYCLE record_id SET cycle_ USING path_
 SELECT FROM projected w LEFT JOIN kb.pdf_record_native n
 ON n.product_id=p_build AND n.revision_id=p_build AND n.record_id=w.record_id
 WHERE w.cycle_ OR n.record_id IS NULL OR w.value IS NULL OR
 (n.native_type='NativeArray' AND jsonb_typeof(w.value)<>'array') OR
 (n.native_type<>'NativeArray' AND (jsonb_typeof(w.value)<>'object' OR
  CASE WHEN n.structure_json ? 'extensions' THEN
    ops.pdf_projection_stream_matches(p_build,n.structure_json->'extensions'->>'stream_id',
     w.value-ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_object_keys(n.scalars_json) UNION SELECT jsonb_object_keys(n.structure_json->'fields'))) IS NOT TRUE
  ELSE w.value-ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_object_keys(n.scalars_json) UNION SELECT jsonb_object_keys(n.structure_json->'fields'))<>'{}'::jsonb END)) OR
 EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_each(n.scalars_json) s WHERE ops.pdf_projection_scalar_matches(w.value->s.key,s.value) IS NOT TRUE) OR
 EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_each(n.structure_json->'fields') f
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CASE WHEN n.native_type='NativeArray' AND f.key='items' THEN w.value ELSE w.value->f.key END value) container
 WHERE container.value IS NULL OR
 (f.value->>'kind'='object' AND jsonb_typeof(container.value)<>'object') OR
 (f.value->>'kind'='parts' AND ops.pdf_projection_stream_matches(p_build,f.value->>'stream_id',container.value) IS NOT TRUE) OR
 (f.value->>'kind'='array' AND (jsonb_typeof(container.value)<>'array' OR jsonb_array_length(container.value)<>(f.value->>'length')::bigint)) OR
 (f.value->>'kind'='map' AND (jsonb_typeof(container.value)<>'object' OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(container.value))<>(f.value->>'length')::bigint)) OR
 EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_membership m
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CASE WHEN f.value->>'kind'='map' THEN container.value->COALESCE(m.member_key,ops.pdf_projection_stream_value(p_build,m.member_key_stream_id)#>>'{}') ELSE container.value->m.ordinal::integer END value) actual
 WHERE m.product_id=p_build AND m.revision_id=p_build AND m.parent_id=w.record_id AND m.field_name=f.key AND
 (actual.value IS NULL OR (m.value_kind='scalar' AND ops.pdf_projection_scalar_matches(actual.value,m.scalar_json) IS NOT TRUE) OR
 (m.value_kind='parts' AND ops.pdf_projection_stream_matches(p_build,m.stream_id,actual.value) IS NOT TRUE))))) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'native access JSON differs from frozen record fields/members/scalars' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;

 -- Each pointer has one parent. Walk each rooted component once, carrying its
 -- nearest section owner. A cycle cannot be reached from a root in this graph,
 -- so missing expected rows detect cycles even when their section owner is null.
 IF EXISTS(WITH RECURSIVE scoped AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT pointer,parent_pointer,label,section_pointer FROM kb.pdf_record_access
  WHERE product_id=p_build AND revision_id=p_build
 ), section_owners(pointer,owner) AS (
  SELECT root.pointer,CASE WHEN root.label IN ('section','chapter') THEN root.pointer END
  FROM scoped root WHERE NOT EXISTS(
   SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_access parent WHERE parent.product_id=p_build
   AND parent.revision_id=p_build AND parent.pointer=root.parent_pointer
  )
  UNION ALL
  SELECT child.pointer,CASE WHEN child.label IN ('section','chapter') THEN child.pointer ELSE parent.owner END
  FROM section_owners parent JOIN scoped child ON child.parent_pointer=parent.pointer
 )
 SELECT pointer,section_pointer FROM scoped
 EXCEPT ALL SELECT pointer,owner FROM section_owners) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'native access section owner differs from native ancestry' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;

 IF EXISTS(WITH RECURSIVE roots(pointer,path) AS (
  SELECT target.scalars_json->>'self_ref',ARRAY[CASE f.key WHEN 'body' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END]::bigint[]
  FROM ops.pdf_record_document h JOIN kb.pdf_record_native root ON root.product_id=p_build AND root.revision_id=p_build AND root.record_id=h.root_id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(root.structure_json->'fields') f JOIN kb.pdf_record_native target
  ON target.product_id=p_build AND target.revision_id=p_build AND target.record_id=f.value->>'target' WHERE h.product_id=p_build AND h.revision_id=p_build AND f.key IN ('body','furniture')
 ), traversal(pointer,path) AS (
 SELECT pointer,path FROM roots UNION ALL
 SELECT c.value->>'$ref',t.path||(c.ordinality-1) FROM traversal t JOIN kb.pdf_record_access a
 ON a.product_id=p_build AND a.revision_id=p_build AND a.pointer=t.pointer CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(a.native_json->'children','[]')) WITH ORDINALITY c
 ) CYCLE pointer SET cycle_ USING cycle_path_
 SELECT FROM (SELECT a.pointer,a.ordinal,row_number() OVER(ORDER BY CASE WHEN t.pointer IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,t.path,a.pointer COLLATE "C")-1 expected,t.cycle_
 FROM kb.pdf_record_access a LEFT JOIN traversal t ON t.pointer=a.pointer WHERE a.product_id=p_build AND a.revision_id=p_build) ordered
 WHERE ordinal<>expected OR cycle_) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'native access order differs from native containment traversal' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;

 IF EXISTS(WITH region_counts AS (
 SELECT pointer,count(*) count_ FROM kb.pdf_record_region
 WHERE product_id=p_build AND revision_id=p_build GROUP BY pointer
 ) SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_access a LEFT JOIN region_counts counts ON counts.pointer=a.pointer
 WHERE a.product_id=p_build AND a.revision_id=p_build AND
 COALESCE(counts.count_,0)<>jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(a.native_json->'prov','[]'))) OR
 EXISTS(WITH page_sizes AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT pages.member_key,page_size.scalars_json AS dimensions
 FROM ops.pdf_record_document h JOIN kb.pdf_record_membership pages
 ON pages.product_id=p_build AND pages.revision_id=p_build
 AND pages.parent_id=h.root_id AND pages.field_name='pages'
 LEFT JOIN kb.pdf_record_native page ON page.product_id=p_build AND page.revision_id=p_build
 AND page.record_id=pages.record_id
 LEFT JOIN kb.pdf_record_native page_size ON page_size.product_id=p_build
 AND page_size.revision_id=p_build
 AND page_size.record_id=page.structure_json->'fields'->'size'->>'target'
 WHERE h.product_id=p_build AND h.revision_id=p_build
 ) SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_region r LEFT JOIN kb.pdf_record_access a ON a.product_id=p_build AND a.revision_id=p_build AND a.pointer=r.pointer
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT a.native_json->'prov'->r.region_index::integer value) prov ON true
 LEFT JOIN page_sizes size ON size.member_key=r.page_no::text
 WHERE r.product_id=p_build AND (r.revision_id<>p_build OR a.pointer IS NULL OR prov.value IS NULL OR
 (prov.value->>'page_no')::bigint IS DISTINCT FROM r.page_no OR
 ops.pdf_projection_scalar_matches(to_jsonb(r.page_width),size.dimensions->'width') IS NOT TRUE OR
 ops.pdf_projection_scalar_matches(to_jsonb(r.page_height),size.dimensions->'height') IS NOT TRUE OR
 to_jsonb(r.left) IS DISTINCT FROM prov.value->'bbox'->'l' OR to_jsonb(r.top) IS DISTINCT FROM prov.value->'bbox'->'t' OR
 to_jsonb(r.right) IS DISTINCT FROM prov.value->'bbox'->'r' OR to_jsonb(r.bottom) IS DISTINCT FROM prov.value->'bbox'->'b' OR
 r.origin IS DISTINCT FROM CASE prov.value->'bbox'->>'coord_origin' WHEN 'TOPLEFT' THEN 'top_left' WHEN 'BOTTOMLEFT' THEN 'bottom_left' END)) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'native access regions differ from native provenance/pages' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
END $$

DECLARE placement ops.pdf_published_revision; selected_body jsonb; relation_body jsonb;
 provider jsonb; observation jsonb; captured text;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO STRICT placement FROM ops.read_pdf_published_revision(p_task,p_key,p_digest);
 SELECT c.body INTO STRICT selected_body FROM ops.pdf_record_context_rows(
  p_task,p_key,p_digest,ARRAY[p_pointer],p_pointer) c
  WHERE c.family='occurrence' AND c.local_id=p_address->>'selected_occurrence_id';
 IF selected_body->>'pointer' IS DISTINCT FROM p_pointer THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'captured recognition selected occurrence differs from source pointer' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 SELECT c.body INTO STRICT relation_body FROM ops.pdf_record_context_rows(
  p_task,p_key,p_digest,ARRAY[p_pointer],p_pointer) c
  WHERE c.family='relation' AND c.local_id=p_address->>'relation_id';
 IF p_address->>'endpoint_role' NOT IN ('input','evidence','alternative')
  OR p_address->>'relation_kind' IS DISTINCT FROM 'decision'
  OR relation_body->>'kind' IS DISTINCT FROM p_address->>'relation_kind'
  OR relation_body->>'outcome' IS DISTINCT FROM p_address->>'relation_outcome'
  OR relation_body->>'outcome' NOT IN ('selected','added','replaced','retained_alternative')
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_endpoint e WHERE e.product_id=placement.build_id
   AND e.revision_id=placement.build_id AND e.relation_id=p_address->>'relation_id'
   AND e.role='output' AND e.occurrence_id=p_address->>'selected_occurrence_id'
   AND ((e.target_task_id,e.target_product_key,e.target_content_digest)=(p_task,p_key,p_digest)
    OR (e.target_task_id,e.target_product_key,e.target_content_digest)=(0,'@self','@self')))
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_endpoint e WHERE e.product_id=placement.build_id
   AND e.revision_id=placement.build_id AND e.relation_id=p_address->>'relation_id'
   AND e.role=p_address->>'endpoint_role' AND e.occurrence_id=p_address->>'occurrence_id'
   AND (e.target_task_id,e.target_product_key,e.target_content_digest)=
    ((p_address->>'task_id')::bigint,p_address->>'product_key',p_address->>'content_digest')) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'unsupported or forged captured recognition decision lineage' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 SELECT o.body,b.descriptor->'observation' INTO STRICT provider,observation
  FROM kb.pdf_occurrence o JOIN ops.pdf_product p USING(task_id,product_key)
  JOIN ops.pdf_product_body b USING(task_id,product_key)
  WHERE o.task_id=(p_address->>'task_id')::bigint AND o.product_key=p_address->>'product_key'
   AND p.content_digest=p_address->>'content_digest' AND p.kind='recognition_observation'
   AND encode(sha256(b.payload),'hex')=p.content_digest
   AND o.occurrence_id=p_address->>'occurrence_id';
 IF provider IS DISTINCT FROM (p_address->>'provider_occurrence_json')::jsonb
  OR observation IS DISTINCT FROM (p_address->>'observation_json')::jsonb
  OR provider->>'precision' NOT IN ('unknown','coarse','block')
  OR provider ? 'start' OR provider ? 'end' OR jsonb_typeof(provider->'text') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'captured recognition provider custody or original precision differs' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 captured:=provider->>'text';
 RETURN captured;
EXCEPTION WHEN no_data_found OR too_many_rows THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'captured recognition has no unique admitted retained lineage/body' USING ERRCODE='23514';
END
